reviewsWithKeywords.title: playa de muro unforgettable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful white beach, equipped with facilities, bars and umbrella rentals.6 km long the beach is divided into sectors, the first super crowded with many hotels the others more natural and wild.We were in sector 4, more natural landscape less chaotic, with adjacent small and pretty bar.Crystal clear water, calm and shallow sea ideal for swimming.I can't wait to go back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely long sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely long sandy beach, sea very calm and good for swimming. Very picturesque and did not need to walk to far to find a secluded spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for children to swim safely.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, shallow sloping fine sandy beach with crystal clear water. For us one of the most beautiful beaches on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Super nice beach, white sand, turquoise water like in the Caribbean. We found other beaches like cala Millor but a bit nicer, as the beach there is wider and the waves are less or the sea is not so restless.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a beautiful blue flag beach with lifeguards.Their are toilets and showers and foot showers too.The sea is so clear! It's good for paddling and swimming in. I could wade put to the end of the pier/jetty and still have my feet on the seabed! The second time I went to the beach it was a bit rougher, so I didn't venture too far out because I could feel the current pulling me.Sun loungers can be rented for €21 a man comes round to collect money. It appears to be cash only. There's a little area next to Isabella's restaurant that is shaded because of the trees.  It's a nice place to sit, if you don't want to pay or can't afford the price of a sunlounger. There's shops and restaurants right next to the beach.There are vendors that sell beach towels/blankets,  foot massages and can do your hair. One woman had French plaits done. If you say no, they leave you alone.There's a glass bottom boat and a catamaran that you can get on at the end of the pier/jetty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too many people

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wide and charming beach in Puerto de Alcudia!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited Playa de Muro in February this year and was pleasantly surprised. It is a beautiful and very extensive beach, which makes it an ideal place both to walk quietly along the shore and to enjoy a good swim when the weather accompanies.Even in low season, you can appreciate the tranquility of the surroundings and how well maintained the area is. Its spaciousness allows you to relax without feeling overwhelmed, and the combination of clear sand and clean water makes it a very pleasant place to spend the day.A beach recommended for those looking for a spacious and pleasant place near the Port of Alcudia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but extremely boring
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach that goes for kilometers each way. A bit narrow at times so it feels like people are on top of each other. Amazingly clean, super warm sea ( September). But the area is extremely quiet, there's absolutely nothing going on, no atmosphere. If you prefer dynamic setting, choose a different and bigger town.The only place with remarkable food, drinks and atmosphere is NU beach bar and restaurant. But their prices will make holes in your pockets. 18€ + for s cocktail. ...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach…shame about the rude sun lounger man
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We’ve come on holiday to this beach three years running we really love it. White sand & clear blue water. Plenty of sun loungers and water sports. The people are a PAIN on this beach though. Constant ‘looky looky men/ people selling things’ asking you every 30 seconds. And now I’ve been shouted at and falsely accused of not paying my sunlounger fee by the aggressive guy collecting the money. Shame as it spoils a beautiful place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach where the boardwalk takes you out into the sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in a hotel just off this beautiful beach. The sea is lovely and clear with somedays the seaweed builds up near the shore. The sea is full of fish and they happily swim around your feet. This beach is  long and we only walked a small bit of it. It's lovely and clean. As we were staying a two minute walk away we didn't use the chairs and umbrella but they had a safe attached if you needed to use this. The dunes and boardwalk add to this beach. The only downside was the mosquitoes in the early morning which put pay to an early morning swim. The beach was busy which was to be expected in the middle of August. Near the boardwalk you can find that the sea goes a bit deeper then hits a sandbank and then is shallow for a while which makes it's safe for kids. There are beach bars off the beach in the dunes or attached to hotels. A beach to  try out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Local transportation - DISGRACEFUL
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice coastal town, with a wide range of good restaurants,shops and a few bars - a family resort.Only down side, if were staying here and wanted to travel to other towns on this coast like Alcudia and C'an Picafort - be careful, taxis are very difficult to find and their reliability is so bad our excellent hotel, would not book a taxi on our behalf. Also the local bus company is a disgrace - TIB - take no notice of their timetables. 29th August 2025, waited an hour for a bus to Alcudia - only one full up bus, then decided to go the other way to C'an Picafort waited 15 mins, on return waited 75 mins with kids, stories of people stranded in Alcudia - walking 6.5 miles back - not good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Waves

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Value for money
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well what can I say don't take any notice of bad reviews just people being picky 😕. We have stayed in 5* many times and this hotel is really good food is excellent rooms clean pool good staff lovely beach fantastic. We went for a week and had a great time and met some lovey people it's lovely and chilled with good entertainment though out the day.Infact we enjoyed it that much we have just been and booked again for next year for two weeks and will be returning with a great couple we met there.If I was to one of those picky people 😜 all I would say is that a loo brush would be good in the bathroom and drinks weren't that great but hey that's not going to ruin our stay as cleaners were in everyday with extra loo roll and clean towels and beds were always made.Would recommend people go to the sky bar at condesor hotel just down the road and treat yourself to a lovey cocktail and watch the sun set and see the fantastic views. Thanks to all at the hotel for a fantastic stay see you in 2026

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, but frightening experience with sunbed staff
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and views were absolutely stunning — crystal-clear water and soft sand made for an ideal setting, and we took many beautiful photos.However, our experience was ruined when the man in charge of the sun loungers attempted to hit me and threatened me, saying “If you don’t pay, it’s problem.” I felt genuinely unsafe. This kind of aggressive and intimidating behavior is unacceptable, especially in a tourist area.Please be cautious if you’re renting sunbeds here, and I hope the local authorities address this urgently so others don’t have to go through the same.

The prices for sunbeds and umbrella I find already very expensive(13,50€) but everyone as he likes.....toilets if then only in the hotels or restaurants directly on the beach or in the street behind what I don't like. reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most beautiful beach I have ever been to!!! We always get a car when we go to mallorca and stay in Alcudia so that we can drive around. We always drive to this beach, there’s beach bars & toilets. For 2 Sunbeds & Umbrella its €18.20 for the day and has a locked box so you can keep valuables in there. The sea is beautiful, clear water, and you can walk out for a long way before it starts getting deep. Perfect for families and young children. The sand is also perfect, white & soft. No rocks, no jellyfish & no seaweed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, long and natural beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach in the area. Just because it is so particularly long, there are different sections..depending on which one you prefer: With lifeguards, loungers and all comforts or right at the nature park where none of this is and you can enjoy the beach for yourself. We were right in the last section and could walk into the nature reserve. Here, of course, you have to stay on the trails. But for nature lovers and adventurers just the thing. Parking is also no problem there. We had fish, big waves, soft sand and seagulls. Highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of people here, even in the off-season time. The water is amazingly clean and full of fish and little crabs. We got waves the other day, but sometimes it is like a pond, not even the smallest movement. The beach is not too wide, and right after it you can find lots of markets, bistros and restaurants where you can grab a quick bite or a refreshment. There are lifeguards patrolling all the time and in a few spots you can find water showers to clean up the sand off your slippers. If you prefer you can rent sunbeds and umbrellas, but there is enough space for beach towels if you would rather enjoy the sand. And for those wondering if October is a good time to visit Mallorca I can tell you I've got my back sun burned in no time. The water temperature is around 24°C, while in the air it rises to 28-30.

A must-visit if you’re in Mallorca

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Highly recommended

The beach is very extensive, we entered just before the pine forest near a village of Can Picafort. Recommendation to move towards the pine forest, in periods of greater influx remains uncrowded.  The water is beautiful, I found it clean, fresh and shallow with fine sand.Rescue service, various bars and restaurants (towards Can Picafort), equipped beaches, showers and toilets.  Nothing is missing.Recommendation in busy period, to park towards Can Picafort near a roundabout there is a supermarket and following the road towards the center, there is a huge free parking.Highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful shallow waters and fantastic amenities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I can honestly say this is possibly the best beach I have ever visited especially if you have young children. Although the beach isn’t very deep it is extremely long so you won’t struggle to find anywhere to set up for the day. Sunbeds with umbrellas and safe boxes are available to hire but we never bothered. Pedlo’s and paddle boards are also available to hire at €20 an hour but these are very popular so be prepared to wait. You can buy beach umbrellas (€12-20) and beach blankets (€10-20) locally so you can get a nice set up at a very reasonable price. The sea is so shallow I never once felt worried about my children and as you walk out there is a huge sand bank which makes the water ankle/knee deep. Lovely clean beach area, recycling bins, showers and toilets which is a big plus. Plenty of supermarkets and bars/restaurants close by for refreshments. Even the lookie lookie men were pleasant and respectful if you say no thank you. We did hear a few reports of thefts on the beach so we never took any valuables with us and to be honest it’s not a bad idea to have a digital detox and enjoy family time. This place is great for unwinding.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach for big and small.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beach! Perfect for family small and large. The water is shallow with lifeguards in towers and jet ski ala Baywatch. Ambulance was parked we road and there is medical care.There is shower for body and feet to flush off salt and sand.There are model primitive toilets.If you want to rent a sunbed, just go there and put your things and the landlord will come to you. The seats quickly get full so arrive early in the day.  A parasol with two chairs costs EUR 14.95. If you do not want to rent space, you can just lay the towel on the sand where there is room We bought a large serong/cloth that we hung on the umbrella to create more shade. There are sellers all the time, however, they stopped asking us after we bought the canvas. Vendors selling fruit came, we bought watermelon, dragon fruit and coconut just fine. There are pedal boats with slide for rent what we saw. Didn't try it themselves. We were super happy to swing in the waves and it beats all hotel pools by far.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Huge top beach, keeping up with the best in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We as a family found the beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in Mallorca. It's worth it! There is plenty of parking nearby, and the beach is not crowded even during high season as it is very large!

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful beach with light golden sand and warm clear water. Will cost 20 Euros per day for 2 sunbeds with an umbrella. The seller was friendly. The pedalos with slide cost 20 Euros also for an hour.  The beach illegal sellers are a little annoying sadly. They will bother you hourly on average and some don't take no for an answer. Best to totally ignore them as when you try to be polite they don't move on. Despite this, this is one of the nicest beaches I have visited worldwide.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beach! Clear, turquoise water, we found it to be calmer first thing and got more wavy as the morning went in, sand that is pale enough that it doesn't burn your feet and it's shallow for quite a while so ideal for kids. Plenty of space, just watch where you park, we parked well off the road on a bit of dirt and got given a €100 fine for blocking a pavement or pedestrian walkway, something that was completely false, so just make sure you park in designated bays.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A really nice beach. Plenty of space on both land and sea. A bit to walk as the parking lot is at the main road (10 min). The water is crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cute.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very wide beach with crystal clear waters and touched us with many algae While it is very beautiful its water, in sight it is a beach throwing to caribbean without any beauty around You can leave the car on the street and walk to a wooden bridge that around you is a beautiful hotel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful sandy beach, where you can rent sunbeds with umbrellas for a good price. There is also a good selection of food and drinks by the beach, and fruit is also sold on the beach from time to time. The beach is clean and suitable for both families and couples in love.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pleasant beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quiet, clean beach, where children can enjoy quietly.A lot of activities can be done including the pedalo slide which is top and buoy.Walking distance to many hotels

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach & top water, unfortunately very crowded.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for families with smaller children as the water here is extremely shallow and you can go far in until it gets deeper.The water quality is also top. Seagrass can of course not be avoided depending on the current.However, you should be aware that the beach is crowded in high season and towel to towel, so not for people looking for peace or a quiet place....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An inevitable photo
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Come non fare un salto a playa de muro?! Beach that is very reminiscent of our beaches of Salento but that you distinguish for the presence of its renowned and long wharf. Clear water and fine white sand. Half a day of relaxation and lots of sun. Books are always occupied by residents of hotels overlooking the beach. As soon as you land in Mallorca your first purchase must be an umbrella. You will need it in all coves so it is a great investment. Take advantage of the lady with the wheelbarrow selling excellent fresh fruit.  If you want to eat really well and with your feet in the sand I recommend the chiringuito Bar Pierino Italian conduction but delicious tapas as well as sangria

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice, long beach. Despite the great crowd, there is a place for everyone. Both for lounging on the sand itself and for sunbeds with parasols that have a safe with a code to leave your phone, wallet... when you go swimming. It is a bit more shallow and you will have to walk a bit longer to the depth to swim. Toilets are there, showers, lots of places for volleyball. There is a supermarket and a restaurant near the beach. The beach is long and depends on where you are. New restaurants are being built along the entire length of the beach, which will probably be for next season. This will probably make it easier for tourists to be able to buy something refreshing, eat a snack, drink coffee without having to dress up and go to a cafe or restaurant. The only thing that bothered us was that you didn't have something on the beach, where you could buy something and enjoy it on your deckchair.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sotto le aspettative!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach definitely below expectations and anyway not the first of Mallorca! It is a 6km stretch of sand with sea in many stretches full of seaweed and overall not crystal clear... possibility to rent sunbeds and umbrellas and free parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pensavo meglio!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Greatly overrated beach... definitely not to be considered the first beach in Majorca! It is a 6km stretch of sand with a sea in many stretches full of algae and definitely not crystal clear. Free parking and easy to find. Overall not terrible but I expected better!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: looked better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we took two buses for a total of two hours to get to the famous playa de muro, beautiful walk through the pine forest, but arrived nothing spectacular, yes two sunbeds and an umbrella 14 euros but the short beach and sea full of seaweed, to swim in clean water you had to go offshore,not recommend the end of playa de muro try where it starts. only shower every 200 meters and amenities to review. disappointing compared to other little known beaches and much cleaner

reviewsWithKeywords.title: For all tastes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sea that slopes slowly, very long beach with equipped and crowded areas and others more isolated and quiet. Easy to reach. Boat excursions depart from the jetty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A huge and beautiful beach Maybe complicated to park But it's worth visitingMallorca is spectacular in itself, but this beach is amazing The closest thing to the Caribbean you'll find

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Places to visit necessarily
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Endless beach , fine white sand, crystal clear sea, Mediterranean and wild vegetation.Although there are many hotels with direct access to the beach, the landscape is not altered because well disguised by the thick vegetation.The free beach is immense, some well-equipped and affordable establishments, small restaurants with fabulous panoramic views of the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach list … top 10.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing … top beach list. Clear, turquoise waters, shade and facilites available throughout.  Best beach on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Many algae
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very busy in all its sectors even in the most remote. We were barely seeing her because the water was full of algae

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super Strand!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great sea, almost like in the Caribbean!Clean water, you can go far in and very nice colors from the water. The beach with very light sand. Yeah, a lot of people, but that's the way it is on public beaches. Even found it ok from the crowd here. It wasn't crowded in the sea itself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely beach on with plenty of sunbeds if get up early enough. Sea is clear and shallow some way out.  Been here a few times but seemed not to be as clean but maybe that is down to others not putting rubbish in bin.The man taking money for sunbeds was very friendly.The only downside was one of the sales men on the beach was quite rude-asking for cigarettes, sitting down on the end of our sunbed and even helping himself to some melon we had purchased on the beach.The other salesmen and women were lovely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful and long beach. It's worth a visit.  We can rent deckchairs and parking was not difficult to find even in July 😁

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beaches!!! l water is very clear and sand on the beach and not pebbles!!! fairly quiet beach, beautiful waves

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach to go with the family is usually very busy but as it is very extensive you can enjoy your beach day without problems

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Normal beach for the family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is not bad, it was not very populated although I have to say that the day was very cloudy, so I imagine in summer time it will be up. For children it is very good because it has shallow depth at first. The only thing I miss is maybe a few showers and being able to park a little easier.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Morning tour recommended
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach both early in the morning at sunrise and beyond the day. Here we have walked kilometers after kilometers, sat at a beach restaurant, laid on the beach and bathed a lot in delicious clean water with good bath temperature. A morning walk between 6:00 and 8:00 is recommended. Then the tranquility and peace can really be ⁇

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with turquoise waters. superb view. very nice. lack of shower for rinsing. swimming is monitored like all beaches of Majorca

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Large Majorcan beach ideal for families with children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large beach with fine white sand.  With turquoise waters.   Very comfortable for children as it is shallow.  Full length of hotels and apartments

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely sandy beach which stretches for miles. Sun loungers and umbrellas to hire along with safety deposit boxes. Easily accessible & would definitely re-visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great views and beach but very busy. Nice shallow entry into the sea. If you want a sun lounger I recommend you need to be there before 9am. Parking is a bit of a problem as it's so busy. Some nudity as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Show. The most beautiful beach I've seen so far.  There are various sectors to access. Parking can be found without problems but I think that from the end of June it will be more difficult.  Better to arrive by 10.00

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Bay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really attractive beach within a bay, a gently sloping sand floor allows the recreational area to be expansive.  Easy to park and parking free of charge.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stupendous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Splendid beach with free parking, equipped with various entrances. Free or equipped with sunbeds and umbrellas around 15 euros per day. Being very large there is room for everyone and therefore it remains among the best choices I think also in July August, wonderful colors of the water. I didn't see any bars on the beach but nearby to walk to supermarkets..,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pleasant family beach Shallow water. Sanitary and shower nearby. Shaded place next to the beach if you want to have a picnic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, shallow water clean and clear which stretches far into other towns. Umbrellas and beds available, lovely for everyone, great views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unfortunately not as beautiful as in most photos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately not as nice as described. The sand is really sticky, there was a lot of algae in the water and on the beach. 🏖️ we didn't find it very nice in general. We drove for over an hour and were disappointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with fantastic calm water. One minus is that there are lots of folks on the beach trying to sell you blankets, massages etc which can get annoying at times. Otherwise great beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: End of discussion - This is the best beach in Spain
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro is not the best beach in Mallorca - it’s the best beach in Spain! Crystal clear and clean waters / fresh breeze to calm the summer heat / especially safe for kids / not over crowded / backs onto Playa de Alcudio which is also excellent. Great facilities along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its a quiet place, nothing flash but that makes it attractive as you don't get large noisy groups around. Beach is simple and safe with lots of sun beds.Major base for cycling in Spring and Autumn

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic family holiday 2mins yes from Playa de Muro beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Brilliant holiday. Lovely house 2mins from the beach in a quiet area. Muro beach amazing, long stretch of sand, well looked after. Our grandchildren had a great time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nothing special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nothing extraordinary, large beach where you can walk around, quite a few hotels nearby, sandy beach, free nearby parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the detour.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the bay is superb, the pontoon very photogenic :-) A few sellers on the beach, but not very pushy.Visit in April, under the sun, but with cool temperatures, there were few people and it was quite pleasant. I imagine it's less pleasant at the height of the season: the parking lot isn't very big, nor is the strip of sand, it's probably difficult to make your way. For our part, no regrets about having made the detour.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful extensive sandy beach with panoramic views of the bay and mountains in all directions.  Clean and with sunbeds and umbrellas available to hire. Clear water and gentle shelving make it an ideal spot to swim. Cafés and bars within a few steps.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very nice white sandy beach. Quite narrow but lots of space to lie on the sand or hire beds and umbrellas. The water stays shallow for a long way making it ideal for children to play in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good experience, very good service, good foodVery clean ,Good spa massageGood price, in good treatmentGood views of aviationThe bed is very comfortableGreat party

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Platja de Muro Beach is great!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Platja de Muro Beach is one of the best beaches on Mallorca. It is very long and there is a gradual slope into the ocean, making it easy for kids and easy to gradually go into the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: let's go to the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful long beach, worth visiting even in February, but only for a walk as the water is very cold.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach was our favorite beach in Mallorca. It was very long, wide with nice sand and the sea was always waving. We were swimming in the sea in late October and the weather was really hot and not so many people around like in the holiday peak season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The only interest is the pontoon to take a little selfie
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On paper, the beach is beautiful with beautiful turquoise colors, in reality, it is rather greenish with the number of people present on the beaches and their mountains of sunscreen. We went there because they said good things about it, but in the end, apart from a little souvenir photo on the wooden pontoon, we didn't stay.For people who like to sunbathe on a pretty sandy beach, no worries. But you won't be alone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome white sandy beach the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in Spain amazing and shallow lovely clear water can get choppy but clean beach and area,two beds and a brolly just under 15 euros

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach with clean water and jetty.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at Hotel Grupotel Los Principes. Could just lay in the deckchairs very close to the beautiful beach with the fine sand and lovely clean sea water. A nice long bathing bridge with a nice view of Alcudia.Sincerely. An & Nine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dream beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sandy beach and turquoise water. Not overcrowded but well attended. Lots of families and the number of sellers of all kinds of items is limited. A highlight: the sunrise in the morning!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful. White sand and clear water. We spent a couple of hours on the beach during our 10 night stay. It was just too busy for us so we couldn't relax as much as we would like. If you don't mind it being busy, it's perfect. We both loved being in the sea. Perfect for families as you are not far from the waters edge and you can easily keep your eyes on your little ones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, very long, sandy, but unfortunately very crowded. Parking was easy and there was a foot shower at the exit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach for families with children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful sandy beach in the bay of Alcudia!Perfect for children to swim there because it is shallow from the beach to about 100 m out to sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sea and great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful place with every service, clean free beach with free showers.Very beautiful sea especially when there is no wind.Various boat excursions depart from the docks, some of them exceptional.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I stayed at the Hotel Playa Esperanza Resort and every day we go to Muro beach and use the beach chairs in the Hotel's garden, which are still free because the beach chairs and umbrellas scattered throughout the garden are paid for. but two sun loungers and an umbrella cost more or less 14 euros per person and each umbrella has a safe!!From the hotel garden, you can walk to the 7 km beach with white sand and crystal clear water, even if it was green the days we went.Other days the water was full of algae.There are different lifeguards throughout the beach and in general there are sun loungers from the different hotels for payment all over the beach.We don't have a car but there is plenty of parking in front of the beach.There are many beach bars, restaurants and a paddle surf school.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Half day trip would be enough. I dont recommend whole vacation here.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated & overcrowded. We booked a hotel really close to this beach (not to mention that this hotel does not have a half of the price value we had to pay), we wanted to be really close to a nice beach. I mean the beach is not ugly but very narrow and overcrowded and two sunbeds with a parasol cost around 19€/day. We spent 2 hours total there and chose to walk 30minutes to a nicer beach instead. If we knew before, we would have never chosen this hotel in this location. It is a mass tourism place and every day we have to think about a plan how to get away (trips on bus, bike, scooter or car), we are very disappointed, won’t ever come back. This is the first time we are looking forward to go home from the holiday :( If you really want to visit this place, plan your trip to spend here at most 1 day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach, white sand, crystal clear sea. Being very large and well known it is very crowded. Be careful because if you don't arrive early you risk not finding the umbrellas because they are all occupied by the guests of the resorts just behind who go up to the hotel leaving everything there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We will be back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Super clean beach, clean toilets.If I read negative things about the beach here, it's only because they're probably hoping that fewer tourists will come.It wasn't crowded, a great holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach to go with children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very cool, there were a lot of little fish and we had a great time trying to fish.Clean beach and good atmosphere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We had a great time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach with lifeguards. Short walk along waterfront to bars, restaurants and shops. Plenty of sunbeds or beach space if needed. Water in the morning was lovely however after lunch the sea was very full of small pieces of plastic. We didn't feel able to swim in it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in Mallorca 🤍
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean beach and for us the most beautiful in Mallorca. Not overcrowded and combined with a lovely walk through the park it's fantastic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great for families. Many areas enabled for children.Several restaurants with different types of food.Very friendly and helpful staff.Variety of swimming pools and leisure areas.Cleaning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Is an amazing beach I would recommend it as it’s the best for family , the water is crystal clear and kids can play

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too bad about the algae
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very large beach with very large free municipal parking lots. Suitable for families with children, shallow water. We ended up on a foggy day, so one star less. We recommend going towards the reserve side

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It could be better.....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach about 7 km long, which we reach with our rented car. We stop at two points on the beach, but the sunbeds were all sold out, the beach is narrow and full of seaweed, so we move away to the next Platja des Port D'Alcudia,The water is beautiful near the characteristic pier on which we were taking a walk from the D'Alcudia beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best family beach in Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Mallorca for a family who wants a lot of space to swim and play in the sea.  Clear, aquamarine water just like the Caribbean, soft white sand, and you can go out a hundred meters and still be able to stand.  It’s huge- no problem having a few Olympic-sized pools worth of space all to yourself, even in July/August.  Just beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated overcrowded beach. Beautiful in a quiet winter day, probably. Do not spend effort for this one, as it's almost always so busy you cannot drop a needle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A clean tidy sandy beach with shallow waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Various different places along the beach to stop for the day - whether you fancy the crowds or the peace and quiet. Take your pick. There are sunbeds along the way with parasols - all optional. The beach is big enough to find some sand to lie on without the need to get a sunbedThe sand is very soft and easy to lie on. The sea is extremely clear in places and shallow for some distance out - perfect for swimming. There is seaweed in places but it is the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning white sand beach fringed with beautifull pine trees. Shallow Christal clear azure blue water .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great looking beachWarm sea and sandHave to pay for sunbeds & there are quite a few street sellersWould go back if was nearbyRecommend walking up the beach towards Alcudia as that's where theres a bit more going on. Nice few beach bars nearby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach very clean!The water is very safe for swimmingYou have to pay for the beds & umbrella’s on the beach 🏖️They clean the beach every day 👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect for family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you come to Playa del Muro to discover Mallorca, you might be a little disappointed... its really touristic, you have 3km of street full of the same souvenirs market, restaurants food is american or german mostly.. its perfect for vacation with family, especially young kids, but if you travel solo like me, you need to move at Palma or Alcudia to see what's Mallorca really look like.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for walking, sunbathing or going for a swim. The water is shallow for quite a way out and looks very clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clear sandy beach, lovely for walking clear water calm and peaceful grate with young children,we visited just beginning of season due to that some of the beech facility wer not open

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach with a lot of nudists if you walk a bit away from the downs, along the forest.At the beach section near the obelisk there are mostly gay men and there is a gay cruising area in the dunes and forest behind the obelisk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: October visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was quiet plenty of beds but not cheap, beach great for sunbathing and swimming and plenty of room

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Glorious
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful beach, clean sand and turquoise seas which is very calm and quite shallow for some way out. The sun loungers €15 for two beds and an umbrella were great including the use of personal al lock boxes for valuable. Quite a few bars and restaurants just at the back so great for food and drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Play Del Muro Beach - Nudist Area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The main beach has lovely golden sand that stretches for several km from southern Alcudia to northern C’an Picafort and is backed by the tree and scrub covered dunes of Es Comu De Muro all with a fantastic view of Alcudia bay.  Closer to the two towns there are lots of sun beds and parasols for hire and away from the buildings topless women are common.  Move further away and you reach the unofficial nudist beach where the majority are naked or at least topless.  You will find people sunbathing naked anywhere there aren’t the sun loungers/parasols for hire but the main area is centred over a km between the two wooden walkways through Es Comu De Muro with the stone  obelisk closest to the beach in the middle.  The main concentration is near the obelisk, there is no defined “gay” area and everyone mixes freely but immediately north of the obelisk has the higher all male concentration.  The dunes are fascinating and well worth an explore (please be mindful of avoiding damage to the eco structure) but are not for the feint hearted as this is where you will find gay/Bi men cruising and sexual acts are common in the more secluded areas particularly at the end of the day (sadly much evidence of their activities litters these areas) - so avoid or enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sandy beach and warm, clean sea to swim in. Highly recommend a visit to this beach. It's shallow for quite a way out and perfect for families with kids

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand with clear blue sea, very shallow and safe for children and elderly. Shops nearby and beach sellers with delicious fruits and mojitos!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had a very good time in Mallorca, playa del Muro and Gaviotas hotel! Must go!!! Must be ab 4 Stars hotels. Otherwise, full of kids and Mosquitos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unbelievable, beautiful sea!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unbelievable, beautiful sea!This is the best Spanish beach we’ve ever been too.Clean sand clear water, one issue storm hit for half an hour, but when the sun shone again, heaven.We we’re staying north of the peninsula in Alcudia and traveled south to Muro. Next time we will go to a hotel on this beach, sorry Hotel More.Also it will mean we won’t have to use the Taxi service. In Mallorca it’s absolutely rubbish don’t bother. Wait for an hour doesn’t turn up.Take a bus, hire a car or walk. Many people said they will not return to Mallorca just because cab service is crap.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, safe,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to this beach many times september 2022, very clean, quiet and safe, some great walks plenty to do or to just sit and relax,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've visited Muro beach a few times and it's gorgeous. It's a wide sandy beach with sunbeds/shades available at a charge but also plenty of space if you just want to.lie on a towel on the beach. The sea is gently shelving and tends to be calm so perfect of everyone including families.There are toilets on the edge of the beach and a number of shops/restaurants very close by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing day trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, hot weather and amazing walk along the Muro beach. No problem with the parking although the more you drive far the cheaper beds and umbrellas are which is a benefit if you are on the beach every day with a group of friends. Enjoy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Majorka
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ideal bright soft sand, safe place for children - shallow water, lifeguard, Showers at the entrance to the beach. This part of the beach where I was, is not very commercial, it was quiet and peaceful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful long stretch of beach with white sand and very clear blue water.It was very crowded on the day we visited but there we lots of parasols and chairs for hire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy white beach with very clean water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice sandy white beach with very clean water. There is a local bar (not sure about working hours because seems like it works about 4-5hours). As part of the bar is regular, clean toilets. Sun beds and umbrella with safe cost around 16 euros. Parking is free and large and it can be found at the beginning of this long beach. Beach provides a very beautiful view of the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful setting. great views and superb facilities. Loads of sun beds available. Great beach bars .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice water but in comparison to the other beaches of this island too many tourists and much dirtier. The pier in the picture is crowded with people during the day. Restaurants on and around the beach require reservations for dinner.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful,  clean and child friendly beach. Hired a pedalo 18 euros the kids loved it. Lack of beach bars though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was on the doorstep to our hotel. Lovely warm shallow sea and golden sand. A pair of sunbeds cost 15 euros for the day and the parasols all have safes attached to them. Pedalos were 20 euros and were great fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach but does get busy be careful near the pier as it can get rough and there is a current there which can make it difficult to get out of lifeguards were always watching.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: what an amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a great beach at any time of day!  Watch the sunrise, go for a paddle or dip, jump on a jet ski or parasail, all under the watchful eye of a life guard.  Anything is possible on the beach in Alcudia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not what it seems - nicer beaches around
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An okay beach that was very crowded and narrow. Felt very packed and you need to swim quite far out in order to get deeper into the ocean. Two beds were €15 for the day and comes with a safe box to put belongings. I wouldn’t be visiting again purely because the pictures couldn’t be further from what we had experienced!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Muro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was great. The water was beautifully warm. It’s easy to rent an umbrella with two chaise lounges…just beware those umbrella corners smack you in the head if you’re not with it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing Beach, 8th time here and keep coming back for more. Only advice is orange labels on beds means reserved so hop on any without and pay the guy who comes round usually between 10.30 and 12.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Trip advisot , DONT DELET MY REVIWE PLEASE ,  we need together inform peaople and family with children .
