reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing clear, warm beautiful sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most amazing beach! My son enjoyed jumping off the jetty in the photo! Sands are soft and clean, water is warm and crystal clear. Shallow for metres too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful- be careful of current though
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach, white sand, clear water. Lots of sun loungers with parasols available for €10, parasols had a safe box attached which was helpful for storing valuables. The sea is tranquil and ideal for children as it’s shallow a fair way out, although be careful of the current that is there underneath when swimming back to shore- it caught two of us strong swimmers out! Lots of beach sellers selling fake goods, massage, blankets & fruit, which we did buy from, but they do get annoying being asked every 15 mins! Overall, a stunning beach definitely up there as one of my favourite

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bad experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful with clear water,sand,toilets  available (no soap,often empty for toilet paper),food and drinks easy to find.It’s a lot of fruit sellers,blanket sellers and massage sellers on the beach.We were all robbed at the beach,we showed the police who did it but they didn’t bother to help us.They robbed several families at the same time that day and the day before.We went to the police station,and they told us to not go to the beach with mobile phones,AirPods,cash,wallet etc.The advices is to just bring towels and cold drinks.These guys who did this,is professional and did it when the beach was full of people and many people was watching and we asked these guys for our things they get aggressive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shallow, lovely sand and clear water.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach to snorkel, paddle, swim or just laze around. Its a busy beach but with some gaps between sections of sun beds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifull beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was near to tour hotel. The collor of the cea is something to behold. It is quite shallow warter for a great distance so it is great for the kids...it could get ab it crowded at times and there is no asphalt or pawed walkway along the beach. You can aónly walk the beach barefoot in the sand which is also nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach for swimming and soaking up the sun with lots of nice beach shops and bars to choose from.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach plenty of loungers to be had for 15euro for the day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: get there for 10.30 ish to get the best views from the loungers can get busy in afternoons do try the local bars and cafes as they are very good and reasonably priced

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GREAT!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach is our favourite beach in Mallorca regardless of age! The sea was always waving and it was always very clean. The sandy beach was superb for the whole family!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful beach! clear waters, slight waves. One of the best beaches i have travelled too. stunning

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely clean beach , sun loungers expensive though and a lot of traders ! that said great location and lovely hotels

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long awaited family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic holiday with family, beach and sea really good for the kids, and adults alike. Stayed at playa Garden apart hotel, good hotel friendly staff, value for money.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach & sea.. but don't expect to not be asked if you want to buy sunglasses or have a massage every 5 minutes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is absolutely beautiful, the sand is golden & the water is crystal clear.However.. I thought the Mallorcan police were cracking down on people trying to sell you items on the beach?  They're definitely still around, but they're really not the most irritating.  There must have been 10 Thai women and a couple of male workers walking up and down the beach asking if you wanted a massage.Now I really dont mind if I'm asked once or twice but some days it was relentless, they were coming in waves, I think its a tactic to try and grind you into submission 😂 - I said no to one lady and she started massaging my shoulders... I just find it rude, one day I said no thank you about 50 times, it got me to the point where I just point blank ignored them.  But yeah, the beach and Port D'Alcudia is a beautiful place to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach near Alcudia!  The beach is clean, the water is clear and shallow - really great for families and young kids.  We had a blast and I would definitely come back to this area for a beach holiday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: amazing golden sand plenty of availability to beach sports bars restaurants shops ladies walking the beach offering massage they are great try them guys walking along selling fruit many out there selling goods  on the beach but they don't pester you they are always pleasant and friendly ive been going every yr for 16 years

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful white sandy beach with crystal clear water and blue sky in summer. Little windy during my visit in May but still quite warm. Nice and peaceful. Perfect for relaxing holiday. Great for family with kids. (6.50€ for a sunbed)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: crystal clear warm water - very shallow for quite a long way out feeling safer with children - life guard on duty - very clean - highly recommend this beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a good, long beach near Alcudia. It was near our hotel Allsun Eden Playa. Due to the COVID pandemics, there was no equipment like umbrellas and sun beds. As the sea is calm and the water is not deep, it is a good place to swim and for families. Also it is a good place for a walk. We did a long walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Playa de Muro in the mornings as my hotel was only a few minutes away. It was very quiet and so beautiful. Definitely recommend spending some time here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: B E A utiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Genuinely never been in a crystal clear sea before and was a bit blown away by it to be honest. Absolutely stunning

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Were is the kristal blue water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have brown water at playa the muro. Don’t know what happed with the clear blue everybody talks about. It looks far from tropical like the pictures. Maybe because the wind comes from the sea or the heavy rainfall the last few days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach - one of the best on the island!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long, white sandy beach which you will find hard to beat. Great for everybody but particularly families with children as the beach is gently shelving and has lifeguard coverage - who are particularly hot when it comes to safety.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand, beautiful beach's, pesky people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pro - beautiful beach, not too busy, white sandy with light blue watersCon - sunbeds cost around 5 euros each for the day but they like to lie  and over change tourists. Clearly says a certain price on the tickets but he'll change whatever he wants then runs off before giving you the change. Also you get pestered every 5 mins with people selling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Busy Sandy beach with lots of families.  Easy parking on road side later in the day out of the heat of the sun.  Short walk through the pine forest & on the wooden walkway.  Shallow sea for a little way out.  Beautiful warm water.  Safe enough for young children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach with deep golden sand, clear light blue sea which is like a warm bath and is very shallow for quite a way out! Go in the mornings after breakfast when it’s quiet, it’s absolutely gorgeous

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise water!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water was partly turquoise and very warm, wonderful to swim in even though there were some waves. The view of the bay is simply beautiful and depending where you are and what time you go it is more or less crowded. Unfortunately some tourists don’t bother to clean up their own trash.....despite the trash cans on the beach. I did see in the early morning a team of beach cleaners. Some water activities and boat tours being offered as well. Great memories for our family !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dirty though sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is sandy, clear water, slowing shelving into the sea. Nevertheless the beach is packed even on a Monday at 11am, dirty, lots of wrappers etc stuck in the sand, no facilities like shower points, toilets, drinks areas on the beach. Very disappointing. Maybe I am just old

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Can Forcat beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach is Sandy & the sea is warm & crystal clear, that’s  until climate change winds kick in to action, then the sea can be rough & dangerous. One day the three life guard towers had red flags flying, yet there was children fifty metres out in the sea, I’m a strong swimmer it it was to rough for me, if you can’t stand up in any water, then don’t swim in it. It’s quite a good stretch of beach for fairly long walks. There was quite a lot of plastic rubbish on the beach, left by visitors & it shouldn’t be allowed in this day & age, apart from that it’s a nice place to spend a few hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sea water: magnificent (Creedence Clearwater Revival...)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean, not crowded, very closed to the JS Hotel. Many attractive opportunities (for those courageous only).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well maintained beach area,shallow water very safe for families with young children.Flat frontage popular with beach walkers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be prepared to fight with locals about the space, but crystal clear and sandy beach. There are many German hotels and bus stops every 20-30minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect day here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a long, clean beach, safe for children, despite the wind and waves. Perfect place for 1 or 2 day trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach is a really nice beach with fine sand. The sea was perfect and super clean for both adults and kids. An absolute must!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sand and visibility
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach here is with nice and fine sand, and it's very clean. The water has great visibility and was a pleasure to swim in. It is very shallow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach ruined by lucky lucky men
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is absolutely beautiful, lovely sand, crystal clear beach, fish at your feet. Amazing beach. All this was ruined by the 20-25 sales pitches by the lucky lucky men selling towels. I get everyone is short of cash right now, but the place was saturated with them, I was at the beach for 2 hours and had to leave because of it. Such a shame because the beach is beautiful. Hired loungers for 13 euro ish. Booked a boat trip with the lady on the pier. Shame it was ruined by them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but a bit busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Is a Long Beach in the North. The sand is really bright and the water is clear and flat which allows you to just sit in the water and enjoy the sun. The pier which was right in front of us, is very dreamy. From time to time you see how the boyfriend has to be the Instagram photographer for his girlfriend. It’s delightful. There are good parking spots every where and a lot of opportunities to get snacks and drinks. There are also some sunbeds you can rent. And if that’s not enough you can just lay on your Sunbed and go shopping at the same time. You have a variety to buy Luis Viton glasses  or to get a small airbrush tattoo. :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long sandy beach and very safe for children. Perfect for a long walk picking shells and paddling in the clear blue waters

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach with beach chairs. (to pay for) regular cleaning en nice for kids.  possibility to learn kite surfing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear water.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love the beach as it is clean, water is clear and shallow. One could really enjoy a beach, especially those with small kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful stretch of white sand beach with shallow water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, worth investing in an umbrella rather than paying daily for a hired sunbed. Also not always available as it's allocated to the hotels on the beach. Keep the environment clean and use bins to put your rubbish in them.  No need to use COVID mask on beach but keep your distance from others to make space. Water and beach beautiful and epic of mix local families and tourist.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean beach in Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach in the isle. Crystal water.  Nice walk. Fine Sand. Big beach. AMAZING!!! You can keep distance easily. Worth to visit and stay there in a great relaxing time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de Muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro has a wonderful, sandy beach with a warm, clear turquoise sea. Ideal for children because of its gentle, shallow waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the world!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is heaven on earth.... You can Wade out for miles and it not be past your shoulders!!! WE ALL  LOVED IT

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After visiting the beach in Alcúdia, this beach is like heaven. We stayed near the National Park entrance where there weren’t any hotels nearby. Amazing sand, fantastic clear water, great waves, but still shallow enough to be safe for children. Really recommend this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long beach with sand for everyone A
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long strip of sand with plenty of space for locals and tourists. Cristal clear water and an amazing view.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: First holiday together
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, lots of places to visit and restaurants to eat in. Food delicious and not too expensive. Staff all welcoming and happy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and clean beach with turquoise water, perfect for a sunny day and long walk. One of the best beaches I have seen on Mallorca.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach in the North-East of Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed a week in September with the family there. The beach is very nice. The color of the water almost like in the Caribbean. about 30m from shore there is a sandbank. It's super for the kids to play there in knee-deep water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 5 k of golden sand. Even more lovely in the winter ... no people guys!!! :)This part of the beach is more natural - head towards the Albafura park and the beach gets wilder. Dunes and some wild flowers ... plus some little wooded areas. Take a gas burner and cook paella ... fab!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: child safe, crystal clear water, only can recommend. I was here in the low season, can imagine its full of people in the high season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent 4 days there, it was a really nice experience. You can enjoy the sun or rent a parasol and chairs to have some shade. Sea water is warm and it has plenty of waves to play on. Kids love it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovley beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited during one day and so nice bech, lot of beachbars, restaurants etc.. it' crowdy during the highseason but the beach is loooong 🌞🤗 recommended to visit. Area is very turistic with lots and lots of hotels thoug.. personally I prefer not to live there ..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Undeniably stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: However we arrived at lunch time and were unprepared so spent most of the afternoon faffing about looking for somewhere to eat. With it being end of season a lot of places were closed unless they had already closed down due to lack of business? Anyway, sadly a relaxing day on the beach was not to be had as the sun also sets earlier with the clocks going back. But we did enjoy the little time we spent on this beautiful beach. Small warning, this part of the beach is close to the Nature Park and with the time of year there were plenty of mosquitos about so we all left with a few bites!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lucky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach 🏝 guy selling pineapples even lady doing massages on beach , gently shelving beach into sea so great for kids

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lifeguards present even during wet periods. Spotlessly clean. Sun loungers available to rent but plenty of room for families who wish to use towels/ blankets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Here, the Mediterranean sea is like the Caribbean sea.  Warm and clean water, with a small depth like a salted water swimming pool.  Sand without rocks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Short break in the sunshine
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Short break in the sunshine with partner. Excellent break staying locally to this beach. Glorious Sandy beach with chargeable parasols and beds. Lifeguard monitored.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing sandy beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing sandy beach. Very, very long perfect for a long sunset walk in the evening. Clean and well maintained.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing white sand beach. Super clean, lovely clear water - and shallow! Felt like you could just walk out for miles. Lots of sunbeds and umbrellas, if that's your thing. If not, plenty of space for beach towels and sandcastles!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for those who love to walk....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some parts of the beach are simply stunning, especially those away from the crowds of Can Picafort's section of Alcudia Bay. It takes around 45 mins ( of a lazy stroll) from the end of Can Picafort's promenade to the wooden platform with a lovely panoramic viewpoint over the sea and the pine forest (in the S'Albufera zone of Alcudia Bay-Playa de Muro). You can explore the pine forest and the idyllic dune area surrounding the place as well- rather quiet  here...Some parts of Playa de Muro were quite busy, though, especially in the first 2 weeks of October...(we'd stayed there for 3 weeks, and the last one was better in terms of beach occupancy- bring in mind that, it was still ''quiet'' by  Mallorcan standards).I personally love the beach in the cloudy days-fewer people then, and the stormy clouds add some dramatic beauty to the place. Those were the moments where the beach really did remind me of the emerald Caribbean beaches, or any other tropical ones...The sea will never have the deep emerald colour of, say, the Grenadines or some Indonesian islands, but it is still as close as it can get to the Caribbean's colours in this part of the World(of course not the only one in Europe...)... and it is only 3 hours on a plane from Poland.. What else?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Birthday wknd
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and stunning beach very clean  dry near to where our hotel was also boat trip can be arranged from pier planning on doing this next year can’t wait to get back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: STUNNING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just stunning nothing else needs to be said.The sea is like you see in the brochures and the beach is just amazing.Lots of hotels along the front, quite busy but it’s huge and goes in for miles. Can’t wait to visit it again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sea but noisy beach and expensive to hire sunbed.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely sea, warm, crystal clear with fish swimming around, you can walk quite far out before it becomes deep. Very busy beach, to hire a sunbed with umbrella was 14 euro for day, even though we were only there 3 hours was same price!  Got fed up of the massage people coming round every 2-3 mins asking if you want a massage on your sunbed. Not a relaxing beach. Ideal for families though!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with sun beds and umbrellas could possibly be crowded in high season as there are only 3 rows of umbrellas. Beach is safe and shallow

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beautiful sea and sand great for castle building. Great beach front and facilities. Umbrellas and sun beds to rent at a cost.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, very touristy!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous clean beach, stunning crystal clear waters but if you’re off here to relax, think again!! If the lucky lucky man isn’t trying to sell you a beach blanket or a Rolex literally every 1 or 2 minutes then it’s melon man screaming his head off trying to sell you fruit! Why resorts/beaches, everywhere haven’t just banned the street sellers is beyond me!! Nobody wants to be pestered every couple of minutes when trying to relax!! Get rid of the above and this would be an amazing beach!! Millions of sun beds by the way, €13-15 per day!! No thanks!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A clean beach very good for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A thin strip of beach with free public toilets and beach loungers and umbrellas for hire Shallow water and not much difference between low and high tide

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lack of sun chairs & costly chairs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bech & water is nice but can get a bit crowded.Good beach for children & sand bottom.Not so deep either.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of our favourite beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been visiting this beach for past 10 years on and off and still one of our favourites !  nice shallow sea, lovely and sandy, good sunbeds and umbrellas and a good number of bars, cafes etc... nearby.  Still love the fruit/cocktail ladies/gents that travel up and down the beach selling fruit/cocktails !  Can't wait to visit again, never been disappointed !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but not the nicest I have experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but not the nicest beach I have experienced.   The bars along the way were nice though.  The sea etc looked very clean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beaches. Very safe for children   We would walk along this beach every morning the water is beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Easy access and you don't need to to flight for 10 hours to the Caribbean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Warm, shallow, cristallline waters with easy access to the beach. A few restaurants in different parts of the beach and sunbed and umbrellas for hiring.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hotel was located right next to the beach and the jetty for boat trips. The beach is gorgeous and water is crystal clear

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unbelievably beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've done a few stints on the parasol and beds for 13 Euros, which is a bit pricey but that's for the whole day-and we certainly didn't want to leave the whole day though as the beach is so stunning! One day it was so calm there wasn't a ripple to be seen in the whole Bay and one day it was soft lapping waves which lulled us to sleep when we were out on our Lilos. Either way the water was sublime, the right level of refreshing, transparent and calming. We were there towards the end of the high season so it never felt too busy. Every morning when we looked out at the glistening water twinkling in the sunlight we were taken back by how beautiful it was.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach, sunbeds with brollys and safe boxes €13.50 for two beds brolly and safe and €4.25 for extra beds, ideal for children's as the sea isn't very deep for a long way out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is exactly like the title! Awesome beach like all in the island, but is little crowded! Lots of people! Have better options aAround!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning beach! Comparable to those I’ve seen in the Caribbean. Really clean with golden sands and turquoise waters. Blissful. There are facilities nearby including toilets, supermarkets and rental facilities. You can rent deck chairs for around €14 per day for two (Sept 19 prices). I didn’t visit many other beaches in Majorca but this was spectacular enough.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach and stretches for miles. Walked along the beach to Alcudia and there’s plenty of water sports and bars. Would definitely recommend a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too commercial
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rent an umbrella with two sunbeds, rent a boat, have a massage.  Not much room left on the narrow strip of sand where you did not have to pay for something..  Which had debris piled on it after high winds and took a week to clear.  At least the sea was warm before the high winds, less so afterwards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long beach with beautiful white sand. Gentle sea lapping shore. Stretches to Alcudia marina and miles the other wah too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: safe beach loads of sand shallow water. Can either sit on the sand or hire a sun lounger  at a reasonable price which can include an umbrella and safe box.Also boat trip start and end here. Nearby toilets and eating establishments at reasonable prices.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful place.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, clean sand. Board walks to walk along above sea. Water is crystal clear and is very shallow.  There are a few bars, restaurants along the beach and there are shops not far away.  One of my favourite places, so peaceful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long stretch of sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice safe beach. Family friendly.Warm sea and shallow.Lots of sun beds.Very pretty background with all the mountains.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Familiar beach with amenities for all family. Clean and lovely warm water. Definitely must go and enjoy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach that is kept so clean and maintained fabulously. The water is so clear and warm. Beds available at a reasonable price with umbrella and safety box. Toilets on site and so many activities offered.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mura Magic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches I've been on. White sands, blue water that the kids can walk into. Beach Bar, toilets, showers and space, unless you wanted to be right at the waters edge of course. Fantastic for the family especially young kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach for adults or children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice long sandy beach, wery good for families with small children,. Sea isn”t deep here, waves are usually small, but if its there yellow flag its big fun for wave lovers. Its wery guiet and clean beach. Our family recomended to all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family friendly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovey beach with gorgeous sand and a very gently shelving entry to the water.  You coud walk out quite a distance so great for families with young children and adults who don't like to go in too deep! The shoreline walk from Port Alcudia to the S'Albufera National Park is lovely and there are plenty of places to stop and re-energise on the way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy beach, free, clean toilets, amazing  view.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was clean, free & clean wc, safe, great views,  bars, restaurants on place. Shops few meters away and not overpriced

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked along the beach at the waters edge to Port d'Alcudia and as far in the other direction as the S'Albufera Park.Lovely clean beach and a turquoise sea that you can walk out a long way to waist height, ideal for the youngsters. Great for a swim out to the buoys.Plenty of umbrellas and loungers, €13.50, bit pricey and becomes a racket when they tell you the safe must be taken and paid for on a Sunday?!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a lovely beach, white sand, crystal clear water and can walk out about 50 metres quite safely. Perfect for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beutiful clean and safe area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was clean and warm.  The beach was busy but not packed solid.  Beds available to rent at a cost but we just dropped a bag and went into the water for most of the time. the water was shallow out to a good distance making it safe for weaker swimmers.  In all, a really good beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water is shallow and warm which made it great for our 2 yr old to wade it. Very clean sand and lots of places to sit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach and Clear Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro beach is a 'Blue Flag' beach, and very well deserved. It can get quite busy but, even at the busiest times, there is still room to walk around.The beach is clean. The water is really clear. Fish can be seen swimming, sometimes really close to the shore.Muro is one or Mallorca's quieter resorts but there are lots of restaurants. The shops are mostly the same - selling ice-cream, beach toys and souvenirs with some selling clothing and jewellery.There are places along the beach where you can hire various boats, surf boards, and other equipment.Alcudia Sea Trips also has tours that pick up from the pier - we took the two hour trip on their glass bottomed 'submarine vision' boat.There are astonishing views across to other parts of the island.We also enjoyed a massage on the beach - good value and perfect with the sound of the sea as the background music.While in Muro, we spent a lot of time on the beach. My adult son and I splashed and swam in the shallow Mediterranean water while my younger son was happy sitting in the sand in between exploring all that Muro - and Mallorca in general - has to offer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lively beach. Water was so warm and although it was crowded it didn't feel uncomfortable.  Not many dining or drinks areas but beds and umbrella were good at €13.95 a day and safe deposit box for €1

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach, gorgeous turquoise sea, very clean and safe lovely sand good location.Good lifeguard station.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach i have ever seen. Sea is like bath water, shallow until far out so fab for kids. But Very busy on the sand with sunbathers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise and gold - Mallorcan delight
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long beach with clear azure sea and very soft golden sand. Shallow for quite a long way out, and the bay gives protection, so good for non-swimmers and children, although the waves can get choppy, especially if there is a stiff breeze. This blue flag beach (with the exception of the stretch at Can Picafort) is accesible from all hotels and side streets off the main M12 road and walkable for the majority of its length, except for the canal at Park Natural de s'Albufera where you must exit and cross a road bridge.All amenities available in high summer: toilets, lifeguard posts, beach-bars and water sports (mainly stand-up-paddling, kite-surfing and pedaloes and more of these the closer you get to Playa de Alcudia northwards with which it almost seamlessly merges.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great for families, toilets available, bars and snackbars within walking distance. Upgraded sunbeds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is gorgeous, water is warm and clear, and one can walk out for quite a distance. For those looking for activities, there are excursions, seadoos, parasailing, and parasol / beach furniture at a cost. The beach provides for a great family experience, therefore extremely recommended for this purpose.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Brilliant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and shallow sea. Went with family (young grandchildren too) and this was only 5 minutes from our villa. Clean, safe, great sand for castles etc. and warm shallow sea with a lifeguard. And a footwash! Just great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A perfect summer beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have been here for the last 6 years and it keeps me coming back. A litter free, clean and beautiful place to visit. The sea is crystal clear with fish swimming around you. In late July/ August when I visit, it is like a warm bath. Come here as part of your bucket list.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another sunny beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Today we went to another beach near Ca’n Picafort. The beaches here are very nice. Three rows of sun beds with a sunbrella. One lifeguard for a big stretch of the sea. Positive: near the dunes. But there are not a lot of beach cafes or restaurants to get some food and drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy beach but still beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is probably one of the niciest beaches in Mallorca, busy, but beautiful. Sometimes it gets grassy from the sea grass but white sand and turquoise water made it a must visit 😉

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach,  narrow but long and great for families with children as very shallow for a long way out! Lovely and clean sand and clear waters

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Total relax
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you have a car, try to move a few kms south east towards Can Picafort. This part of the beach is a little bit less crowded than the sectors in front ot the major hotels and you can enjoy as well its gorgeous waters !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s fun, family friendly and Sandy. But very very busy. You have to step over people. Pedalos to hire for 20 euros. A few jelly fish, but not swamped with them. This is a downmarket area and very brits abroad touristy unfortunately.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent 2 days down the beach while on holiday both days were lovely we rented two sun beds & brolly & safe-box for £13.75 for the day. Kids had an amazing time and loved they could swim out in the sea as is so shallow and warm.The beach has toilets which were clean. The sand is self was lovely and it was busy but you weren’t sat on top of each over as is a really long beach.Lifeguard on duty giving warnings flags if sea was unsafe to swim. Even telling you how high the sun UV was. Would definitely return

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous beach really nice and beautiful and clean you can also havea massage for a small charge.they also do glass bottom boats to go and see the sea life on the bottom of the sea.🙂

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty scenery and pretty busy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long stretch of golden sand and blue sea...You can walk along way out before you’re unable to touch the bottom. My younger children enjoyed this especially as it meant they could wade out and lilo back to sand!You need to get there earlier to get a sandbed. We got there around 11am and everything was taken. It’s 13.75€ for 2 sun-beds and a palm tree umbrella for the day. Some also have a small mini safe. We didn’t know this:If under the cost sticker there is another sticker with today’s date it means the sunbeds are occupied!There are public toilets and showers to use as you leave.No cafes or restaurants on the beach, but a few hotels back on and they do brunch/lunch deals. Approximately €20ppThere are plenty of ‘lookie lookie’ men selling bags, glasses, large cotton squares etcWe saw one ‘wheelbarrow lady’ selling fresh pineapple, mango, coconut, watermelon. We bought a quarter for a watermelon (which was massive) for 4€The taxi rank is by the big deckchair on the roundabout. Beware, you can’t flag a down and they won’t take you if you’re a bit wet!The area around the beach doesn’t have much to offer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, horrible area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Palma de muro is a very nice beach. The water and the view is amazing, the beach is very clean. HOWEVER, the area is horrible. There is no seafront walk, food choices are steak house, pizza or pasta. Extremely touristic. Overall, very disappointed with the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach I’ve been to!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning with it white sand & crystal clear water. I don’t usually swim in the sea but this was like a swimming pool! The water is very shallow quite a way out before it suddenly drops off and gets deeper. Really clean, lots of loungers with parasols €12 per day. Also lots of people wandering up and down selling fruit, blankets and ‘looky looky’ things, so take a bit of cash if this is your thing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Made our holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at one of the hotels on the beach and it made are holiday, the beach is perfect, clean especially. The sea was clear, gentle but with a slight sway and shallow. My daughter loved it and her friends who was on inflatables on there on in the sea as it was really shallow, there was also plenty of fish to see which was swimming near the shore. It is also manned by lifeguards, Would definitely recommend and return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand, warm shallow sea. I couldn't believe how far out we could walk and how warm it was. I didn't expect as much seaweed but such a nice beach overall

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing, the sand is clean there are enough sun  beds and umbrellas, which include a safe. (€13.75 for 2 beds, umbrella and safe)The sea is crystal clear and very shallow for a good distance, so ideal for children 4ish years and upwards. There are life guards, toilet facilities and wash facilities at the beach. There are the usual looky looky men and women wanting to give you a massage and braid your hair, but they soon disappear with a “no thank you”. The fruit seller is great and a nice treat in the heat of the day. Definitely give this beach a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lazy day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: TopBeach Great bars and restaurants Life guardsBeds to hire Lovely view Would recommend ponderosa beac

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing huge beach. Lots of space. Water is lovely, clear and clean. It's very shallow upto the end of the boardwalk. Lots of people selling watches, scarves etc. The Chinese lady that offers massages is amazing. 45 minute full body massage for 20 euros was a bargain. Highly recommend it. The paragliding was used by friends children, bit risky as one child felt she was not strapped in properly, no signing of risk or insurance either. So be aware. Lots of beds available at 10euros ish. Showers available too to wash away the sand and salt water. Handful of Shops nearby to buy snacks, drinks and icecream. By 6pm the little market stalls begin to set up their goods.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fab beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach,lots if beds for hire, usual guys selling items. We had 7 teens and ofcourse they wanted the watersports, so sad that the one on the beach were so rude and unhelpful, most watersports places I've been to are happy,helpful, they interact with kids ect these guys total opposite, so so rude. Spent a great deal of money and yet they were still misrable.Couldn't take go-pro on parasailing but of course you could buy there pictures. It would be worth walking along the beach a little further to the other company.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Summer holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de muro beach is fab, fine white sand. You can go out quite a long way in the sea before it is deep making it safe for children. Cafes and facilities in or close to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Summer holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely hotel very clean,  staff friendly, have to get up early to get a Sunbed around the pool. The pool doesn't open until 9 but people start to queue at 7 in the morning, hotel near the beach and the strip, the breakfast was good didn't have meals in the hotel so cannot comment on that. Your not allowed in your room until 3 no matter what time you get there. Would I stay there again yes definitely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro beach is without doubt one of the best beaches I have ever visited and is  strong competition for Carribbean beaches being much closer as well. The water is warm, clear and fairly shallow for a little way out as there is a submerged sandbar which makes it very safe for children and non swimmers. Being in the fairly sheltered bay of Alcudia, the water can be amazingly calm but waves and shallow rollers will appear when windy, At one end of the bay near the stone jetty there  is a wind surfing and sailing centre and body boards are popular when there are bigger waves.. The water is  picture postcard blue and the sand soft and almost white. The beach is very long so never seems really busy except in the peak season and most of the hotels are low rise and ergonomic in design so it doesn't appear built up thanks to the many trees and shrubs forming a barrier between the hotels and the beach. Plenty of sunbeds for hire on the beach as well and a popular pastime is walking along the shoreline. The beach isn't a wide one but neither is it narrow and on the plus side, the water its never far away. A boat stops at the wooden jetty from where trips can be made to Alcudia or Ca'an Picafort along the coast. We have visited Playa de Muro several times and it can't be beaten for a relaxing beach holiday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal blue waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand. Very clean. Shallow water for quite a while which is great for children and not so crowded as people spread. Great restaurants nearby. Nice views. Perfect for walking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caz
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach very clean and clear sea 1 of the best in Mallorca. Very picturesque for long walks.  Would recommend for a family day out

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clean beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Get there early otherwise your sitting on a towel the first few steps into the sea a re a bit rough shells and little stones seem to gather there but once you're past that its beautiful nice temperature of the water too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely shallow waters and sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent 4 mornings here as part of our recent holiday. Lovely beach and the sea was shallow for such a long way out and warm. Kids loved playing and swimming and fishing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely gorgeous beach with Caribbean like water. Shallow warm and transparent water for almost a mile out with gentle small waves. Plenty of water based activities available, fish to spot Whilst snorkelling .The beach is very busy but it’s also very long and we always found a spot to sit, it’s very picturesque

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach with lots of sun loungers to hire at an additional cost. Very family friendly too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were 12. The beach was quite busy. Water is clean but you need to walk in the sea for few dozen meters before having enough depth to swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clear shallow waters and very warm.  Like a large paddling pool.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach I've been to for years and only a 10 minute walk from the hotel.  No need for the shuttle bus which the hotel does provide.  Sunbeds available for hire with a little safety deposit box available if required.  Cost was average.  Little local lady sells fresh fruit on the beach with is a lovely touch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, bit overcrowded for my liking though!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shame there are no restaurants on the beach to have lunch at but the sea is sooooo clean and amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: fantastic Beach, with nice sand- some places crowded, but possible to walk a bit in there is hardly anyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy, shallow beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very clean and lots of space including sun beds and umbrellas even at peak times in peak season.The beach stretches a long way and is lovely sand.You can paddle out quite far and it’s not deep.There’s not so many waterfront restaurants and few water activities (eg Pedlo, jet bike, etc) but highly recommend it with small children (under 12?)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All I can say about this area is that mainly for young families. There few shops,restaurants not enough too be honest it is a quite area. Beaches are great. That's it too be honest

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach and seemingly safe for young children as it is quite shallow for a fair way out. You need to get there early to pick a spot as it gets full very quickly, we visited twice but only for a couple of hours as we aren’t big fans of crowded beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our first beach visit on this trip. Recommended to us, we struggled to park initially (mid morning!) but managed to get something eventually.Watched an amusing workout but a group of 40 or so people on the beach, swam for a bit, escaped buying anything from the local beach sellers with ‘authentic’ Rolex watches and Indian sheets/towels etc. All in all a nice morning at the beach, calm, warm, great views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very good beach with nice clean water. Good for kids with shallow water in between. Sometimes there are big waves. That’s fun for the bigger kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sandy beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro is a wonderful beach, with fine white sand and extremely transparent water. A bit too crowded for our taste...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful place, hot water, clean !!! This is the forth time we came black !! Pictures are better than words !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice beach with krystal clear water and lots of things to do. Quiet and family friendly and not noisy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beutiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro, an extensive sandy beach with crystal clear waters in the Bay of Alcudia. Not too crowded compared to other spots in Majorca

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazingly attractive! Perfect for children; sandy beach, warm water. Terr aren’t enough parasols though..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent 3 days here and it was wonderful! Clothing is optional so if you’re shy stay on the part of the beach closer to the hotels. That is where most of the families (and couples) with clothes are. I never sunburn, but I did here. So just make sure you pick up some sunscreen before you hit the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach amazing green & blue sea. Very clean and a lovely relaxed tranquil aptmosphere. Also close to Rei Del Meditrainia hotel. We loved it here.. and would definitely go again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Levelly beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach for the family to enjoy. The sea is clean and different very time you visit. You can walk for miles or head into the park.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice ,blue color of the water , clear.. the beach is clean ,has free showers as well as the toilets. It also has restaurants and shops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach. Pretty low until close to the end of the pier which means for smaller kids it’s not too scary venturing deep.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for family and kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with long Sandy stretches and shallow water for 100m+ There is a charge for sunbeds and Sun shades

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long Stretch of Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pick your hotel based on where you want to be on this long stretch of beach.  We stayed at Grupotel Los Principes & Spa which is located on the most photographed pier.  Great location, easy to catch a bus Port d'Acludia where most of the shops and restaurants are or Acludia old town, which is well worth a visit to this mazed streets inside a fortress walls; great boutique shops, local wine bars, restaurants and a whole lot of charm, would have liked to go back again, easy & cheap bus service in and out, really enjoyable.  We did the 5 hour Catamaran tour which I wouldn't recommend, way too overcrowded, check hotel or port for other better options, especially for 58 euro each.  Were told max 40 on Cat, must of been 150 on board, completely jam packed, tickets sold at pier.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: TUI Alcudia PINS resort looks right onto the beach. Very clean. Water clear and lots of tiny fish. easy access with a gate and pathway.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with turquoise splendid water! The water a bit cold in june, especiay for kids. The sea breeze is quite strong in this part of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I usually don't much like the beach, but I love this one. It's beautiful, clean, not too crowded and has good amenities such as showers, toilets and cafes. The shallow, turquoise water is perfect for families. There's no promenade here. This is presumably to allow several big hotels, like the Iberostar, direct access to the beach. It certainly is a selling point.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I would only say that you would need to Get there early for a sunbed. Beach is beautiful and plenty of activities to do down there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, near a number of restaurants, quite busy, available rentable sun-loungers with umbrellas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean in the Med
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach- clean with clear aquamarine water. Shallow and ideal for children, plenty of watersports if you are so inclined. Part of the national park and the water is crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most marvellous beach we have visited! Clean, white sand, shallow water. A lot of facilities nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, warm and safe beach.  Very busy but still room for everyone!  Lots of characters selling their wares, from wraps, to mojitos, and fruit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely blue water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is lovely, soft sand, blue water, waves. You can walk for miles if you fancy a walk. However the beach gets extremely busy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but to hot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was there with my family, very nice beach but the sea water not to clean and very little tree that you can hide or if you want to sit down for a while. There are many restaurants here which is very cheap and delicious that value your money. Pirate restaurant is one of the best restaurant here. So don’t miss this!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amaziiing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I will spend the whole winter thinking of this beach. Large sand, salty ocean, breezy cocktails. Time flew by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely long beach, Ideal for children!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely long beach, which I believe is ideal for young children! All to good clean sand!. not really for people who want to swim, as deeper water is a good way out. Life Guard on duty. Excellent!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in whole island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Mallorca several times already and this beach is by far the best beach in whole island. Shalow cristal clean water with soft sand. A lot of activities, stores and restorants along the beach. If you dont like crowd go to this beach closer to Can Picafort. There is a part of the beach where are no hotels and you can always find a spot for you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Big, clean and filled with activities. You can either rent umbrellas and sunbeds or seat on the free beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Beach, shallow water for quiet far in, clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only disappointment is the 'lucky lucky men' can ask more than once if you would like to buy anything.  Beach is lovely though and water is very clear and can see the fish in the shallow water too.  Sunbeds are available for hire with umbrellas

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal turquoise sea and soft white sand, fringed by palm trees. Safe, shallow water  and a very long and beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand and very gradual slope into the sea so very safe. Cafes and Bars near where you can look onto the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice small beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice small and clean beach. Great view.To less facilities for watersports and food and beverage.The most of the space is for people staying in hotels nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can walk from the port all the way to muro along the blue path. White soft sands very shallow for kids to swim in plenty of sunloungers to hire at 6.50 per day showers and wc on the beach also you have the use of all the beach bars for toilet. Beach very clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft clean sand and clear warm sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed in June this year, lovely resort, safe sandy beach which stays shallow for quite a  while, so clear you can see your feet!  Plenty of sunbeds with parasols if you want to rent or just lay on the sand. Activities include para sailing, jet ski etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fab sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach with great sand   Warm water that starts shallow and you can walk out into the sea  there are activities available such as pedalos, para gliding

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand & clear sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Caught the bus here from C’an Picafort, worth the trip as the beach is beautiful. Soft white sand and crystal clear sea. Gently sloped for small children. There is a supermarket and a few cafes near the main stretch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous hotel and resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My daughter and I stayed here for a week in June. This is a fabulous hotel with excellent staff, facilities and service. We had a beautiful room and a fantastic view of the pools, we were delighted with it. Our room was cleaned daily and towels replaced daily. The food at the hotel was also excellent with a wide variety on offer. The hotel runs a shuttle bus to and from the beach regularly every day, this is a great service and although it’s only a short walk to the beach we regularly used the bus. The beach is one of the nicest I’ve ever seen, water as clear as crystal and a beautiful sandy beach. We will definitely return to this hotel as soon as is possible for us, I couldn’t recommend it highly enough to anyone, it’s first class !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Very clean, sandy beach, water is crystal clear and despite being very popular never seems to get overcrowded. Shaded parasol type covers are available at €6.50 per bed - there are 2 per cover so €13 for the day. Obligatory sunglass and massage people do come around but don’t pester once you say no thank you.Activities such as Jet skis, windsurfing, banana boats and glass bottom boat are available on the beach.Local shops and eateries within walking distance, including a beach front cafe which sells coffees and hot snacks.A glorious beach and a stunning sunset. spend a few days on the beach with our children during g our holiday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach from Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wide and clean beach. You can walk long distance in the water before got deep water. Many activities possible but not cheap. Lifeguard every 500m

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best on the island, sand a plenty! Clean, large and waves with aqua blue water. Safe for children. A beautiful Mediterranean bay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing fine sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is perfect for families with young children because the beach was shallow. Water was clear and surroundings clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Fantastic views. Only down side is locals walking up and down trying to sell blankets-bags ect and they just keep on coming. I lost count of how many times I said no thank you. Other then that its a fab beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a quiet relaxing beach, there are no noisy motor sports, no bars and no cafe. It is just a good place to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After spending a week in the area, we had a few days at the beach.It is lovely, the size is Hugh and no problem finding a quiet spot.nice clean beach and the sea is crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach of Mallorca. Hands down
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Please stop looking, I've been coming to Mallorca over 15 years now and this is the best beach of the island. It's clean, (relatively) quiet, beautiful, sandy, blue seas and this is where all the locals go, miles of white beaches. We love coming here every year :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifull beach with a lot of sellers.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach is very nice, clean with  blue water. 🏝😍 but a lot of sellers and people who offer a massage are very annoyed.  Every 10 minutes there are 5 people who disturb my peace.  I don't think it's okay.. i don't like it !😫

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of sun umbrellas chargeable of course. The sea is just perfect for the little ones quite shallow ......there was even a guy going round the beach picking up cigarette stumps with a fishing net and we didn’t see anyone leaving any rubbish behind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful beach with clear blue water. Great views of the mountains both sides and Port Alcudia in the distance. Lots of nice restaurants, bars, cafes, shops etc in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very safe and sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Highly recommend this beach as it is very clean and safe for children and easily accessible.  Downside.... all the sellers continually coming along selling merchandise and especially the massage people, drives you mad, but suppose this is the norm at most resorts these days sadly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing clean beach with crystal clear waters ,my family didnt believe i was in spain .Beautiful and stunning

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazingly beautiful sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Thanks to the locals and the Beach Clean initiative the beach barely had any litter. You could literally walk 4 miles easily along the beach. Interesting inlets and piers along the way. Much better this year than 2 years ago when it was covered in fly invested seaweed. No sign of seaweed this year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous sea and sand. And seems really safe for paddling and bathing for children as it stays shallow for ages.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sands nice walk to alcudia or jump on the sea bus to alcudia port well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Around and about

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bustling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is such a beautiful long beach that I can see why so many people come here. This means that it is more attractive to those looking for liveliness than solitude. A little nippy in spring and the breeze can be cool - which is of course a delight in summer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited end of March beginning of April, a little too cool to swim - especially with the wind coming off the sea but no less a beautiful beach. Always better when not too busy and it was relatively quite when we visited. Can’t say what it’s like when it’s packed full of people though but definitely a great beach of Mallorca.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: good time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful colors!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ok for kids but not more, if you like long beach walks you will enjoy it, supermarket and cafè's along the way

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My relaxed break away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Needed a quiet break and that’s exactly what I got and how nice this place was too !! Will deffo return!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Word of warning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a magnificent beach and we have been to it several times.  No problem at all.  We even went on a fine day during our trip in October 2018 and enjoyed ourselves.However, on our last morning we decided to go back in spite of heavy rain and I went for a swim.  The water was utterly calm but there was a long reddish cloud in the water which stretched about a hundred metres.  Something told me not to swim through it, but I did go up to the edge of it to try and see what it was.  Unfortunately, proximity made me none the wiser.  Red algae, pollution from the nearby power station?  I don’t know, but the result when I got home was the red rash you see in the picture, and this in spite of using a beach shower just after swimming.  This rash took over three weeks to fade away.  It wasn’t particularly itchy but required a cream with hydrocortisone to master it.There was exceptionally heavy rainfall in Mallorca during that month and most of you are probably not going to go swimming in the rain anyway, but I thought it best to share this in case!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great family beach. You can go out pretty far as the water is not very deep. When the sea is calm, its crystal clear. Sun beds are available to rent and there are activities on the beach at various spots. The beach goes on for a couple of miles so it never tends to feel overcrowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cracking beach, long and sandy great for walks, safe. Lovely, coffee shops cafes scattered along the front.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach we've been in Mallorca. Cristal clean water, white sandy beach, warm and clear water with easy going into.Superb place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quite a vast beach, beautiful white sand, no debris, and shallow waters making it great for bathing and for families. Boat tours are good, we went on the one to Formentor which we would recommend. You can see the fish as water is crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good beach for children and adults. Low water and flat bottom without rocks and dangerous waves. Clear water and not debris. Long beach so the space is definitely for everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely soft sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely soft sand to walk down. Lots of sun loungers if you wanted to stay there all day. Beautiful views. Close to amenities. However, no wheelchair access, so if you’re disabled and want to walk or go along the beach, there is no prom or walkway running along the beach, for you to enjoy. I think putting a walkway along the back edge of the beach would make it perfect, as this would help pushchairs and less able people to enjoy such a wonderful stroll along a lovely beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach 🏖

Very clean and lovely white sands.There are sun beds to hire with umbrellas if you need shade.It wasn’t too busy when we visited so didn’t look overcrowded!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice sandy beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely soft sand!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long Clean Beach

The post of the parasol have small dates attached for your valuables should you want to goIn for a swim and are worried about your valuables. Loads of place to even just stick your towel down on the sand. Plenty stores and eating places but probably slightly higher priced due to location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely clear water, shallow great for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A bit too busy for my liking so didn't stay long, but went for a swim, the water is crystal clear, you could see lots of fish.There is a jetty for the boats to dock for trips.

We swam out a bit further and with goggles realised there were fish swimming with us so take your snorkeling equipment. We didn't use the loungers but apparently you have to pay. reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very flat beach with fine sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is flat, so that kids can be in the water with safety risk. The beach is quote long and if you walk some meters you will find enough space were it is not crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but can be very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Often walked this beach it is nice but can be so busy you have step over people. Generally it is clean & well maintained.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gentle entrance to the sea, very convenient for children. The beach is cleaned daily. Sun loungers are paid.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very long stretch of sandy beach, gorgeous water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Officially this beach runs from Alcudia to the end of Can Picafort, but unofficially the beach has been divided into different names along the way, to identify which part of the beach you're at.  The Playa de Muro part now runs after Can Picafort township towards Alcudia and this is an amazing part of the beach.  The water is gorgeous - a marine blue/green colour, light waves and soft sand.  Because most people choose the more popular Can Picafort part, when you're at Playa De Muro you'll find it's very quiet, lots of room and a quite isolated.  It's a perfect relaxing beach but has limited sun beds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of beach bars supermarkets nearby. Boats collect from pier out from beach and take you along coast... water us and glass bottomed boats.Still very warm end of September

reviewsWithKeywords.title: perfection and relaxation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach at playa de muro  is fantastic you have ammenities close by beach  restuarants the water is pretty shallow for kids up untill aboute 20 metres out there is also a pickup point for boats trips up and down the island well kept beach and gorgeous weather

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful long clean beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear blue sea

You can hire chairs+ umbrellas+ safety box for around 14 euros a day, or you can get each separate at different prices. It is a quiet and pleasant beach as there are no bars or restaurants on it. We really enjoyed our stay here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A proper sandy beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach

The €6.50 each per day for a lounger was a little steep for us, but there is still plenty of room for lounging on a towel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy beach. Clear water. Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro has a terrific beach. Lots of soft white sand. The beach is groomed every morning to smooth it and remove any seaweed that has washed ashore. The warm is warm and clear, and shallow for a great distance. You can walk out quite a way and still be only waist deep. The water is very calm in the morning; small gentle waves in the afternoon. You can walk for many kilometers on the beach, which is always a fun and relaxing this to do. The beach is in an inlet or bay and has great views surrounding it, including some small mountains. Lounges and shelters are available to rent on the beach. Beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach at Esperanza hotel is lush
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is combed every night, the water is warm, and has great clarity and colour. One of the best beaches I’ve been to. Lots of options for beds with security boxes available too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice water, large beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Golden sands and clear water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely beach which was always busy lifeguards on the ball , plenty for children to do along it and the water not too deep for the children

reviewsWithKeywords.title: gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely clear waters with a gentle incline , perfect for childrenGreat to have a lifeguard on duty too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice clean beach with showes ,toilets and life guard  en enough spots to eat a burger or a pizza en supermarket to buy cool drinks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely, clean, safe beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just spent 10 days here and loved the beach!  The water was warm and crystal clear - thankfully the jelly fish that had been bothering people had cleared off by the looks of things.  It's safe to swim, assuming there's a green flag, as there's a lifeguard on duty and the safe areas are clearly marked out.  We had a go at paddle boarding further along the beach (mixed ages too, 59, 54 and 14 year old son!)  Hired a board for 16 Euros for an hour, which the 3 of us shared - best laugh we had all holiday! - and yes, we did all manage to stay upright, eventually!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow what a nice beach amazing how clear the water is and how far you can walk into the see. I really like the size of the beach as this one has lots of space and you will not feel overwhelmed by the may people around you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sandy beach nice views of Menorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its nice white sand and clear blue shallow water is perfect for families, great sand for sand castles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best family beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear, pure sand, no rocks, so safe and user friendly. Sand beautiful. Lots of amenities and activities available. Lifeguard.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place, perfect for families.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long shallow beach that allows the children to play safely and grown ups to go far out. Crystal clear water, wonderful sand and lovely views. The beach feels safe both on and off the beach and the life guards is constantly monitoring all activity. I hope we will be back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have just returned from a lovely week and this beech was a highlight. Clean, clear and so shallow for such a long way out. Our 10 and 7 year old boys loved it, they could walk out such a long way and as such in August it didn't ever feel busy. We had so much space to play in the lovely warm water.  The fruit seller is hilarious and his fruit amazing, expensive but amazing as he cuts it up for you to eat there. It's just what you need when it's hot.Very highly recommend for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday.. watch out for the jellyfish!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is amazing, shallow clear waters for miles. Let down by the natural phenomenon that is jellyfish!! I’m frightened of them so didn’t go in the sea nearly as much as I’d have liked.. fab beach though with loungers shades and lifeguards. A pier with boat trips from and regular fruit and drink sellers along with the ‘lucky lucky men’ selling their wares... some great fakes to be had if you’re into that kind of thing. Enjoy, we did!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beach in Europe. Sandy beach, unique sea, relaxing atmosphere. Bed and umbrella are not always nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful  beach . A must see. Shallow water and lovely pier to walk . Sunbed for hire . Also walking down in the evening.  Beautiful at that time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach along the coast from Alcudia.  Sea incredibly warm this summer and very shallow so excellent for families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach here is great. Really clean, very sandy and lovely warm water. Definitely one of the best beaches I have been to in Majorica with plently of lifeguards and felt very safe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, fine sand, clear water. You can walk and walk and walk and still is very shallow, perfect for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have a 16 month old son, and knowing the beach was so good here was one our main reasons to return. Miles of golden sand, well maintained sun beds. The sea is very warm, and the waves always very small. So perfect for small children. You could go a long way into the sea and still only be up to your knees in water. A word of warning, during our stay this year there were quite a few jelly fish as you ventured further out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach but busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is amazing, but too busy during the main parts of the day. Come early or late if you like a bit more beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I love this place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love this beach. If your hotel is just around this place, you dont need to go anywhere else. There are lots of restaurants and supermarkets around the area, so you could just eat anywhere after a swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean and not too crowded. Only wish the sea was a little livelier but nothing to complain about. I will return

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: can really review it because didn't do very much because the water kept stinging my kids eyes the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach.White sand gorgeous warm sea.Fruit seller lady is a character!Look out for Jellyfish!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic clean beautiful beach, never too busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic clean beautiful clear blue sea and shallow for the little ones was never too busy and had lots of activities going on

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very long beach and clear sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Its really very long beach not less than 2km long , but a very good water and clean with an excellent view and relaxation.. also good for families and couples..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach, there is a shower and toilet block, sellers with fresh fruit, a masseuse, a water play park etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect for smaller kids, enough space for people between sunbed areas, a bit pricey 13,5 euros for two beds. Nice beachwalk all the way to port alcudia. Delivers, extra hords of people on weekends.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Up there with the Caribbean.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have visited plenty of beaches, including many in the Caribbean.... I must say this is one of the best. Very clean and looked after, golden sands and blur shallow water.We got situated at the back of the beach near a shady section and there was a spar in walking distance with plenty of choices of food and accessories.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, golden sand, shallow water not too rough.  Get there early as it does get busy.  Sunbeds 13.75 euros a day.  Peddlows available.  Boat trips great value

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brilliant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is clean. Has toilets all the way. Brilliant for couples and families. The sea is beautiful for everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous long beach, lovely white soft sand. It was pretty clean and I didn’t see that much rubbish left at all. The sea is beautiful with it being quite shallow for quite a distance out which gives it the feeling that it’s not too crowded in the sea. Watch out for the odd jellyfish. The beach does get quite busy. You are charged around £14 euros for use of 2 sunbeds, a parasol and safe. There are quite a few of the guys coming round offering all kinds of goods for sale but it’s the constant question of “massage?” Which gets irritating after a while. Listen out for the guy selling fruit (really fresh and tasty fruit) and the lady selling cocktails...you can’t miss them really with their distinctive calls.
