reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach, but not impressed with HomeAway
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The 1 star is for HomeAway with whom we booked our holiday.  The beach is a 5 star beach.  BUT we love Majorca and have in the past  booked many happy holidays with Owners Direct in Majorca and in various countries and would not use any other company. Then they became HomeWay and we had to deal with a management company, 5starshome. Our villa (Villa Valeta  in Muro) was in a great location very close to a fabulous beach, but the villa was disappointing.  The kitchen was stocked with what appeared to be items from a jumble sale.  There were a total of three mugs and bowls and about 60 plates of varying sizes and designs.  No proper knives, only steak knives, and no bread knife. And we were told by the cleaners upon arrival that  WE DON'T PROVIDE BEACH TOWELS!The crack in the bathroom sink - there upon arrival- was not repaired whilst we were there. We reported very loose electrical socket situated immediately next to a tap in the bathroom - a real health and safety issue.  Repeated promises to fix were broken until after several days of phoning to chase, and having 5starshome staff raise their voices to me, and on one occasion slam the phone down on me, it was fixed with super glue  (we think by the cleaner's husband who said he was NOT an electrician, but very kind and keen to help.) There was no air con in the living areas which became horribly hot, humid and stuffy. The shutters all around the property were not well maintained and some stuck completely so we were unable to open or close them.  We did not bother to report as dealing with the company was too stressful.We were asked to submit a review by 5starshome , but it has not been published....We would return to the location in a heartbeat but will not use HomeAway or 5starshome Home again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for small children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went to Playa de Muro Beach looking for a calm beach with fine sand for my 2 year old to play.This beach is really perfect for this.It has nice fine sand, calm sea, life guards and umbrellas rental.There are no restaurants on the beach, but you will find many options to eat (restaurants and markets) 1 block away.If you want to rent an umbrella (& lounges) I recommend going to the beach early in order to do so. The umbrella will be reserved for you the entire day, so you can go back to your hotel and return later.There is also a safe on the umbrella! So dont be afraid of leaving your values while you go for a swim.The sea is clean and very calm.You will see small fishes swimming around your feet.Just wonderfull!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing family beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this beach twice on our recent trip to Mallorca. The sand is fine, the beach is clean and extremely long and the water clear and shallow. It was literally perfect for our family with two children aged 6 and 8. On both occasions we drove down the Ma-12 and parked just past the Hotel Iberostar where parking was free. This stretch of beach seems to be slightly less crowded as there aren't the cluster of hotels backing the beach, although as a result there aren't sunbeds to hire. Bring a beach umbrella instead and lay on the sand!If there was one downside, there was a faint smell of sewage on the first day that crept in about an hour after our arrival. Not sure the cause or how long it lasted as we left. The smell was completely absent on our second visit. I believe you would be hard pressed to find a beach more suitable for kids to swim in the sea. Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aggressive peddlers ruin an amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most gorgeous beaches I have ever been to, and we usually vacation in Mexico or Thailand, so that is saying a lot. Soft sand, turquoise water, gentle waves, and shallow clear waters perfect for wading in. Unfortunately, as we were trying to relax on our towels and play with our kids, peddlers kept walking right between our towels and toys and tried to sell us cheap crap like knock off purses and sunglasses. Like every other minute! Our 6 year old politely said “No thank you” every time, but when the same people keep passing you by repeatedly, it gets annoying. By the 20th time, my husband had had it and told the guy selling a pile of scarves on his head to leave us alone. The guy completely lost it, set his stuff down and came at my husband aggressively and kept saying “I f*** your mother”. He caused a big scene on the beach over nothing , with everyone around us staring, and terrified our 2 young kids. He wouldn’t stop dropping the F-bomb and would not leave us alone, so we had to pack up and leave an hour after getting there, and ruining our last day in the area. The sheer volume of peddlers makes returning to this beach a turn off, and make sure you don’t piss any of them off!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long beach, not too crowded and you can walk for long promenades ! Really nice. There is a promenade where parents can walk with pushchairs. Really easy for everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beachside stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in Muro for 5 days in March. Be aware that this is off-season so majority of places will be closed. There is also not much to do if you don't drive or choose not to use local transport. The beach was  5 minute walk from our hotel, and although the first few days were chilly, walks here became a regular thing. One of the good things about it being off-season was that it was pretty much empty so there weren't hoards of people trying to catch the sun. The water is beautifully clear although somewhat murky where the seaweed comes in, but that's just nature for you. There were also tractors picking up mountains of seaweed, most likely clearing it up for the summer tourists. Nice walk and if you choose to, can take you all the way to Alcudia.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove to this beach and wow it’s like a hidden gem, glad we found this quiet relaxing beach, noticed there was only 1 place to eat but didn’t care as we enjoyed the beautiful water and sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand and a blue water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beat the crowds

Its quite funny to see people fighting for space when only a short walk away there's a beach that's empty by comparison.A walk to the end of the pier is a must to see the fish that get bigger as you walk out further. Bring a slice or 2 of bread and watch the mad frenzy.The water temp in late October is still quite warm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful crystal clear waters! Recommend a walk along the pier! Stunning! Best beach I have ever been to in my life.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, kept clean and we went in May so wasn't too busy. There was plenty of restaurants and shops nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just a dream .. was bit windy but we went on late October.. so beautiful..we walk through.. The best beach I have ever seen xxx

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Playa de Muro, Majorca, Spain
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Another excellent Majorcan  beach. We left our gorgeous Alcudia bay to jump the waves late Oct. at Muro beach.  Recommended by locals. Reassuring attentive lifeguards in attendance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de Muro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, clean and tidy, plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas.  Nearby bars and restaurants.  Easy to get to on the local bus.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for kids. Very safe sea which is shallow for a long way out. Only problem is all the illegal sellers on beach who don't leave you alone!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely October half term holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de muro was perfect for an October half term break. Located between alcudia and can picafort both are a short bus journey and make great day trips. Plenty of restaurants are still open and no crowds, warm weather and a calm sea. The inflatable fun park was ideal for my children (aged 6 & 3), As was Dakota restaurant with its bouncy castle and the lovely swan pub for a British meal and cocktails which was really reasonably priced. Fun time and definitely will be returning!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice lovely beach, the best in the NorthClean no cig butts in the sand ! Nice beds was 22.25€ for 4 beds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited on a cold and blustery day and even then the beach is a lovely space and would be wonderful on a sunny day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived to beach around 6pm, the sand is white and beach looks really nice. It might be different in high season and during "frequent" hours

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely white sand and beautiful views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: a stunning  beach with lovely views out towards Minorca. White sand and stunning blue gteen clear sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sandy beach,safe swimming - with life guards and miles of walks.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is warm by September after the Summer sun and safe for children and not so confident swimmers as it does not get deep for about 25 metres out. The beach seems to have life guards situated in towers every 1000 metres or so. Sun beds + parasol can be expensive to hire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fairly typical Med beach, not too busy in October.  We just walked along the shore for a bit didn't sunbathe or swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked here from the hotel. It was full of people. We loved it. We went for a swim. It was nice and warm. Definitely refreshing. People were enjoying themselves. There was some water activities going on as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Totally beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Totally beautiful beach , lovely blue and very clean . If you can watch the sunrise and the sunset it's beautiful xx

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice for kids as it's quite shallow. Great sand and very view with the mountains in the background. (of course) a bit crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach views...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic views! Surrounded by a mountainous scene, the clear blue waters and golden sand serves as a great break from hotel pool life. The down side is that the beach as lovely as it is, is very small and can possible be considered over crowded. Close to local restaurants that serve great food I would recommend at least one visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, shallow water, great for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sandy bay stretching from Alcudia to Can Picafort. Various areas offering loungers, parasols, etc at different costs. We went paddle boarding on the stretch of beach just before the canal. Exits from the beach all offer free showers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shallow and safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great beach for small children. Not deep for a while so children played safely and loved jumping the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Safe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very long beach and a safe ocean to enjoy. Lots of bars and restaurants located at the beach so you are spoilt for choice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice wide sandy beach, good for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice wide sandy beach stretching far out into the water, so the kids could wade out quite a way.  The main downside was that it was really crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very popular beach - hence pretty crowded. Still nice to hang out for the day and people watch. Clean shallow water and lifeguards on watch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very Clean sandy beach with sun beds and parasols. A couple of bars for food and drinks. A fair few pedlars on the beach who will continue to ask for sales but they are polite and leave you to it. The sea is very shallow and clear for quite a way out with very gentle waves and it’s a pleasant respite from the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, nice little family friendly resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed towards the end of the season. Beautiful long white beach with lifeguard cover and shallow waters. Ideal for families and those wanting a quieter relaxing break. Some good eateries and shopping too. Great bus links to Alcudia, Inca, Pollenca and Palma as well as a local taxi service. We loved it and will return. Very close to a nature reserve so would recommend you a prepared with mosquito repellents, they can be a bit bitey in the evenings :-).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: the best of mallorca I think
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very large and nice sand, slowly going down in the water, good survey services - this must be one of the best playas of the hole isle .  One negative point could be that many people knows that and it could be very crowded during high season

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very nice uncrowded beach with lovley fine sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: small in width but long and really nice soft sand...claer blue sea a pleasent evening walk or sit in the sun,,,nice little beach terraces infrequently along too....not spoilt at all..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sandy beach with clear blue sea. Close to amenities and good quality sunbed, shades and safes with friendly beach staff. €13.75 For 2 all day. Toilets were free and fairly clean but often without paper and soap. Only drawback is lots of masseurs and sellers all day. It does get a bit too much when you're trying to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovey beach. Plenty of bars and restaurants. Lots of shops nearby for food and souvenirs. Friendly atmosphere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach to visit. Next to some bars and resturaunts. I think we paid €13 for two sunbeds for the whole day, lots of people trying to sell you rip off sunglasses/bags act though. There's a lady who comes round selling fresh fruit. Later on in the day she came back selling cocktails! Brilliant

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, if a bit busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful and water relatively shallow and crystal clear. It was pretty busy even at the end of September.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with sunbeds or area to just to lay on sand. Public toilets and shower on the beach. Shops and cafes nearby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long long beach and quite calm in October. Really peacefull place with a forest nearby. Recommend to stay there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ok but there are better beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fine but not very sheltered there was always a breeze. For snorkeling and I recommend Cala Moullins about a 40 min drive

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but avoid it in high season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice, warm, transparent water. Beautiful views. Completely crowded in August (It took 1 hour to park the car nearby and another 30-40 minutes to queue for lunch).Some of the umbrellas are "reserved" for the whole season, and I wonder why the local authorities allow this practice. It's nice to have a security box paying 1 euro more.avoid it in August

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun burnt
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent 2 days down on the beach with our rubber rings. Lovely crystal clear water and nice and warm. Water melon man was so funny srlling his fresh fruits.€12.75 for 2 sunbeds and umbrella for the day was very good also safe box €1.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's easy to stay near this beach at reasonable price. Good food all around  I didn't swim but many did sand is nice good for families

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach for children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice beach to spend some time with your children. Shallow water with perfect temperature. Don’t forget to try the pedal boats when you’re here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach shallow clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach well kept with lifeguard stations and toilets / cafes suitable for families not sure about disabled access though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach, plenty of activities. Good, safe swimming with plenty of lifeguards. Sunbeds on the expensive side, but just about enough open beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 4th year
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach, annoying people trying to sell glasses etc all the time..... remove these and would be heaven!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This a wonderful 7km beach. Very clean with public toilets and shops close by. Lots of wooded areas further up the beach for shade. The sea was very warm in early Oct. There was a small jetty where day trip boats come and go in the morning and back in the afternoon.This a fantastic beach for families and those who like a nice walk along the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It was a beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Clean enough. Was not overcrowded, nor was there any litter to speak of. Very nice shallow water. And it the sea CAN be very calm (despite what cretins in the one-star section might claim) if the wind is coming from the right direction, or if there is little-to-no wind at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with beautiful clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach had light yellow sand and beautiful clear water. It is fairly shallow for around 50 metres so it is good for children and paddling out. On a hot day it is very busy due to all the surrounding hotels. A half an hour still from Alcudia Port down the Playa de Muro Beach just before dusk / sunset was very beautiful and highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the best "hotel+sandy beach" locations on Mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, it is ok if you stay in a hotel there, but not worth a trip from other locations, the hotels located further south from Alcudia and better since the beach does not get so busy, nice chairs, umbrellas and even a safe available for a reasonable fee up to 20 euro per day (2 chairs, umbrella, safe box)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean although crowded.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a few hours on the beach out of the seven days we spent at Playa de Muro. That was enough. Although the beach was clean and the water warm it was too crowded for us, and this was after the schools were back in the UK. God knows what it's like in the peak season ! The area of Playa de Muro was nice and friendly but very Blackpooly .We hired a car for five days to see the islands coves and hidden ports and beaches, sadly we won't be returning due to the anti-tourist demonstrations and the anti-tourist graffiti written on the roads up the mountains. Never bite the hand that feeds you !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: overcrowded, not clean water. tiny beach, long but only 10-20 m wide. Playa de Alcudia is much better, and in Palma as well and other small beaches in this Island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, beach, great views. Lovely atmosphere with lots of shops around it.  Would definitely recommend going there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: clear water,, nice sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice clear water, white sand,  sea is not deap... wonderful for children....the only problem,, there are some people offering massages

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A little too many "lookey lookies" on the prowl offering everything from melon and margueritas to sunglasses and massages.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean with lots of sun beds and sea shallow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We liked this beach as it was clean with lots of sun beds or you could just sit on the sands and it was close to bars etc

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely area, very clean, gorgoeus beaches and friendly people.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the JS alcudimar hotel, great hotel, great area, hired a car to explore other beaches, Muro beach is clean and water is safe and clear, just beautiful. Pollensa a beautiful beach with lovely promenade and little cafes/restaurants. Toured the mountains, well worth the steep 'edges' Would definatley visit this area again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach stunning sea... there was a great water park in the sea but was too expensive in my opinion from other ones

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean with clear and shallow waters. You will have to pay for sunbeds & umbrellas if you want to use them - around 10 Euro p/day. Toilet and cafe facilities. Nice long beach to walk along.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: most beautiful beach i see in my life
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice , beautiful and quiet beach .perrfect to go and have fun with family and children .not dangerous and safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved it .beautiful clean beach the sea was perfect not many shells or seaweed, the beach workers were great especially the fruit man and cocktail lady, sunbeds were pricey 14 euros for. Beds and a brolly with a safe for valuables. Always managed to get a bed , toilets and shower facilities also. Lovely place. One thing id go back for.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice place to go for a few hours. There is always a little space to lay & a massage table with shops and bars close by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not that great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a walk from the hotel to the beach and I must say we have seen better, the beach was very crowded, the loungers were chained to the umbrellas so it looks like they don't trust persons, narrow beach sorry but not somewhere we would pay to lounge in

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an amazing beach with beautiful sand and sea. There are a lot of people visiting this beach, but it is worth the crowd to take a dip in this entrancing blue sea!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is kept very clean, sea absolutely lovely. I'm not a beach or sea person but spent 3 wonderful days on the beach. Lady comes around selling pineapple, coconut and melon. Very reasonable price and very tasty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach and beautiful clear water . Plenty of restaurants nearby and toilets and shower .you have to pay for sun beds etc but worth the charge I think .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach - but VERY busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach is a white sandy expanse of shoreline that stretches as far as the eye can see. In high summer, the water is beautifully warm and it's pretty shallow, so good for children and unconfident swimmers. However that does mean that the beach is PACKED. It's very noisy and has lots of sun loungers to rent. Trying to find a quiet spot away from the crowds is a bit futile. However, given how many people are on the beach it is incredibly clean. There are public showers and recycling points along the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, sandy, perfect for children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice, long, sandy beach with plenty of sun-chairs but also place to put the blanket down. Access to the water even and gentle, for good 70m shallow enough to stand even with big waves. Very clean. The only minus is lack of classical chiringuitos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Greta
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach, beautiful and warm sea. Stunning. Sun beds are available and boats for the kids, you can actually walk right along the coast.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: what a lovely beach golden sand and clear waters cant go wrong. loads of families and couples enjoying the sun. if you see the mango lady selling fruit it will make your day haha shes amazing. loads of lucky lucky men selling crap tho which does ur heading all in all lovely place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, clear water, fine light sand, but overcrowded in the season. Beach is very long and you have possibility to go out of resort to free nature for several minutes and you reach nice quiet part of beach with a cup of poeple and still nice sea. There is no bar, nor noise, no music, no childers, simply you and sea and wind noice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is long and shallow, perfect for children. Crowded when we visited in September, but you can always find a spot. The downside was that there was some garbage in the water (plastics and so on).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely sandy beach with boat trips available and good snorkeling to see small fish.Beach is kept clean and plenty of sunbeds if you want to pay for them

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BUSY BUSY BUSY
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We read about this beach on a 'secret beaches' list so drove across the island to get to it. Just a tip - it is far from secret! It's the busiest beach around. When we pulled up in the nearly-full car park with fly-tipping everywhere, I knew something was up. A little walk through a pretty national park along a lovely wooden walkway reassured me. Then we descended onto the ten-foot strip on sand with 200,000 Russians on it, all fighting it out to have the biggest beer belly with the tightest budgie smugglers. I've attached a few pictures to give a realistic impression. One of the pics shows that the actual sea is really nice, and would be paradise if Yuri and Vladlina not been almost lying on top of me.We bailed after a few hours and drove to another place. If you are staying in the nearby towns, this would be a nice enough beach to have on your doorstep, but don't travel too far because your own local beach is bound to be better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and shallow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Came to this beach a few times! Lovely, clean and shallow waters...lots of fish swimming too! Even on an overcast day its lovely to visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean and plenty of paid sun beds with lockers with some  of them very shallow water so safe for all ages

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice and clean beach. Arrive before 10 am to have first row sunbeds. Water is not deep so it is suitable for small children. In the afternoon waves are bigger, but very funny.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Put quite simply. This is probably one of the best beaches I have ever been to. Soft golden sand, the sea is like being in a bath and the view is rather good too. It's so safe for kids because the sea is shallow. So even the youngest can have a dip. You also get the fruit man with his wheelbarrow full of fruit that comes round about 2-3 times a day selling pineapples, melon, coconut, mangoes and bananas. All freshly cut infront of you as so juicy and tasty. In the afternoon a lady walks round with a wheel barrow selling a cocktails. Further down the beach there's an inflatable assault course for anyone to do as long as you can swim out to it. There's also a boat that tows  an inflatable banana and an inflatable arm chair. Plus another boat the does parasailing. There are boats that come and go from the pier all day long for trips out to sea. Behind the beach there's a square that has a few restaurants,  a supermarket and a couple of bars. Most nights the square has a market on. Which is ok.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very quiet and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most wanted and beautiful beach.  Very clean, friendly and close to everything.  Umbrellas available for around €12 with two beds. Good food around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach I've ever been to.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Sunbed, umbrella and safe hire is around 15 euros but is worth it. The sea is very clear, warm and shallow although does go deep in some parts and then shallow again. There is a blow up obstacle course in the sea you can swim too also. 'Looky looky' men are around and do offer you watches and sunglasses etc but you just have to be polite and firm and they leave you alone. There is also a hilarious guy selling fresh fruit out of a wheelbarrow, his sales pitch is hilarious. I'm not sure if it's a chant or a song but it works and I bought a huge slice of watermelon and 3 bananas for 5 euro. There is also a lady who has the same sales pitch selling cocktails. It's hilarious to watch. Take a walk along the pier and watch the fish!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: wonderful beach with several sand banks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: excellent beach with warm and clear water where one could stay the whole day.not a lot of space to lay a towel between the chairs for rent and the water though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most exciting thing in Boring Playa De Muro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa De Muro is possibly the most boring place on the planet, unless of course you just want to lie on the beach for your entire holiday, in which case it is perfect for you, as the beach is absolutely beautiful. But don't expect to leave the beach after sunning yourself all day and find any sort of night life / entertainment, other than what your hotel provides. When we booked our two weeks holiday we were told that there is plenty to do in and around Playa De Muro, well that simply isn't true. There are some good restaurants, serving really good food, but very little atmosphere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach and crystal clear blue water. €12 for the day for 2 loungers and parasol. €1 for safe for valubles. Only downside is constant flow of men trying to sell you stuff such as, watches, sunglasses ect. Was hard to relax with them keep asking you everytime they pass and it got very annoying. Lovely Spanish lady selling gorgeous fruit however!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely blue sea sandy beachs lots of sunbeds pay for the umbrellas.. choice to go on jet skis paragliding.. you can walk far out to sea.. and still swim

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unbelievable crystal clear water , the stretch of the beach is so long and is so clean.Really worth a swim as the water stays really shallow before going really deep in the distance but you can walk out so far best beach in Majorca

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach clear sea soft sand. Goods sun beds umbrellas and safe box is needed all at a cost.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous local beach clean with excellent facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had a lovely day here next to the pier , kept the kiddies entertained looking and feeding up the fishes , nice and shallow except for the end where the boats docks for day trippers ! Toilet facilities good no problems with looky looky men, stay away from the fruit sellers they are unlicensed! Will return again another year, clean clear water and a view across the bay to the mountains, what's not to like!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Approx 7km of fine sandy beach with crystal clear water . very shallow so great for kids. Plenty of sunloungers to hire as well as watersports .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: relatively quiet beach considering peak season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean,gently shelving narrow beach, safe for children although slightly tidal. quite a hike along the beach especially with 2 kiddies buggies.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach is great for a run, loads of cycle hire places
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Light clean sand with crystal clear waters ....great for a beach holiday .Hired a BMC Grandfondo from the shop up the road. The bike was top quality, cycling is amazing, with mountains, flats, hills and compliant traffic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favourite beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro beach in our opinion is just amazing. This was our fourth year here and we still love it. The beach is clean and family friendly. The sea is blue and shallow so the kids are safe playing out on their inflatables, riding the waves. A huge inflatable in the sea for adults and kids alike and the usual pedalos etc for hire. Plenty of beach bars for refreshments. We walked along the beach to Can Picafort and accidentally discovered the nudist beach (kids thought it was hilarious!) so be aware if you intend walking this route. We will most likely be back again near year 😀

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there for a week, a sandy nice beach however in most days there was lots of woody stuff in the shoreline which made it difficult to enjoy it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brilliant, very nice sea.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was very relaxing, offering sunbeds, they are usually taken though. The sand wasn't very hot either, which was very good. People do come around with sunglasses, watches, beach towels and offering hair braids etc. The sea wasn't cold at all, it was quite warm. And so shallow! You could definitely walk 90 metres into the sea and still be up to your knees. My three year old sister could go in the ocean on her own, being safe. Although I did keep a very close eye on her and rarely let her alone. There are shops nearby, selling lilos, water, fruit, lollys and all the things to supply you for the beach. I recommend very much coming to this beach if you're stopping in Playa de Muro or alcudia! :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very busy but very clean. Close too several cafes etc for a refreshment when it gets too hot. Many families there with small children so I assume it can be considered safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice sand. Sea is very shallow so it is suitable even for little babies. Also it is very warm. But during the waves there can be too much water plants on a sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: good for us as we wanted long walks so we did it every day, good for children as is not so deep sand, sun, fun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great spot to relax while in Majorca if you are traveling with kids. White sands, long beach and a lovely pier. There are . restaurants along the way and some voleyball courts. Its a bit far away from the alcudia center but the beach is definitely better

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plenty to do
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are loads of water activities available including Banana Boats, giant inflatable, paragliding. Two sunbeds with a parasol and lock box was 14euro for the day and well worth it just for the security. There were beach hotels where you could get lunch or a Spar if you wanted to make your own. The Banana boats were 10 euro pp and great fun. The beach was clean and you waded out a fair distance before the water got deep do safe fro little ones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The hotel was right on the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea was warmer than the pool very safe for young children beautiful sandy beach if you wanted you can rent sunbeds and an umbrella

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect sandy gently sloping beach.  Ideal for little ones.  Loads of sun beds.  Very clean.  Nice walk out on a small jetty for photo opportunities!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely safe beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely sandy beach that is clean and well maintained. The sunbeds and parasols are very reasonable to rent for the day and can include a safe which was a great idea for when the whole family went in the sea. There is a huge inflatable activity structure that any age can use for 12€ an hour . Fruit and cocktails are offered occasionally during the day and are  good value. There was quite a few sellers ( we call them looky, looky men ) on he beach but they were always polite and never became a nuisance . Massage and windsurfing was also available as were boat trips from the pier.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach around this area is lovely for young children as it doesnt get deep for quiteif you go one stop or several stops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is beautiful but would be really busy in the height of summer. The only problem is the pestering salesman/women. No I don't need sunglasses/sarong/watches/bracelets or even a massage. Don't sit near the trees on the beach that's where the accumulate and talk very loudly to each other all the time. Apart from that it was great. Close to supermarkets for drinks and snacks and we also bought cheap sun umbrellas and left them in the hotel at the end of our stay. And close to restaurants for the lunchtime litre of Sangria. Wonderful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely, swimming with the fish
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, not overly commercialised but still get everything you need. Clear warm water and loads of fish to swim with. Our kids loved this. Just take some googles (our buy them at the beach)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shallow a distance, fish & fruit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is shallow for quite a way out allowing space for all to play. There are fruit sellors walking along who are great for a refreshment. Beds are pricey, nearly €15 for 2beds and an umbrella but you don't need them tbh. Enjoy!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach for children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Alcudia area beach is very nice, if you have children.The depth increased quite slowly, so you can let the children play without holding hands all the time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach with soft white sand and lots of possibilities for water activities. Not too overcrowded. Sunbeds available for hire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safe beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good for swimming, sunbathing or boat trips. Lifeguards on duty. Clean sand. Closest to our hotel. Recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach. Not many free sun loungers but we were fine with beach towels. Bit windy at times, but that's fine when it's really hot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A truly beautiful beach, with white clean sand and turquoise water.  The water is warm and clean and is shallow and great for smaller children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach great for kids and safe sea swimming. Would definitely recommend a visit. Lots of fun with water sports as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach terrible facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited the  Beach last week four or five times. We rented 2 sun beds  for about €13 for the whole day. It was close to the sea which was really warm and perfect for swimming with younger children as it is quite shallow. Apart from the constant barrage of people trying to sell hats watches sunglasses fruit  every two minutes we found the beach to be quite pleasant and although busy we still had  plenty of room for the children to play.  However the main drawback of the beach has to be the horrendous toilets. Our hotel is quite a walk away and with three young children we relied on the toilet, but  were unable to use them on several occasions because they were so filthy to the point were people were retching as they left. There was excrement plastered all over the toilet and walls and floor. It is the dirtiest toilet I've ever seen and was in pretty much the same state every time we try to visit. We ended up eating  or buying drinks from nearby restaurants so we could use the toilet facilities. Such a shame to what would've been a decent beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach looks like paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, the colours are amazing, very clean and family friendly. The temperature of the water was great. Next holiday will be here again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a fantastic family holiday here, beautiful clean, air conditioned bungalow, lovely swimming pools our 2 grandchildren adored and best of all amazing food in the restaurant with very friendly, helpful restaurant staff who couldn't do enough for us, especially Jose, Marga and Kinga, it was one of our granddaughters birthday while we were on holiday and they laid a special table for us, it was so thoughtful, thank you again to all the staff, can't wait to come back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really clean with perfect sands and blue waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the perfect beach. No stones, seaweed, crabs or anything to hurt your feet. Perfect for kids and shallow for a good distance out. The water is so warm and very salty. Clean toilets and showers all along the beach. Sun loungers to rent. Be sure to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice relaxing beach. Very appropriate for children. Services easily available. Amazing colours. Walking on that beach has been one of the best experiences of my holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach, could spend all day there. Plenty of space although a very busy beach. Shops nearby selling everything you need.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft sand, gentle slopping waters, plenty of sunbeds and brollys (with a  beach safe €13.75) for the day. Good value. Plus the royal beach bar /restaraunt for a lovely lunch or drinks. A few hawkers and masseuses but they don't nag you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fab beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Would rival Mexico and more tropical places. Beautiful beach with loads of activities on offer. Loved it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: But very busy! Sun beds get booked up and taken quickly. Booking in the section we went to towards alcudia is minimum of 4 days and then 4 day booking increments. €5.25-€6.50 per bed per day and safety box is about €1 a day. The blue ones look less classy but far more comfortable!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sandy beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely clean beach with lots of sunbeds and umbrellas for hire, with safes.  Kids loved it here.  Local supermarket and man selling fruit on the beach are good for lunch/snacks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A place to rest
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, wide and sandy beach which offers a variety of water sports, both for kids and for adults. You will pay for a beach chair i euro per day. It is a calm place where you do not find many clubs. Plenty of hotels, restaurants and street shops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with fresh wind and some waves. It's possible to rent umbrellas and sun beds. The only problem regards theshower, few and distant from the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very busy but so clean and the water is shallow and warm. The waves gave us hours of entertainment. Loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pleasant beach with plenty of room
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is part of the long sweep of beach between Alcudia and Can Picafort on the north of the island of Majorca. Clean, pleasant beach and sea, with watersports available and other services like restaurants, fruit vendors, shades and massage. Boat trips available around towards Formentor and Pollensa. Very pleasant place to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach. It was very busy but the sea was lovely and warm and shallow and a nice way to spend time away from the pool.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great clean and safe beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We really enjoyed going to the beach it was very clean and safe as the sea was shallow a long way out meaning the children were safe while swimming alone and it was very warm. The  beach did get very busy so it was hard to get a sunbed sometimes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach was stunning. It was very clean and kept well - with calm and warm water it was perfect for swimming and relaxing.The area of the beach we visited also had an inflatable play area in the sea, and other water activities available, such as Jet Skiing, Boat Trips etc. There were plenty of sun loungers with sun shades, in which you would have to pay per day to use.Overall, we really enjoyed this beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: long sandy beach with blue water. great for families although quite large waves when the wind picks up.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice sand and view over the mountain, water perfectly clean!!!! Great to relax with the whole family!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My heart belongs to Playa de Muro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Clean, safe beach with lifeguard, paddle boarding windsurfing and shade.  Shallow water - choppier in afternoon.Returning next year - need I say more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Steve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach with clear water, clean sand and excellent facilities.. regular lifeguard .. shallow water perfect for families and cleaner regularly by the local council

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this beach is very nice, clean water, nice sandy beach, close to restaurants. i would recommend to visit this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's nice, but not as spectacular as expected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our stay in Majorca was short, but we wanted at least one day at the beach and chose Muro having read the many reviews about it being the best in Majorca.The strip is long and golden, but far from the cleanest. The sand was peppered with sea debris and some stretches bring in a lot of debris with the tide.We stayed in Port Pollenca and by comparison, whilst the strip of beach is far smaller, it was raked and cleaned regularly throughout the day. Given how many holidaymakers use the beach at Muro, I would have expected the same.The water was lovely however, and warm and quite shallow, so our 5 year old son was very comfortable after a short time in the water.Good to have experienced, but if we return to Majorca, we'll try a different beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hotel Alcudia Park - an EXCELLENT stay in Playa de Muro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Once again in July 2017, a VERY GOOD two weeks beach vacation stay in the Hotel Alcudia Park - like in the last 5 years, in a All Inclusive program. All the hotel services are VERY GOOD - reception, food and beverages, cleanliness, entertainment activities... We didn't have any problems at all! This year we got a 'STAR Prestige' room (in the block 5), with an EXCELLENT exclusive service - something unforgettable!!!The very clean hot water Mediterranean beach is just aside of the hotel, a few steps out of the hotel backyard, we could take as many sea baths as we want, swim, never getting cold... My wife and I we really enjoy very much to return every summer to this hotel for a seaside vacation period of two weeks, and we look forward to came back again in July 2018!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Beach very safe well lifeguarded with ample warning signs and danger flag system in place to ensure all take notice when required. Water entry and exit safe on a low shelving sand bank. Area of improvement could be made by a better beach clean operating during high season due to higher usage and users failing to use the bins provided for the dreaded cigarette butts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful shallow, clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely and shallow with crystal clear water and gently waves.  The beach is kept clean and tidy with beds to hire if needed.  Highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach within walking distance to apartments, I would recommend alcudia beach as it has less sea weed! It's a nice place to go and walk along.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach and view of the bay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely gently shelving beach ideal for children.  Golden sands and clear water with plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas on offer (have to be paid for).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach the water isn't too deep and is lovely and warm. You can hire sun beds and parasols however we didn't bother! The only downfall are the people trying to sell you fake Rolex and sunglasses! We walked down nearly every day even if it was just for a paddle! There is a little market in the evenings that sells Nic nacks. My daughter had a braid in her hair which was €10!! But it was her money and she really wanted one!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach with sea that is like getting into a warm bath!Beautiful colours as well! Spotlessly clean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is one of the best beaches ive been on. the sand is super soft and stretches for miles, the water is safe for children and quite shallow. it is very popular so gets crowded so go early to get your spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic views, spotlessly clean but you should watch for the jellyfish - we saw a few of them although this was a good 200 metres out from the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plays de mura beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beachPlenty sun beds and parasols 18euro for 3 beds and parasol best going towards iberostar hotel area as guaranteed beds. Less crowds Shallow clear water perfect for children Kids loved it as did parents.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful heach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning stretch of white sand beach, with gentle waves, ideal for young families as safe and gently shelving.   Great to be able to catch the sightseeing boats from the jetty along the beach.Sun beds were a bit pricey, but worth it as stunning location

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach with watersports
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful with shallow warm waters for the children and gently waves.  Lots of water-sports available including par-sailing, banana boat rides, jet skiis, paddle-boarding and more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely, clean beach. Within walking distance for Most hotels in the local area. Close to amenities

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with plenty of space
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, even in high season not over crowded, has some smaller bars next the beach too and offers plenty of parking. Just a few minutes walk towards the direction of the nature reserve will get you enough space for a relaxed beach day. The sand was white, the water clear and everything appeared clean and looked after.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very safe clear blue sea ,very shallow water  for small children,sand clean.Sunbeds 6.50 each but ones with parasols need booking in advance so maybe look to book online beforehand?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifull beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A " must" visit it if you are on Mallorca! If we knew how nice it is we would rent a house there. It is not crowded eventhough a lot of people are there, but it is so long that everybody can find it's own private space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A little slice of paradise on the Majorcan island!  Clean beach, plenty of beds and umbrellas for shade. Idyllic place to relax and unwind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is my favourite beach ever, the water is shallow and warm. For most of the time the water is completely clear and teeming with fish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach with parking and a beautiful outlook. The sea shelves away very slowly so you can walk out quite a way and it is safe for little ones. The umbrellas and 2 loungers were 12.75 euros for the day and each umbrella has a small safe on it so you can lock your money, keys, phone away when you go to eat/swim. Amazing! There are ladies walking around offering massages which I did have. A full body massage taking 45 minutes for 20 euros. Then there's the man selling fruit which was so refreshing. Everything from pineapple, melon, bananas & coconut. It's a lovely beach and with these extra touches it makes a lovely day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is stunning with clear sands, clean and can walk out for ages with it still being shallow.This may be due to us going end of may/start of June but there was no sunbeds (there was last year)  and there was no showers or toilets at all " to save water" This meant you had to go and have a drink in the bar in order to use their toilet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach, safe for young children and the older folk in our group. Long golden sandy beaches, warm water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect beach: clear water, warm temperature and light sand!Ideal for families with small kids.The second part of the beach is the best. The closer to Port Alcudia the more crowded it gets..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shallow for a long way out so the sea has a lovely turquoise colour, also reasonable priced sunbeds and lifeguards

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and tidy...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful golden beach, with clear waters. Clean toilets and shower facilities. Make sure you but buy some fruit from the man with the wheel barrow. He was great value!Shame the 'looky looky' men - selling sunglasses , Sun blankets and the such like, 'hair braid' ladies and 'massage' ladies aren't better managed as they did tend to be a pest when you're asked 10 times a day of you want anything...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: miles of golden sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of golden sandy beach. Plenty of small bars/restaurants and water activities. Only a 10 minute walk from Holiday Garden Village. Plenty of shops on the adjacent main roads.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach Sun lounges were a little expensive  clean and lots of restaurant around with varying prices

reviewsWithKeywords.title: long sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is a nice beach, we stayed in a hotel on it. Sandy, shallow water. Liked it. I can't say it's the best ever as 1. I prefer smaller beaches/coves and this is 4 miles long! 2 Was windy all week

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the moat clean and white sand beach what I have seen on Mallorca. Definitly I will come back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great family beach clean with plenty water sports nearby.Plenty of space to take your own beach gear if not using the sunbeds

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shallow so perfect for youngsters, large inflatable for teenagers, walk to Alcudia along beach took 50 minutes at a good pace. Restaurants/bars close by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with warm water, when we visited there was an onshore wind which brought in a little bit of seaweed, visibility not so great for snorkelling due to that. Clean and plenty of local amenities. Frequent bus services to and from in either direction to Alcudia etc. Sandy beach with a slight coral bit as you enter the sea which then smooths out into sand again. You can go quiet far our and still be waist deep. Lifeguards present at some locations with flags up. Various water sports attractions

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, popular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a free shuttle to the beach from our hotel. The beach is clean, well stocked with shops, bars, restaurants, sun beds and street sellers. Some shade available from trees but lots of sun beds with umbrellas for hire too.Water is very clean and fairly shallow to start with. Lifeguards on duty and there are markers to show you not to go out too far.Lots of activities too from boat hire, parasailing, and inflatable obstacle courses on the water. The beach is that long, if you don't like the one bit you only have to walk 100m to find a bit you do like.We'll worth a day out or two if you're in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very busy but worth a visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely sandy beach with crystal clear water. It is very busy with families. There are lots of bars/restaurants and shops nearby. Worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft sand, clear lightblue water, shallow so you can easily bathe with kids and funny Waves! Lifeguards during the day, lots of fish in the sea...simply a perfect beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sandy beach heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand, turquoise water & lots of space to play racket ball! You also have various options for renting out sun beds at decent prices. Great beach for a lovely beach day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ansel Ponce Diama
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach. It is very clean, has clear water, and white sands. I highly recommend coming to this place if you want to relax! - Ansel Ponce Diama

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice clear warm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clear warm water, loungers, watersports, various bars from refreshments at points. Loungers we used were €6.50 between 10am - 6pm and have a plastic safe to put your stuff in under the umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach life
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach miles of white sand. No one bugging you for money to hire loungers. Lots of restaurants and bars on hand also supermarket that sells beach goods

reviewsWithKeywords.title: cracking beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very clean white sand, can get busy only been in June for the last 5 years so cannot comment on what it would be like for July and August, quite a few pedlars but not oppressive, lovely sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best in mallorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After the beaches palma and illetas it is the besth beach three of them. We paid 14 Euro for two sun beds and parasol. It is a very big beach and you can find carpark, restaurants, toilets easily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear water, beautiful sand (that does not burn little feet) and you can walk out very far before the water gets deep- so perfect for playing water games and for small children. Very clean...busy on weekends but still room for everyone without feeling crowded. Such a relaxing spot ❤️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely picturistic beach. long with many sunbeds, although they were often reserved without being used.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A favourite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Big, so crowds seem to disperse, very broad and wide and some waves: lots of action for teenagers (SUP, kayak, windsurfing, banana boats) and excellent chiringuito (Moai) and very clean water. No intimacy but fun guaranteed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Incredible Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing beach that stretches for miles. It helps too that the sea is like a bath. Our hotel was right on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Small but stunning beach with views of the coastline, also great for evening strolls. Nice atmosphere and is lined with restaurants and a little market

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach and beautifully clear sea. The shallow seas are fantastic if you have small children, the beaches are cleaned daily,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, lots of Activities, Clear waters!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beach on multiple occasions and at different locations, this is one of my main reasons for returning to alcudia, the beach stretches for miles and is golden sand all the way around to the port where it is very shallow with clear water ideal for paddling with young children, there are food & drink stands located almost the entire length of the beach. There are also various watersports & activity points located halfway down. Very highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and safe bathing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Small or narrow in places extends quite a distance, clean clear water, could be crowded at times. Good for a few hours but very hot days could be uncomfortable for young babies as no shade unless you buy an umbrella or hire a sun bed with one, but pleasant. No walkway path so access through side streets by big hotels

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, lovely sand, gets very busy in peek season. Shops and restaurants around. There was an inflatable gym in the middle of the sea you could swim out to which looked fun although never went on it myself as I'm not a fan of the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach gorgeous clear blue waters and light golden sands looked like a beach you would see in Mexico!! Definitely worth a visit..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach for the family. Beautiful cleans sands and waters. Lots of space to stretch out and enjoy the sun, sand and sea. Local boat trips available. Pedaloes also available and an inflatable assault course within swimming distance. There will always be looky looky men selling some items and on Playa de euro there are even some people offering massages but as long as you don't mind the very occasional chat its all fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: safe and popular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice sandy beach ,popular with all and easy to access .main road is very close so easy to get the bus to alcudia or can picafort if you want more action . a daily evening market with several stalls selling budget jewellery trinkets and souvaniers

reviewsWithKeywords.title: paradise found
reviewsWithKeywords.text: long white sandy beach & crystal clear turquise waters, this is one of the best beaches on the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great beach with amazing sand and clear water. It can be very busy, especially at weekends. Close to amenities and shops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent location and ideal for beach lovers and cyclists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stay at the Los Principes Hotel and Spa. Welcoming, clean, good service and good freshly cooked food. Then hire your bicycle from Heurzeler which is attached to the hotel grounds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but very few places to eat/drink along it, and FULL of sun beds. Very busy with families but beautiful none the less!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect playa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 2 weeks in family at this beach. The water is turquoise and warm. You can reserve the sunbed for a nice price. We will come back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach, soft sand and clear sea.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only visited here once during the week but I could have come back for more. The sea seemed clear and clean with a huge inflatable assault course for kids. A few showers for cleaning yourself off and plenty of bars within walking distance for refreshments.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the best beaches very close to the hotel couldn't ask for more clear blue and no seaweed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach for Toddlers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has beautiful soft, white sand and the sea is amazing, warm and only knee deep for a long way out so it's great for toddlers. There are small waves but nothing which is scary for little people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: good & clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: found beach to be very clean with nice sand - water was very shallow so good for young ones , plenty of water activities going on + play area actually out in the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice, easy, shallow beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very nice, white shallow beach that is very kid friendly. It stays shallow a long ways out and the there are fun, but not too rough waves to play in. The palm tree umbrellas and sun chairs were a nice bonus. The beach is not too wide but makes up for that by being quite long, so you can get away from crowds if you like. Close to town and shops, restaurants, etc. Easy parking as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paya du Muro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean and so safe for children. Can walk out in the sea for quite a distance and still not be in deep water. Water is so clear you can see the fish swimming. Only downside is the sellers on the beach trying to sell you watches,hair braiding etc which is a nuisance and later in the day the seaweed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had some great days at the beach whilst on holiday.Only 2/3 minutes walk to restaurantsAlso boat trips, parasending  and bouncy water slides available along the beach 5/10 minutes walk ether way.Fantastic beach well looked after.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with a pier
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful sand beach. The water is clean and beautiful, very picturesque. Two sunbeds + parasol cost 12€ for a day, but the staff appears to start checking them around noon. There's also a pier offering several boat trips which you should definitely go on!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little piece of paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely stunning. An excellent place to relax and unwind and enjoy a swim in the sea...just perfect!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is lovely, with white sand and clear blue water. Really shallow which is good for children paddling. Lifeguards on duty toilets showers and changing facilities, also water sports if you want them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro is a great beach for families  with kids and all other. The water is shallow and the sand is white and soft. Umbrellas and chairs for rent but lots if space for your own towel and umbrella. There is a small square with wc, restaurants and a supermarket.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great day at the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, clear water. Sandy Beach with no algae or seaweed. Breezy day keep the heat off! Perfect beach! Only fault- minimal shells to collect. Very clean beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holidays
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, but missing beach clubs. Very clean and not so much crowded, beginning of July. Perfect blue and clean water. Very close to the markets and small restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cocktails are amazing! Best in the area. Staff are friendly and efficient too.Very nice location looking out onto the beach/sea. Very open sitting areas with nice low music and dim ambient lighting. Very calming place :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful day and night
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited both day and night, both offered different kinds of beauty. In the day the blue sky is complimented by clear waters. We didn't stop and lie on the sand but we walked along and up and down the jetty. Sun beds and umbrellas were available but the sand was crowded. At night the sand cooled, the sky turned a purply blue as the sun set and we sat on the end of the jetty as the air cooled. Definitely recommend going down to see the sun set behind the mountains.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro in the center of a large bay in the north of mallorca is a spectacular place. A clean white sand washed by a crystal clear water that makes you feel in paradise. I stayed 5 days but will return for longer because it is the best I have ever seen. I was in the Alcudia area and the beach is still spectacular to the other side I was not there but the view from the Muro Palace was very nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sea and beautiful sand with plenty of activities if that is what you like. Toilets easy accessible and shops are close for refreshments.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach great bar / restaurant near by called the swan easy to get a boat trip if wanted had a blow up water activity in the sea restraints near by shops lady on the boat trips on the day we went was so helpful happy and so friendly we couldn't say a bad word about it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach like fairy tale
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pure water, azure, sandy and soft sand. Fish added charm. Hard not fall in love The only shortcoming is the lack of children's play areas like in Salou

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a long shallow beach, so perfect for children to swim. Its open area, toalett facilities, and good possibilies for wheelchairs aswell.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach with lovely warm, clear water that stays shallow for ages! We spent a gorgeous afternoon here with our two little ones who had a whale of a time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very lovely clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: stayed at playa de muro suites. beach was lovely x very clean x also had life guard x check out the traders on the beach have some nice copy glasses cheap x nice men x

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at a hotel on the beach and was really lovely with the pier right in front of us. Just a little too much seaweed around but nothing to stop me going in the sea. Few shops and restaurants just off the beach too. The water was lovely and warm...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wasn't very clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach in general-with sandy shore and rocks around. Right beside S'iilot main street with restaurants, bars and other attractions. We did not swim a once cause we found much better beaches around like cala anguila and another one next to it. But for a walk it was lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We booked a hotel at this area of Majorca, purely for the beach. We stopped close to the Las Gaviotas Jetty, which offers boat trips and a lovely bit of scenery. The water was beautifully clear, the beach is fairly quiet. Our favourite thing about this beach is the fish which swim close to the shore, they like being fed and it is great for children and snorkelling enthusiasts to get close to the sealife

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at family life alcudia pins, right on this beach. Everyday it was kept very clean, perfect blue waters, lifeguards actively patrolling. Only down side buy about 3/4pm seaweed had covered the shoreline, but not a massive issue.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This hotel are located in a perfect area. Very close to the ocean. The hotel are very clean. The food also fantastic. Friendly helpful staff. Only the wifi connection are very poor and the Gym need some upgrade but highly recommended for everyone who like quality stuff. AAA+++

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean , clear beach , calm water and shallow for a few meters . Boats came into the jetty to take people on trips .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, very clean and well maintained.  Shallow, calm waters so the children were able to really enjoy it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect water, crisp and clear, very nice sand and a super super Long Beach with chiringittos, bars and restaurants and clubs ... normally a little bit of wind in the afternoon, so great for all different sorts of watersports

reviewsWithKeywords.title: well kept
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach was good with chairs and umbrellas (14euros) and a life guard--the water was very shallow so family friendly

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for kids. Very safe sea which is shallow for a long eay out. Only problem.is all the illegal sellers on beach who don't leave you alone!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a lovely afternoon here at muro beach clear water white sand.Was surprised to see no sun beds available which would of been an added bonus.A lot of lucky lucky men and hair braiders about but with a stern no they did leave us alone.Kids thought the beach and riding the waves was brilliant, some lovely restaurants nearby and shop just as you come off the beach to the left.Beach was well supervised by lifeguards and plenty of activities to take part in if you are daring plus the harbour for the boat trips which looked fun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a beautiful beach! White sands and crystal clear ocean! There is so much to do from water sports to plenty of lovely little restaurants to sit in the sun and have something to eat and a drink! We went banana boating and on the peddle boats with a slide and has an amazing day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great, clean, beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach is beautiful. Clear water, very clean, umbrellas to hire, lots of bars/cafes close by, and a little market at night. A really lovely place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean beach, public restroom available and a docking pier where You can book excursions. Very clean water and very shallow.I am 1m68 and I could walk to end of the pier and still head above the water :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely Long Beach. Sea temperatures are great, feels luke warm by the afternoon, some fish only small ones mind do swim close to the shore. very shallow for a distance out. Which is great if you're taking little children or a non swimmer who can still have fun slashing around. Check prices before buying from beach huts. €2.80 for a small water. Robbery. Buy multipacks from a supermarket and a cool bag.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent sandy beach, shallow waters for children, umbrellas and chairs for hire. Restaurant just off beach and lifeguards in attendance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach!!!!, very suitable for kids
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very pretty. is very good for kids, since is very shallow and safe. We were in the area of the iberostar hotel albufera park and is a very nice area and it has the pick up point for the boat trips which is quite useful. Is our favorite beach area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are staying in alcudia for two weeks and playa de alcudia surprised: a lot of sludge, foul odor... its strange cause last year, the same time everything was ok. Thats way we looked for another place. Playa del muro - only few minutes by car from the centre of alcudia with clean water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Feels like being in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s definitely worth visiting playa de muro. It feels like being in the Caribbean. The sea and beach are clean and life guards are everywhere. There are also free showers which adds a little extra if you are not staying at a private beach section.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: best beach ever visited in Mallorca ,beautiful clean sand and sea, shallow and safe several lifeguards

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach, clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A clean beach that is quite shallow so good for young kids.  The water is clear but we didn't see any marine life.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the longest beaches in Mallorca, supported by various beach bars out of the sand and with its sea line fully occupied by hotels it looses the beauty because of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach crystal blue water you can go out a fair way , only down fall we went end of may no sun beds or umbrellas I bought a good umbrella with sun protection on it for twelve euros and took it back home end of holidays .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely and clean beach with easy access for pushchair. Water calm and safe for the children. Beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous we visited recently and stayed at alcudia pinns hotel which is in this beach we went on the beach on our first full day the weather was hot the sea was clear and nice and warm the views are stunning its nice and clean id go back here just for the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No umbrellas for shade and the shower/foot wash didn't work.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bypass this beach and go to Can Picafort instead, more shops, restaurants/bars and umbrellas/working showers.  This is a shame for the shops/bars in Playa de Muro but it needs a little attention to detail.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet beach, few facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in a nearby hotel and visited the beach nearly every day of our stay. The beach is made accessible by wheelchairs (and has a few other facilities for disabled), which was also convenient for visiting the beach with our stroller. There are no beach beds available on the beach, which whe didn't mind, but be sure to pack enough for a comfortable stay. With our 3 month old daughter, this included a stroller, umbrella, little beach tent. We managed fine. Hotels near the beach offer bar service (and provided us with bottle service).Surf is calm and the sea is very shallow, so very kid friendly. The shower didn't function fully, but with our hotel nearby, we didn't mind.The wind was getting strong each day after lunch time, so we then packed up our stuff and moved back to the hotel.Since the beach is facing east, early birds have the pleasure of viewing a beautiful sunrise.
