Get up early!Few vendors offer sunglasses/massages/rugs/braids/fruits, but we didn't mind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: clean well kept beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: just one or two toilets would be the only down side, a few shops and restaurants make it feel like a quaint little beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good clean beach safe for children as the water gets deep very gradually, sand cleaned each evening, lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, family friendly beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a perfect beach for families as the shore slopes very gently into the sea. Even toddlers could run in and out. There was no music blasting when we were there. Beds and umbrellas could be hired but most had taken their own things. The beach is clean and the water sparkling. I believe it has a blue flag. Very nice, safe family orientated beach with enough amenities to make it a pleasant destination.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach, unsurprisingly it was busy at May half term.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, lovely sand. Was very busy with sun loungers/umbrellas and other people when we went but it was May half term week   The water stayed shallow for a long way so was ideal for our young children to splash around in. The people selling on the beach are a bit irritating but not persistent - a polite 'no thank you' and they went on their way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a week there on 23rd May this yr and spent it all on the lovely beach, last yr they had sun beds as you walked onto the beach( near the Swan Resturant) and portable toilets( which were not open this time,we were told they don't have the sun beds or open toilets until beginning of June so we had to walk a little way to the left of the beach to find some beds and use the restaurant toilets,apparently there is a bit of the beach which is Alcudia beach( where the sun beds were and the other bit where there weren't any is Playa De Muro, just a note about sun beds in general ,we noticed around our hotel( BQ Holiday sun village) the sun beds are not adjustable so if you book there be aware if you have a bad back when using the beds.the ones on the beach which were Pink were adjustable so okAnd right on the beach is the Floridita Beach Bar and restaurant but beware of the portable loo a little bit behind it, it was so bad I couldn't use it, you get the key from that coffee bar I mentioned it to the staff they said something in Spanish and didn't seem to worry about it, disgusting.Had coffee/ beer lunch time every day at El Leon Rojo  restaurant good food and great staff, and the Swan next to it was great too the staff there,Sebas, Clau,Jaime and Marina were lovely always helpful, we ate there in the evenings, good food and reasonable prices, also good for football fans they have all the matches on,lol it's a family run Restaurant.We have been to that area twice now and really love it, the sea is lovely to swim in and great for little ones.you can go on boat trips from the beach, but unfortunately there was a lot of what we thought was seaweed but it was grass from under the sea when the weather is rough out at sea this grass comes in, it's ok to walk on at the waters edge but bit messy , they had a digger collecting it up,it's dark brown when wet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a long, gently shelving and clean sandy beach with lifeguard in attendance. Looky-looky sellers and patrolling Masseuses are easily dissuaded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay beach, no boulevard
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good beach, clear water and well suited for holiday with little children as the water does not get very deep for a while. Little facilities on the beach though.But we missed that there was no boulevard or boardwalk with shops or restaurants or bars, a few little streets end with a bar that overlook the ocean but for the most shops and restaurants you need to cross a busy road first and than there are plenty, but not with sea view. Vibe is good and relaxed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of white sandy beach and shallow clean waters. Perfect for kids! There were water activies for the adults and several boattrips from the pier! Sun beds  & umbrella rental available too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach and lovely  BaySafe with LifeguardsGreat for all agesSunbeds for hire in certain areas

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice view and clean water, the only major problem is the services which does not exist, WC, shower all are missing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a very beautiful beach but quite crowdy even in September and you can also expect some nude people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Accessed direct from our hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long, white sand beach. Clear, quite shallow water. Always very clean and due to it shear size, never crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beatuful blue sea and spotless sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is spotless and clean it is cleaned everyday and kept well maintained . The sea is great for the kids it is very shallow and calm but can get a little choppy if there is a breeze . The water is an mixture of beautiful blues and with the white waves can be very pretty . The early morning sunrise is a lovely site it comes up at the end where the lighthouse can be seen try to see it once . The walks along the beach are nice and relaxing can be a bit busy in high season. Great location

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A good long walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is clean and very shallow.  However there is a strip on the tideline of what appears to be coconut husks which can be a bit sore on the feet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, but don't believe the hype.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very nice beach with a decent selection of bars and food outlets nearby. Pros:- gently shelving smooth sandy seabed which is great for families- water is generally quite clear- plenty of places to eat/drink nearby- water sports nearby- always a breeze to take the edge of the heat, but you could probably say that about most beaches. Cons:- don't believe the hype about it being better than the Caribbean or the Maldives. It's certainly not a patch on any Caribbean beach I've visited.- every 100 yards or so there are large piles of seaweed at the waters edge, and large patches of seaweed floating in the sea. - the surrounding area is very touristic - a touch of the Blackpool-in-Spain atmosphere that plenty of us try to avoid. There were plenty of places advertising all day English breakfast. I'm not knocking it, but for me that's not a positive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach!!! Nice and clean.... be aware of locals trying to sell stuff on the beach or lady constantly asking if you want a massage!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Playa Garden hotel which backs on this beach and were lucky enough to be able to see it from our room. It's a beautiful unspoilt beach with sand dunes and a lovely long jetty. We were there end of April beginning of May so it was very quiet. Lovely views of mountains both sides. Lovely skies in the evenings which lit the mountains beautifully. Lovely soft golden sand. Great for children to make sandcastles !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, but....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've been coming here for years, the beach is absolutely beautiful and the water clear and shallow and really safe for kids, but has now it seems has become infested by an army of lucky lucky men trying to sell you fake sunglasses and people offering massages. Can't spend more than a minute without trying to fend them off.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach that is clean slopes gently into the sea for safe bathing for young and old.and of cause there are lifeguard stations all a long this beach.There are restaurants near by which all add up to a nice place to send the day.The only draw back is there is no paved walk way along the edge of the sand so those with walking problems may find this hard.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best experience ever for my 3yr old daughter. Shallow water and clear water. So much activities going on at the beach like water sports at far ends. Boat rides. Fine sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mr and Mrs Hoggard
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful clean beach,shallow water,( safe for babies and children) easy access from hotel.Life guards stations all along the beach right up till Alcudia port.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with lovely clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach clean and sandy, water beautiful light blue colour. Would benefit from a tap/shower when you leave beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach warm water and shallow for kids toilets are located close and there are plenty of shops bars and restaraunts in a 5 minute walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach! Loads of space! Safe! Close to bars and shops! Offers sea trips! Can get a massage there

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean beach with sun dunes and turquoise watersGood for little children although lack toilet facilities

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice naturist beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely, clean, sandy beach, with dunes that have been preserved. We visited the naturist part, which was relaxed, and not very crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely picturesque walk into Alcudia, plenty of beach bars and restaurants to call in along the way, great for a peaceful amble, my idea of bliss

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really beautiful and offers a lot of space to sunbathe! The water is clear and has amazing colors. Definitly worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, quiet beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: long stretch of sandy beach, clean, few areas of sea weed depending on tides. No sun beds and parasols on beach when we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach nice and clean a few beach bars and boat trips. Very picturesque nice shallow water. Well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a nice one to go to and smaller, quieter and less commercialised than the ones in Alcudia.  Well worth a visit if you are in the area.  It is a dinky little town, yet with great views, lots of shops, hotels, restaurants, and pubs.  Also, some quiet lakes and canals, as you walk away from the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scenery
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Popped down for a visit a couple of days, scenery is beautiful, place wasn't to busy and looked fun if beaches are your type of thing. Shops around and places to eat. Most people we spoke to had a walk right along the length of the beach which takes a couple of hours and they enjoyed it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach but no sun loungers due to it being the start of the season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful beach 🌊 the only Downside to when we visited there were no sun loungers or toilet facilities due to it being the start of the season

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long white sand beach. Beautiful. Can get quite busy but still doesn't feel packed with people. There is some people going around selling fresh fruit, coconut, watermelon, mango and that's nice. You can also get massage and have your hair braided.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a lovely sandy beach with crystal clear waters. Good location. You can walk all the way into the main town of Alcudia from Playa de Muro.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely sand and clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful beach white sand and clear water and lovely for children to play there there are no cars allowed close to the beach and there are pubs shops close by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: lovely clean beach. water is very clear. sun beds on the beach loads of bars and food places near by

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sandy beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was lovely & clean with proper sand (no stones like you get in England)!! with clear, warm sea that you could swim quite far out before it became too deep but also perfect for paddling or leisurely strolls as it is a long stretch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lush
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lush white sand and blue sea. A little cold at this time of year but still very nice. A fairly quiet area but enough shops and bars to keep you busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach in the National Park, with lovely clear sea and good views across the bay. Nice to come here to get away from slightly smelly Alcudia!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, you can buy fresh fruit from locals or if you fancy someting stronger its close to local shops. Banana boat and other fun water activities available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whilst it's been really windy over the last few days it's still been easy to appreciate how nice the beach is, very clean and lovely blue sea... such a pleasant place to be 👍👍👍 🌊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is absolutely stunning. Came here most days of my holiday.  Pure white sand.  Family friendly. Toilets.  And places to buy food and drinks.  Lovely place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely sandy which beach. It was very quiet and peaceful. I watched my kids make some sand castles and playing with the sand. Lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famiky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach - safe for family's. Golden sands - one of my favourite beaches in the world. Clean sands with blue waters

reviewsWithKeywords.title: stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: fantastic holiday had by myself and 2 teenage children sun village was lovely and clean hotel staff were polite and helpful and any problems dealt with asap the entertainment reps made our holiday they were friendly entertaining and encouraged everone to join in good job yann and adam :) we would definitely go back here!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big and quiet beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Impressive Alcudia bay. Excellent beach experience. Clean water and sand. Landscape of dunes, perhaps too affected by the erosion and human works.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sandy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro Beach has lovely golden sand and is ideal for children and adults alike.  It is popular for watersports.  The sea is various shades of green - it's a lovely beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NICE AND CLEAN
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to the beach 1 day of holiday it woz nice and clean and sun was shining and really nice views 👍👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bit disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was really excited to visit the beach because everyone I had spoken to about visiting here raved about how great the beach is. I was really disappointed, the beach is nice, just such a shame it had a lot of rubbish lying around and if you have children please be careful of dog poo, unfortunately people do take their pets there for walks, which I'm not opposed to at all, I love dogs, but when they don't clear up their pets mess, it's just disgusting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, soft sand and crystal clear waters. Visited in April so not at all busy. You can walk along the beach in both directions for miles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We love this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've been to stay on the beach several times & will never tire of it. The sea is warm, clear, shallow & calm and is perfect for the children to play in. The sand is free of rocks & pebbles & its very clean.It does get busy but any beautiful beach would.My children like to take bread & sit on the pier to feed the fishes, if you stand in the water & drop in bread the fish will swim around your legs! Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: a beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach, especially in the evening when it quiets down after the sunbathing soles. Cafes over looking the sea are superb too, Water facilities to wash your feet and lifeguards onsite is great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa de Muro Beach / Majorca
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro has a lovely beach to satisfy every expectation for a pleasant stay with friends and familiys, clean waters, restauration nearby inviting for more energy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful uncrowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely family beach, safe shallow water, turquoise. Always been quiet​when we visit, April and October and water still warm!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a lovely clean beach. Long walk to port de alcudia. Very quiet out of season but we enjoyed that. Sea very cold in march. Lovely views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Would recommend this place for family holidays.Lovely family friendly beach.Nice 2 week vacation. Hotel right on the beach and a beautiful sea view.Would like to go back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful and quiet part of the beach is a nude area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa de Muro is a long stretched Caribbean beach with shallow warm water that makes you believe you just spend €1000 on a plane ticket to Cancún. To reach the beach you have to walk about 10 minutes through a beautiful nature conservation park, meaning the beach is not surrounded by beach resorts. However, the most beautiful and quiet part of the beach is a nude area. The rest of the beach is very crowded and noisy. X didiandyasaroundtheglobe.com

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pure perfection
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, hills on the horizon, turquise see: bahamas in Europe. And there are places on this beach where you can have nobody 50 meters aroun you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent, wide and sandy beach, friendly for children. Feed fish straight from your hand. Enjoy warm sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is nice, for it's sandy and you can walk into it for very long before it gets deep. It's warm in the summer. As it is on the east side, there are a bit more waves than on the west side, but nothing to worry about. Also, the beach is very long and you can make a night walk all the way to Alcudia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday through illness
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent holiday lovely beaches lots to keep you occupied good restaurants, plus some nice walks along the promenade

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the lagotel and there was a free shuttle bus to the beach. Lots of shops around the beach. Beach itself is really nice, we just put our towels on the sand, I recommend going early to get a good spot. The water was lovely and clear, could walk very far out and the waves were quiet so good for swimming. Lovely beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful soft sandy beach with clear blue water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing! It's so clean and you can walk for miles. The water is so blue and you can see thousands of little fish swimming about in the sea with you. You can see exactly where you are treading. The sand is so soft. There are people offering there massage services (paid) on the beach which is a must. People don't even notice that you are getting one done as everyone is too busy sunbathing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mr.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unbelievable place, shallow water, clean and beautiful beach. Kids was very happy and staying long time in the water,  no waves.. Clean water so kids can play and we don't need to worry. I will be back again.. Thank u Majorca.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach. Wheelchair access-friendly place. Highly recommend this beach. Good places to eat around the beach. Close to almost every hotel in Playa de Muro. They also have day trips from this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: OMG forget the Caribbean!!You his clear blue water which is waist high when your over a mile out is the best sea and beach I've ever been onWe had some amazing days and nights in this beach, it's proper romantic and is really clean!I will defo return very soonThis is my favourite place at the moment

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely amazing beach.  Shallow water.  Lovely.  Loved it. My children spent every day on this beach. You can walk into the water and know that it's shallow enough for the children not to be at risk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Little Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was amazing fully recommended and would go gain. They do need to improve entertainments. The food was very good and plenty of choice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is absolutely amazing ! Shallow water make it perfect place to stay with kids, view is outstanding. The only disadvantage was fact that beach was absolutely packed, all day long - but cannot really complain as it not a private place and Playa de Muro is a holiday destination for thousand's ppl each year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, well maintained and clean. Tide comes right up to the top of the beach. Shallow water that is excellent for smaller children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, shallow crystal clear water. Keep very clean. Sunbeds are 11 Euro for 2 for the day with the shade.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful beach, the water is so shallow it's great for kiddies or nervous swimmers.  If you like a beach bed you need to be down there early enough as they do get filled up very quickly but great beach and lovely and clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful spot.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach . Rent a little thatched brolly sunbed ,book ,cold bottle idyllic!Could have been anywhere in the world. Would think it is busy in peak season but nice in October half term.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very clean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Playa De Muro is well maintained. There are manned lifeguard towers every 800m or so. Sun beds and parasols are available for a charge and local cafe's and shops are within a short walk. There are disabled sun beds adjacent to the wooden walkway and a foot wash and toilet facility very nearby.

reviews.title: playa de muro unforgettable

reviews.title: Stunning Beach!
reviews.text: It's a beautiful blue flag beach with lifeguards.Their are toilets and showers and foot showers too.The sea is so clear! It's good for paddling and swimming in. I could wade put to the end of the pier/jetty and still have my feet on the seabed! The second time I went to the beach it was a bit rougher, so I didn't venture too far out because I could feel the current pulling me.Sun loungers can be rented for €21 a man comes round to collect money. It appears to be cash only. There's a little area next to Isabella's restaurant that is shaded because of the trees.  It's a nice place to sit, if you don't want to pay or can't afford the price of a sunlounger. There's shops and restaurants right next to the beach.There are vendors that sell beach towels/blankets,  foot massages and can do your hair. One woman had French plaits done. If you say no, they leave you alone.There's a glass bottom boat and a catamaran that you can get on at the end of the pier/jetty.

reviews.title: A wide and charming beach in Puerto de Alcudia!
reviews.text: I visited Playa de Muro in February this year and was pleasantly surprised. It is a beautiful and very extensive beach, which makes it an ideal place both to walk quietly along the shore and to enjoy a good swim when the weather accompanies.Even in low season, you can appreciate the tranquility of the surroundings and how well maintained the area is. Its spaciousness allows you to relax without feeling overwhelmed, and the combination of clear sand and clean water makes it a very pleasant place to spend the day.A beach recommended for those looking for a spacious and pleasant place near the Port of Alcudia.

reviews.title: Beautiful but extremely boring
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach that goes for kilometers each way. A bit narrow at times so it feels like people are on top of each other. Amazingly clean, super warm sea ( September). If you prefer dynamic setting, choose a different and bigger town.The only place with remarkable food, drinks and atmosphere is NU beach bar and restaurant. But their prices will make holes in your pockets. 18€ + for s cocktail. ...

reviews.title: Beautiful beach…shame about the rude sun lounger man
reviews.text: We’ve come on holiday to this beach three years running we really love it. White sand & clear blue water. Plenty of sun loungers and water sports. The people are a PAIN on this beach though. Constant ‘looky looky men/ people selling things’ asking you every 30 seconds. And now I’ve been shouted at and falsely accused of not paying my sunlounger fee by the aggressive guy collecting the money. Shame as it spoils a beautiful place.

reviews.title: A beautiful beach where the boardwalk takes you out into the sea
reviews.text: We stayed in a hotel just off this beautiful beach. The sea is lovely and clear with somedays the seaweed builds up near the shore. The sea is full of fish and they happily swim around your feet. This beach is  long and we only walked a small bit of it. It's lovely and clean. As we were staying a two minute walk away we didn't use the chairs and umbrella but they had a safe attached if you needed to use this. The dunes and boardwalk add to this beach. The only downside was the mosquitoes in the early morning which put pay to an early morning swim. The beach was busy which was to be expected in the middle of August. Near the boardwalk you can find that the sea goes a bit deeper then hits a sandbank and then is shallow for a while which makes it's safe for kids. There are beach bars off the beach in the dunes or attached to hotels. A beach to  try out

reviews.title: Local transportation - DISGRACEFUL
reviews.text: A nice coastal town, with a wide range of good restaurants,shops and a few bars - a family resort.Only down side, if were staying here and wanted to travel to other towns on this coast like Alcudia and C'an Picafort - be careful, taxis are very difficult to find and their reliability is so bad our excellent hotel, would not book a taxi on our behalf. Also the local bus company is a disgrace - TIB - take no notice of their timetables. 29th August 2025, waited an hour for a bus to Alcudia - only one full up bus, then decided to go the other way to C'an Picafort waited 15 mins, on return waited 75 mins with kids, stories of people stranded in Alcudia - walking 6.5 miles back - not good.

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Well what can I say don't take any notice of bad reviews just people being picky 😕. We went for a week and had a great time and met some lovey people it's lovely and chilled with good entertainment though out the day.Infact we enjoyed it that much we have just been and booked again for next year for two weeks and will be returning with a great couple we met there.If I was to one of those picky people 😜 all I would say is that a loo brush would be good in the bathroom and drinks weren't that great but hey that's not going to ruin our stay as cleaners were in everyday with extra loo roll and clean towels and beds were always made.Would recommend people go to the sky bar at condesor hotel just down the road and treat yourself to a lovey cocktail and watch the sun set and see the fantastic views. Thanks to all at the hotel for a fantastic stay see you in 2026

reviews.title: Feel the freedom.
reviews.text: Once you're out of town, most beaches in Spain are nude-friendly, but certain areas have a tradition of naturist use and are therefore less daunting if you'd like to try a clothes-free experience for the first time.The established naturist area of Playa de Muro is best reached from the bus stop opposite the Valentin Playa De Muro resort, just outside Can Picafort. Follow the footpath a short distance to the boardwalk and on to the beach. Turn left toward the stone tower with a pointed top, and as soon as you're a discreet distance from the boardwalk (say 100 metres) you can freely sunbathe and swim as nature intended.Don't be put-off by people who are hiking along the shore from Can Picafort to Alcudia. You've just as much right to enjoy the beach as they have!You only live once, and sitting in a soggy swim suit is nobody's idea of comfort.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach!

We always drive to this beach, there’s beach bars & toilets. For 2 Sunbeds & Umbrella its €18.20 for the day and has a locked box so you can keep valuables in there. The sea is beautiful, clear water, and you can walk out for a long way before it starts getting deep. Perfect for families and young children. The sand is also perfect, white & soft. No rocks, no jellyfish & no seaweed!

We were right in the last section and could walk into the nature reserve. Here, of course, you have to stay on the trails. But for nature lovers and adventurers just the thing. Parking is also no problem there. We had fish, big waves, soft sand and seagulls. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: Lots of people here, even in the off-season time. The water is amazingly clean and full of fish and little crabs. We got waves the other day, but sometimes it is like a pond, not even the smallest movement. The beach is not too wide, and right after it you can find lots of markets, bistros and restaurants where you can grab a quick bite or a refreshment. There are lifeguards patrolling all the time and in a few spots you can find water showers to clean up the sand off your slippers. If you prefer you can rent sunbeds and umbrellas, but there is enough space for beach towels if you would rather enjoy the sand. And for those wondering if October is a good time to visit Mallorca I can tell you I've got my back sun burned in no time. The water temperature is around 24°C, while in the air it rises to 28-30.

reviews.title: Beautiful shallow waters and fantastic amenities
reviews.text: I can honestly say this is possibly the best beach I have ever visited especially if you have young children. Although the beach isn’t very deep it is extremely long so you won’t struggle to find anywhere to set up for the day. Sunbeds with umbrellas and safe boxes are available to hire but we never bothered. Pedlo’s and paddle boards are also available to hire at €20 an hour but these are very popular so be prepared to wait. You can buy beach umbrellas (€12-20) and beach blankets (€10-20) locally so you can get a nice set up at a very reasonable price. The sea is so shallow I never once felt worried about my children and as you walk out there is a huge sand bank which makes the water ankle/knee deep. Lovely clean beach area, recycling bins, showers and toilets which is a big plus. Plenty of supermarkets and bars/restaurants close by for refreshments. Even the lookie lookie men were pleasant and respectful if you say no thank you. We did hear a few reports of thefts on the beach so we never took any valuables with us and to be honest it’s not a bad idea to have a digital detox and enjoy family time. This place is great for unwinding.

reviews.title: Very nice beach for big and small.
reviews.text: What a beach! Perfect for family small and large. The water is shallow with lifeguards in towers and jet ski ala Baywatch. Ambulance was parked we road and there is medical care.There is shower for body and feet to flush off salt and sand.There are model primitive toilets.If you want to rent a sunbed, just go there and put your things and the landlord will come to you. The seats quickly get full so arrive early in the day.  A parasol with two chairs costs EUR 14.95. If you do not want to rent space, you can just lay the towel on the sand where there is room We bought a large serong/cloth that we hung on the umbrella to create more shade. There are sellers all the time, however, they stopped asking us after we bought the canvas. Vendors selling fruit came, we bought watermelon, dragon fruit and coconut just fine. There are pedal boats with slide for rent what we saw. Didn't try it themselves. We were super happy to swing in the waves and it beats all hotel pools by far.

reviews.title: Huge top beach, keeping up with the best in the world!
reviews.text: We as a family found the beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in Mallorca. It's worth it! There is plenty of parking nearby, and the beach is not crowded even during high season as it is very large!

reviews.title: A dream beach with crystal clear waters

reviews.title: Playa del Muro
reviews.text: Lots of people, lots of vendors who go around constantly selling fake stuff so avoid if you want peace and quiet. Lots of waves but nice water and nice bottom (sand). Even shallow.

reviews.title: Beautiful clear warm water and golden sand
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach with light golden sand and warm clear water. Will cost 20 Euros per day for 2 sunbeds with an umbrella. The seller was friendly. The pedalos with slide cost 20 Euros also for an hour.  The beach illegal sellers are a little annoying sadly. They will bother you hourly on average and some don't take no for an answer. Best to totally ignore them as when you try to be polite they don't move on. Despite this, this is one of the nicest beaches I have visited worldwide.

reviews.title: Too many people

Plenty of space, just watch where you park, we parked well off the road on a bit of dirt and got given a €100 fine for blocking a pavement or pedestrian walkway, something that was completely false, so just make sure you park in designated bays.

reviews.title: An inevitable photo
reviews.text: Come non fare un salto a playa de muro?! Beach that is very reminiscent of our beaches of Salento but that you distinguish for the presence of its renowned and long wharf. Clear water and fine white sand. Half a day of relaxation and lots of sun. Books are always occupied by residents of hotels overlooking the beach. As soon as you land in Mallorca your first purchase must be an umbrella. You will need it in all coves so it is a great investment. Take advantage of the lady with the wheelbarrow selling excellent fresh fruit.  If you want to eat really well and with your feet in the sand I recommend the chiringuito Bar Pierino Italian conduction but delicious tapas as well as sangria

reviews.title: A wonderful beach!
reviews.text: Nice, long beach. Despite the great crowd, there is a place for everyone. Both for lounging on the sand itself and for sunbeds with parasols that have a safe with a code to leave your phone, wallet... when you go swimming. It is a bit more shallow and you will have to walk a bit longer to the depth to swim. Toilets are there, showers, lots of places for volleyball. There is a supermarket and a restaurant near the beach. The beach is long and depends on where you are. New restaurants are being built along the entire length of the beach, which will probably be for next season. This will probably make it easier for tourists to be able to buy something refreshing, eat a snack, drink coffee without having to dress up and go to a cafe or restaurant. The only thing that bothered us was that you didn't have something on the beach, where you could buy something and enjoy it on your deckchair.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Hotel Playa Esperanza Resort and every day we go to Muro beach and use the beach chairs in the Hotel's garden, which are still free because the beach chairs and umbrellas scattered throughout the garden are paid for. but two sun loungers and an umbrella cost more or less 14 euros per person and each umbrella has a safe!!From the hotel garden, you can walk to the 7 km beach with white sand and crystal clear water, even if it was green the days we went.Other days the water was full of algae.There are different lifeguards throughout the beach and in general there are sun loungers from the different hotels for payment all over the beach.We don't have a car but there is plenty of parking in front of the beach.There are many beach bars, restaurants and a paddle surf school.

reviews.title: Half day trip would be enough. I dont recommend whole vacation here.
reviews.text: Overrated & overcrowded. We booked a hotel really close to this beach (not to mention that this hotel does not have a half of the price value we had to pay), we wanted to be really close to a nice beach. I mean the beach is not ugly but very narrow and overcrowded and two sunbeds with a parasol cost around 19€/day. We spent 2 hours total there and chose to walk 30minutes to a nicer beach instead. If we knew before, we would have never chosen this hotel in this location. It is a mass tourism place and every day we have to think about a plan how to get away (trips on bus, bike, scooter or car), we are very disappointed, won’t ever come back. This is the first time we are looking forward to go home from the holiday :( If you really want to visit this place, plan your trip to spend here at most 1 day.

It’s huge- no problem having a few Olympic-sized pools worth of space all to yourself, even in July/August.  Just beautiful.

reviews.title: Play Del Muro Beach - Nudist Area
reviews.text: The main beach has lovely golden sand that stretches for several km from southern Alcudia to northern C’an Picafort and is backed by the tree and scrub covered dunes of Es Comu De Muro all with a fantastic view of Alcudia bay.  Closer to the two towns there are lots of sun beds and parasols for hire and away from the buildings topless women are common.  Move further away and you reach the unofficial nudist beach where the majority are naked or at least topless.  You will find people sunbathing naked anywhere there aren’t the sun loungers/parasols for hire but the main area is centred over a km between the two wooden walkways through Es Comu De Muro with the stone  obelisk closest to the beach in the middle.  The main concentration is near the obelisk, there is no defined “gay” area and everyone mixes freely but immediately north of the obelisk has the higher all male concentration.  The dunes are fascinating and well worth an explore (please be mindful of avoiding damage to the eco structure) but are not for the feint hearted as this is where you will find gay/Bi men cruising and sexual acts are common in the more secluded areas particularly at the end of the day (sadly much evidence of their activities litters these areas) - so avoid or enjoy.

reviews.text: Beautiful sand with clear blue sea, very shallow and safe for children and elderly. Shops nearby and beach sellers with delicious fruits and mojitos!

reviews.title: great
reviews.text: I had a very good time in Mallorca, playa del Muro and Gaviotas hotel! Must go!!! Must be ab 4 Stars hotels. Otherwise, full of kids and Mosquitos.

reviews.title: Unbelievable, beautiful sea!
reviews.text: Unbelievable, beautiful sea!This is the best Spanish beach we’ve ever been too.Clean sand clear water, one issue storm hit for half an hour, but when the sun shone again, heaven.We we’re staying north of the peninsula in Alcudia and traveled south to Muro. Next time we will go to a hotel on this beach, sorry Hotel More.Also it will mean we won’t have to use the Taxi service. In Mallorca it’s absolutely rubbish don’t bother. Wait for an hour doesn’t turn up.Take a bus, hire a car or walk. Many people said they will not return to Mallorca just because cab service is crap.

reviews.title: Clean, safe,
reviews.text: Went to this beach many times september 2022, very clean, quiet and safe, some great walks plenty to do or to just sit and relax,

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I've visited Muro beach a few times and it's gorgeous. It's a wide sandy beach with sunbeds/shades available at a charge but also plenty of space if you just want to.lie on a towel on the beach. The sea is gently shelving and tends to be calm so perfect of everyone including families.There are toilets on the edge of the beach and a number of shops/restaurants very close by.

reviews.title: Amazing day trip
reviews.text: White sand, hot weather and amazing walk along the Muro beach. No problem with the parking although the more you drive far the cheaper beds and umbrellas are which is a benefit if you are on the beach every day with a group of friends. Enjoy

reviews.title: The best beach in Majorka
reviews.text: Ideal bright soft sand, safe place for children - shallow water, lifeguard, Showers at the entrance to the beach. This part of the beach where I was, is not very commercial, it was quiet and peaceful.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A beautiful long stretch of beach with white sand and very clear blue water.It was very crowded on the day we visited but there we lots of parasols and chairs for hire.

reviews.title: Nice sandy white beach with very clean water
reviews.text: Nice sandy white beach with very clean water. There is a local bar (not sure about working hours because seems like it works about 4-5hours). As part of the bar is regular, clean toilets. Sun beds and umbrella with safe cost around 16 euros. Parking is free and large and it can be found at the beginning of this long beach. Beach provides a very beautiful view of the sea.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful setting. great views and superb facilities. Loads of sun beds available. Great beach bars .

reviews.title: Nice water
reviews.text: Nice water but in comparison to the other beaches of this island too many tourists and much dirtier. The pier in the picture is crowded with people during the day. Restaurants on and around the beach require reservations for dinner.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Beautiful,  clean and child friendly beach. Hired a pedalo 18 euros the kids loved it. Lack of beach bars though

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: The beach was on the doorstep to our hotel. Lovely warm shallow sea and golden sand. A pair of sunbeds cost 15 euros for the day and the parasols all have safes attached to them. Pedalos were 20 euros and were great fun.

reviews.title: Favourite beach in Mallorca!
reviews.text: We stayed in different parts of Mallorca for 10 days and this beach was our absolute favourite by far! If you plan to spend the day here, be sure to either pack a lunch or book reservation at one of the beach clubs for lunch!

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach but does get busy be careful near the pier as it can get rough and there is a current there which can make it difficult to get out of lifeguards were always watching.

reviews.title: what an amazing beach!
reviews.text: What a great beach at any time of day!  Watch the sunrise, go for a paddle or dip, jump on a jet ski or parasail, all under the watchful eye of a life guard.  Anything is possible on the beach in Alcudia.

reviews.title: Not what it seems - nicer beaches around
reviews.text: An okay beach that was very crowded and narrow. Felt very packed and you need to swim quite far out in order to get deeper into the ocean. Two beds were €15 for the day and comes with a safe box to put belongings. I wouldn’t be visiting again purely because the pictures couldn’t be further from what we had experienced!

reviews.title: Playa Muro
reviews.text: The beach was great. The water was beautifully warm. It’s easy to rent an umbrella with two chaise lounges…just beware those umbrella corners smack you in the head if you’re not with it.

reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: Amazing Beach, 8th time here and keep coming back for more. Only advice is orange labels on beds means reserved so hop on any without and pay the guy who comes round usually between 10.30 and 12.

reviews.title: Dangerous Playa de Muro beach, under water curents .
