reviews.title: Best beach of Mallorca. Hands down
reviews.text: Please stop looking, I've been coming to Mallorca over 15 years now and this is the best beach of the island. It's clean, (relatively) quiet, beautiful, sandy, blue seas and this is where all the locals go, miles of white beaches. We love coming here every year :)

reviews.title: Beautifull beach with a lot of sellers.
reviews.text: the beach is very nice, clean with  blue water. 🏝😍 but a lot of sellers and people who offer a massage are very annoyed.  Every 10 minutes there are 5 people who disturb my peace.  I don't think it's okay.. i don't like it !😫

reviews.title: A day at the beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of sun umbrellas chargeable of course. The sea is just perfect for the little ones quite shallow ......there was even a guy going round the beach picking up cigarette stumps with a fishing net and we didn’t see anyone leaving any rubbish behind.

reviews.title: Lovely area
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach with clear blue water. Great views of the mountains both sides and Port Alcudia in the distance. Lots of nice restaurants, bars, cafes, shops etc in the area.

reviews.title: Very safe and sandy beach
reviews.text: Highly recommend this beach as it is very clean and safe for children and easily accessible.  Downside.... all the sellers continually coming along selling merchandise and especially the massage people, drives you mad, but suppose this is the norm at most resorts these days sadly.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: An amazing clean beach with crystal clear waters ,my family didnt believe i was in spain .Beautiful and stunning

reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: Thanks to the locals and the Beach Clean initiative the beach barely had any litter. You could literally walk 4 miles easily along the beach. Interesting inlets and piers along the way. Much better this year than 2 years ago when it was covered in fly invested seaweed. No sign of seaweed this year.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: lovely stretch of beach leading to Alcudia. parasailing was good with Jose. sun loungers a plenty. shops nearby. everything decently priced

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: Gorgeous sea and sand. And seems really safe for paddling and bathing for children as it stays shallow for ages.

reviews.title: Sandy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful white sands nice walk to alcudia or jump on the sea bus to alcudia port well worth a visit

reviews.title: Around and about
reviews.text: Being April nothing was open as it was just start of season. When shops and cafes did open there wasn’t very much only supermarkets small gift shops and a few cafe/bars really only one street

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Beautiful, long, white and sandy beach. Shallow turquoise water - great for safe bathing with children. Highly recommended if you're looking for a good beach to take the family for a swim.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach
reviews.text: Lots of water sports to try on the beach. A clean and beautiful beach for all to enjoy.  Lovely turquoise waters.

reviews.title: beach
reviews.text: nice clean beach .great for family's as nice & shallow ..A few bars along the beach front to get drinks ice creams etc..shaded areas along the area by a few trees which is great to keep out of the sun when needed

reviews.title: Soft white sand, gently sloping sea, crystal clear water
reviews.text: Great for families. Very safe. Clear water. No big waves. No lifeguards but it was April and you could walk into sea for ages and only be up to your knees

reviews.title: Bustling
reviews.text: This is such a beautiful long beach that I can see why so many people come here. This means that it is more attractive to those looking for liveliness than solitude. A little nippy in spring and the breeze can be cool - which is of course a delight in summer.

reviews.title: Romantic getaway
reviews.text: Very impressed. Lovely resort and beach. Food lovely, great variety. Great attentive staff . Very picaresque. Will return!!

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: We visited end of March beginning of April, a little too cool to swim - especially with the wind coming off the sea but no less a beautiful beach. Always better when not too busy and it was relatively quite when we visited. Can’t say what it’s like when it’s packed full of people though but definitely a great beach of Mallorca.

reviews.title: good time
reviews.text: hotel clean and friendly entertainment available day and evenings.rooms serviced every day dnd sign if you want to lie in.ours was self catering but the option to buy meals available and snacks made to order

reviews.title: beautiful colors!
reviews.text: A very clean beach. The water is full of greens, blues and turquoises. The power of the sun is not to be underestimated.

reviews.title: Overcrowded
reviews.text: Ok for kids but not more, if you like long beach walks you will enjoy it, supermarket and cafè's along the way

reviews.title: My relaxed break away
reviews.text: Needed a quiet break and that’s exactly what I got and how nice this place was too !! Will deffo return!!

reviews.title: Word of warning
reviews.text: This is a magnificent beach and we have been to it several times.  No problem at all.  We even went on a fine day during our trip in October 2018 and enjoyed ourselves.However, on our last morning we decided to go back in spite of heavy rain and I went for a swim.  The water was utterly calm but there was a long reddish cloud in the water which stretched about a hundred metres.  Something told me not to swim through it, but I did go up to the edge of it to try and see what it was.  Unfortunately, proximity made me none the wiser.  Red algae, pollution from the nearby power station?  I don’t know, but the result when I got home was the red rash you see in the picture, and this in spite of using a beach shower just after swimming.  This rash took over three weeks to fade away.  It wasn’t particularly itchy but required a cream with hydrocortisone to master it.There was exceptionally heavy rainfall in Mallorca during that month and most of you are probably not going to go swimming in the rain anyway, but I thought it best to share this in case!

reviews.title: Great family beach
reviews.text: This is a great family beach. You can go out pretty far as the water is not very deep. When the sea is calm, its crystal clear. Sun beds are available to rent and there are activities on the beach at various spots. The beach goes on for a couple of miles so it never tends to feel overcrowded.

reviews.title: Long sandy beach
reviews.text: Cracking beach, long and sandy great for walks, safe. Lovely, coffee shops cafes scattered along the front.

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: The best beach we've been in Mallorca. Cristal clean water, white sandy beach, warm and clear water with easy going into.Superb place.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Quite a vast beach, beautiful white sand, no debris, and shallow waters making it great for bathing and for families. Boat tours are good, we went on the one to Formentor which we would recommend. You can see the fish as water is crystal clear.

reviews.title: Clean and beautiful beach.
reviews.text: A good beach for children and adults. Low water and flat bottom without rocks and dangerous waves. Clear water and not debris. Long beach so the space is definitely for everyone.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Fantadtic beach shallow sea for quite a good distsnce very busy at the weekends Idesl for kidsNeed to be early tk bag a sunbed and parasll

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach, got to pay for loungers and some people reserve them so beware. Some jelly fish when we were there but a fantastic beach all the same.

reviews.title: Peaceful and Picturesque
reviews.text: Well worth the visit. Peaceful and a great walk. Early morning was better for sunlight. So quiet....

reviews.title: Short break
reviews.text: Very nice and friendly town ,clean and relaxed , plenty of places to eat and drink . Very safe and clean beach and sea

reviews.title: Best Beach in Mallorca
reviews.text: This beach is absolutly Paradise , defently recomenden when you are going to mallorca , one part of the beach is a nude Beach just to your info if you should have anything to that

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Lots to do on the beach. paddle boards, jet skis. windsurfing  Not many English. We played football with the Spanish every day

reviews.title: beautiful long beach
reviews.text: the beach is amazing with gorgeous white sand and blue green sea. Perfect for long relaxing strolls or running, if that's what you prefer. Would be great if this stunning beach could be equally enjoyed by wheelchair users, so a parallel footpath would be a great addition, as suggested by a previous reviewer.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: I used to walk for about an hour each day along the beach to Porto Alcudia.  Very clean sandy beach, although I didn't venture into the sea it looked as if it was shallow for quite a way

reviews.title: Inflatables
reviews.text: 10€ for an hour! So much fun and would return. Quite tiring though but well worth the money. Sea and beach is lovely.

reviews.title: Lovely soft sand
reviews.text: Lovely soft sand to walk down. Lots of sun loungers if you wanted to stay there all day. Beautiful views. Close to amenities. However, no wheelchair access, so if you’re disabled and want to walk or go along the beach, there is no prom or walkway running along the beach, for you to enjoy. I think putting a walkway along the back edge of the beach would make it perfect, as this would help pushchairs and less able people to enjoy such a wonderful stroll along a lovely beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach 🏖
reviews.text: During our stay in Muro we visited the beach, a must for any holiday and it was beautiful!Easy to access and not too far from our hotel.  Very clean and lovely white sands.There are sun beds to hire with umbrellas if you need shade.It wasn’t too busy when we visited so didn’t look overcrowded!

reviews.title: nice sandy beach
reviews.text: A bit crowded during season, about 5 raws of sun unbrellas, but not as much as in El Arenal. Sand beach is nice with shallow water, suitable for children. Also good to walk along the beach.

reviews.title: Lovely soft sand!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful sandy beach, large and has lots of parasols and relaxers. Close to amenities and shops/restaurants. Very clean and shallow water so good for Children.

reviews.title: LOVELY BEACH
reviews.text: Lovely sandy beach with lots of activities and places to eat and drink also you can walk on the beach in either direction

reviews.title: Long Clean Beach
reviews.text: Great beach. No stones, pebbles or shells. Great to walk along at waters edge for a chill or in for a swim. Plenty sun beds at  €6.50 a day complete with thatched parasols. The post of the parasol have small dates attached for your valuables should you want to goIn for a swim and are worried about your valuables. Loads of place to even just stick your towel down on the sand. Plenty stores and eating places but probably slightly higher priced due to location.

reviews.title: nothing here
reviews.text: This is a very boring place. Even for a couple nearing sixty!The best part of this place is the bus stop to Alcudia or can picafort.

reviews.title: Lovely clear water, shallow great for kids
reviews.text: A bit too busy for my liking so didn't stay long, but went for a swim, the water is crystal clear, you could see lots of fish.There is a jetty for the boats to dock for trips.

reviews.title: Windy but beautiful
reviews.text: Very busy even in October. Red flagged for 3 days of our stay. Soft white sand, clear turquoise sea. Very wavy and fun

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: The beach here is lovely.  Soft sand and clear water. The water is shallow for a long way out so it's great for kids. We swam out a bit further and with goggles realised there were fish swimming with us so take your snorkeling equipment. We didn't use the loungers but apparently you have to pay. A beach towel on the sand was just fine.

reviews.title: Love this beach!
reviews.text: The Beach here is fantastic and never that busy really. The walk from Ca'n Picafort is pleasant and you can walk further to Alcudia!

reviews.title: Miles of white sand and beautiful clera sea to swim in.
reviews.text: although busy in late September, still plenty of places to lay your towel or rent a sun lounger with parasol (6.5 euro) for the day (10.00-18.00). A few snack bars dotted along the way, more so closer to Alcudia old town.

reviews.title: Very flat beach with fine sand
reviews.text: The beach is flat, so that kids can be in the water with safety risk. The beach is quote long and if you walk some meters you will find enough space were it is not crowded.

reviews.title: About the clothing optional part of this beach
reviews.text: Like on some other beaches, also Playa de Muro features a clothing optional or nudist part. That part is also where rainbow families enjoy the sea side. As often, if you’re not a local, it is hard to find. Therefore see my enclosed map. The nudist part is next to an old tower and not far from the wooden boardwalk that goes through the nature reserve. There are parkings on either side of the nature reserve. Tags: naturist, clothing optional, gay beach

reviews.title: Nice but can be very busy
reviews.text: Often walked this beach it is nice but can be so busy you have step over people. Generally it is clean & well maintained.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Great sandy beach kept clean great for family with children as lifeguards are on duty all day shallow calm sea, parasol and sun bed are for hire with a safe box.fresh fruit are on sale from a lively vendor

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: I stayed there for 3 days and it’s really nice beach beautiful clear water nice sand pretty clean some shadow by the trees at some places. A very long and nice beach

reviews.title: Safe
reviews.text: Lovely beach very shallow so have to walk quiet a way to be able to swim.Peddle  boats to hire €20 for a hour great fun.A small jetty where you can catch the many boat trips from.Close enough to shops & restaurants to grab some lunch and take back to the beach..one end of the beach they have showers & WC ....

reviews.title: Clean white sand beach
reviews.text: Gentle entrance to the sea, very convenient for children. The beach is cleaned daily. Sun loungers are paid.

reviews.title: Very long stretch of sandy beach, gorgeous water
reviews.text: Officially this beach runs from Alcudia to the end of Can Picafort, but unofficially the beach has been divided into different names along the way, to identify which part of the beach you're at.  The Playa de Muro part now runs after Can Picafort township towards Alcudia and this is an amazing part of the beach.  The water is gorgeous - a marine blue/green colour, light waves and soft sand.  Because most people choose the more popular Can Picafort part, when you're at Playa De Muro you'll find it's very quiet, lots of room and a quite isolated.  It's a perfect relaxing beach but has limited sun beds.

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach
reviews.text: Lots of beach bars supermarkets nearby. Boats collect from pier out from beach and take you along coast... water us and glass bottomed boats.Still very warm end of September

reviews.title: perfection and relaxation
reviews.text: the beach at playa de muro  is fantastic you have ammenities close by beach  restuarants the water is pretty shallow for kids up untill aboute 20 metres out there is also a pickup point for boats trips up and down the island well kept beach and gorgeous weather

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach. Areas for sunbed rental. Sea is great to swim in, crystal clear, no weeds or stones. You can walk out quite far before it gets deep. Lots of water sports going on, parasailing, banana boats, jet skis. Great area for families too

reviews.title: Beautiful long clean beach
reviews.text: On of the most beautiful beaches Mallorcas. Clean. Fine sand a fine temperature of the sea. Clear water. Suitable for children.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This beach is just lovely. There are lots of fish that swim all around you and the water is so clear you can see them. Very nice and clean. There is a lady walking around with fruit. Would deffo recommend. Fruit is so fresh, sweet and juicy.

reviews.title: Clear blue sea
reviews.text: Fantastic Beach ideal for long walks water sports shallow swimming and sunbathing.Playa de Muro has cute Coconut style shades and sun loungers and they were around 14 euros a day to hire for 2. If you walked for 10 minutes up the coast towards alcudia it gets a bit more lively and there is a Jetti that you can walk out onto and dive from at the end or take a boat trip

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach with shallow and clear water, you need to walk a lot to get to deeper levels, so it's really good for older people and kids. You can hire chairs+ umbrellas+ safety box for around 14 euros a day, or you can get each separate at different prices. It is a quiet and pleasant beach as there are no bars or restaurants on it. We really enjoyed our stay here.

reviews.title: A Fantastic beach restaurant
reviews.text: The best beach restaurant I have ever had the pleasure to eat at. Great food that is served by super friendly staff and a wine list to match the smiles.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach Great family beach.. €13.50 for 2 sunbeds 1 parasol and lockable safe box!! Great idea.. loved the mojito lady fresh drinks made at sunbed. Toilets /shops very close top beach !!

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: I really like this beach,the sand is lovely.It doesn't get too deep too quickly when going in the sea.Ideal for families which means it can get busy at times.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We loved this beach. gorgeous sand, shallow waters and the wooden pier to walk along where you can get the boat trip from....we will be back!

reviews.title: Crystal clear waters
reviews.text: Well kept and clean beach and waters. The water is crystal clear and warm, it makes you feel like your in the Caribbean. It does get crowded but it is to be expected as the beach itself is quite narrow. Perfect for children due to the shallow calm waters.

reviews.title: relaxing beach
reviews.text: Nice and clean beach. It is public so you have to pay for the sunbeds and parasol. And have to say there is a lady selling fruits and coconuts so so funny.

reviews.title: Best holidays ever
reviews.text: Thanks to the hotel's team for the best holidays ever :-) Wonderful beach, excellent food, perfect service and friendly staff! The only issue – the bottle of water in the room was refilled every three days, not enough…

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: We love this area and keep coming back every year for our holiday. I cannot recommend this enough for everyone - regardless if couples or families.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: A lovely clean beach with lots of amenities. There's shops near bar with bars on the beach and water activities. My brother was also injured in the sea and the medical staff were very helpful.

reviews.title: A proper sandy beach
reviews.text: Playa de euro is a proper sandy beach that is easily accessible. Clean and suitable for children.  Also, it is well-organised and you can rent sunbeds for the day.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Only spent a few hours on the beach but thought it was nice. Really liked the fact it had little lockers on the parasols that you could hire to keep your valuables. That way if you were a couple you can go into the sea together without having to worry about your smart phone etc.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, has loungers on with brollies you can pay a small fee to have one of these for couple hours or the day, plenty of shops on the sea front to get snacks and drinks and it has a toilet block, there is even a massage station on the beach perfect.. the sand is perfect and the water is beautiful even at night we sat on the beach at 10pm and it was delightful the tied never comes right in so can have a sit on a seat and you don’t have to pay at night.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach, crystal clear water. The sun raise is spectacular do not miss it if you visit the Muro Beach.

reviews.title: Very save
reviews.text: This is the most safest beach I have ever been. You walk into it 150 meters and the level of the water is not deeper than 1m. Very shallow and clean. You can see lots of fishes. This place is very popular amongst people with kids.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!
reviews.text: The beach is lovely and clean, water only waist high for quite a while out. Can happily walk straight in on a warm day as a result as the water is like a luke warm bath. It's nice that the water isn't taken up by watersports everywhere, plenty of space for swimmers to relax in the water. The €6.50 each per day for a lounger was a little steep for us, but there is still plenty of room for lounging on a towel.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, lots of facilities, water sports and shops close by. Warm clear shallows. Worth a visit :)

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Brilliant beach, the water was amazingly clear with a healthy population of small fish close to the shore, I counted 6 different varieties and that was without snorkelling. The beach is ideal for children learning to swim as it does not get deep for a while witch also means that there is a lot space in the sea.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and water. We came here every day. Was so gorgeous and not over crowded. Sand and sea was like Caribbean!!!!!

reviews.title: Long beach with blue colour water
reviews.text: Beach is very wide, with fine sand, bars and restaurants around, even water activities. Great for kids as sea is shallow for at least 15 meters in to water. Just perfect for small kids.Beyond 15 meters water goes deper.A bit windy but no big deal.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Lovely clear water, nice mini piers into the sea. Gets very crowded in high sea but well worth a day out.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Wow wow wow!!The most amazing beach I have been too.The sea is crystal clear and very warm.You can walk out very far and still only waist high. My daughters and son loved swimming in the sea, and I did too. So much activity to do too.5 star beach Picture taking from in the sea

reviews.title: Sandy beach. Clear water. Beautiful!
reviews.text: Playa de Muro has a terrific beach. Lots of soft white sand. The beach is groomed every morning to smooth it and remove any seaweed that has washed ashore. The warm is warm and clear, and shallow for a great distance. You can walk out quite a way and still be only waist deep. The water is very calm in the morning; small gentle waves in the afternoon. You can walk for many kilometers on the beach, which is always a fun and relaxing this to do. The beach is in an inlet or bay and has great views surrounding it, including some small mountains. Lounges and shelters are available to rent on the beach. Beautiful!

reviews.title: Beach at Esperanza hotel is lush
reviews.text: This beach is combed every night, the water is warm, and has great clarity and colour. One of the best beaches I’ve been to. Lots of options for beds with security boxes available too.

reviews.title: Crystal
reviews.text: Crystal clear waters. Absolutely beautiful. Stunning. Can walk out for roughly 300m and still just be stood up to your chest.

reviews.title: Lovely beach. Great for families and couples
reviews.text: Apart from the customary annoying Looky Looky men, everything about it is great. Lovely sea, great for families.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Hot water, clean sand, wide beach . Services available on the beach . Entertainment programs upon request.

reviews.title: Nice water, large beach
reviews.text: Nice water, large beach. Clean, but it could have been cleaner. Showers are pretty far away. Chaise-longs not cleaned in the morning, although there is a tax.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Can get very crowded, but a stunning beach and view. Areas appear to be for hotel guests from near by hotels but plenty of room and close to restaurants and WCs

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Beautiful beach , shallow warm clear waters, great for children, did get quite crowded but was very clean

reviews.title: Stunning Beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach which was very busy on our visit with some beds available to hire. The warm water was so relaxing. Other guests at our hotel complained about so many jellyfish but we didn’t see any on our visit. A gorgeous beach! Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Very nice.
reviews.text: Very clean beach with lots of sunbeds and umbrellas. Usual charge for the day. The sea is very clean and you can walk out for quiet a bit before the sea gets deep .

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: The fact that you here more Spanish speakers on this beach then British tells us it must be a good one. Didn’t know the sea did this is Mallorca. You just walk for ages before it gets deep and then gets shallow again. Has a lovely chilled family / friend vibe going off. Worth a visit for the day at least.

reviews.title: Golden sands and clear water
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach with calm shallow waters. Great for young kids. Boat tours bookable on the jetty.

reviews.title: Nice beach to spend time
reviews.text: We found lots of people across the beach and it was quite crowded, however you can still relax and have a sea bath.Good location though however there are other beaches which you will enjoy more with children like Aucanada Beach.For toilets, you need to use Restaurant or Cafe toilets.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, very blue calm sea and sand. The only thing is, there are hundreds of jellyfish so you cant really swim properly in it (some are huge and you wouldnt want them stinging you thats for sure) very very busy as well, cant really relax as so many people.. but the beach itself is beautiful

reviews.title: Good & bad
reviews.text: Great location directly on the beach with good views, shame about the poor service and disgusting toilets.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: lovely beach which was always busy lifeguards on the ball , plenty for children to do along it and the water not too deep for the children

reviews.title: gorgeous beach
reviews.text: lovely clear waters with a gentle incline , perfect for childrenGreat to have a lifeguard on duty too

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: nice clean beach with showes ,toilets and life guard  en enough spots to eat a burger or a pizza en supermarket to buy cool drinks

reviews.title: Lovely, clean, safe beach
reviews.text: Just spent 10 days here and loved the beach!  The water was warm and crystal clear - thankfully the jelly fish that had been bothering people had cleared off by the looks of things.  It's safe to swim, assuming there's a green flag, as there's a lifeguard on duty and the safe areas are clearly marked out.  We had a go at paddle boarding further along the beach (mixed ages too, 59, 54 and 14 year old son!)  Hired a board for 16 Euros for an hour, which the 3 of us shared - best laugh we had all holiday! - and yes, we did all manage to stay upright, eventually!

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Wow what a nice beach amazing how clear the water is and how far you can walk into the see. I really like the size of the beach as this one has lots of space and you will not feel overwhelmed by the may people around you.

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach nice views of Menorca
reviews.text: Its nice white sand and clear blue shallow water is perfect for families, great sand for sand castles.

reviews.title: As good as the Caribbean if not better!
reviews.text: Remarkable how similar the appearance of the beach is to those we visited in the Caribbean. It is very gently shelving beach so is perfect for families. Arrive early and park at the Albufera nature reserve car park just the other side of the main canal. We will definitely be coming back to stay at one of the hotels.

reviews.title: Best family beach ever!
reviews.text: Crystal clear, pure sand, no rocks, so safe and user friendly. Sand beautiful. Lots of amenities and activities available. Lifeguard.

reviews.title: Amazing place, perfect for families.
reviews.text: Long shallow beach that allows the children to play safely and grown ups to go far out. Crystal clear water, wonderful sand and lovely views. The beach feels safe both on and off the beach and the life guards is constantly monitoring all activity. I hope we will be back!

reviews.title: Fantastic for families
reviews.text: Have just returned from a lovely week and this beech was a highlight. Clean, clear and so shallow for such a long way out. Our 10 and 7 year old boys loved it, they could walk out such a long way and as such in August it didn't ever feel busy. We had so much space to play in the lovely warm water.  The fruit seller is hilarious and his fruit amazing, expensive but amazing as he cuts it up for you to eat there. It's just what you need when it's hot.Very highly recommend for families.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: Spent 10 days here in May this year, wonderful hotel, very friendly efficient staff will be going again next year

reviews.title: Holiday.. watch out for the jellyfish!!!
reviews.text: Beach is amazing, shallow clear waters for miles. Let down by the natural phenomenon that is jellyfish!! I’m frightened of them so didn’t go in the sea nearly as much as I’d have liked.. fab beach though with loungers shades and lifeguards. A pier with boat trips from and regular fruit and drink sellers along with the ‘lucky lucky men’ selling their wares... some great fakes to be had if you’re into that kind of thing. Enjoy, we did!

reviews.title: Very beautiful beach
reviews.text: One of the best beach in Europe. Sandy beach, unique sea, relaxing atmosphere. Bed and umbrella are not always nice.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Beautiful  beach . A must see. Shallow water and lovely pier to walk . Sunbed for hire . Also walking down in the evening.  Beautiful at that time

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach along the coast from Alcudia.  Sea incredibly warm this summer and very shallow so excellent for families.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: The beach here is great. Really clean, very sandy and lovely warm water. Definitely one of the best beaches I have been to in Majorica with plently of lifeguards and felt very safe

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, fine sand, clear water. You can walk and walk and walk and still is very shallow, perfect for kids.

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: We have a 16 month old son, and knowing the beach was so good here was one our main reasons to return. Miles of golden sand, well maintained sun beds. A word of warning, during our stay this year there were quite a few jelly fish as you ventured further out.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous long beach, lovely white soft sand. It was pretty clean and I didn’t see that much rubbish left at all. The sea is beautiful with it being quite shallow for quite a distance out which gives it the feeling that it’s not too crowded in the sea. Watch out for the odd jellyfish. The beach does get quite busy. You are charged around £14 euros for use of 2 sunbeds, a parasol and safe. There are quite a few of the guys coming round offering all kinds of goods for sale but it’s the constant question of “massage?” Which gets irritating after a while. Listen out for the guy selling fruit (really fresh and tasty fruit) and the lady selling cocktails...you can’t miss them really with their distinctive calls.

reviews.title: Fabulous beach, but not impressed with HomeAway
reviews.text: The 1 star is for HomeAway with whom we booked our holiday.  The beach is a 5 star beach.  BUT we love Majorca and have in the past  booked many happy holidays with Owners Direct in Majorca and in various countries and would not use any other company. Then they became HomeWay and we had to deal with a management company, 5starshome. Our villa (Villa Valeta  in Muro) was in a great location very close to a fabulous beach, but the villa was disappointing.  The kitchen was stocked with what appeared to be items from a jumble sale.  There were a total of three mugs and bowls and about 60 plates of varying sizes and designs.  No proper knives, only steak knives, and no bread knife. And we were told by the cleaners upon arrival that  WE DON'T PROVIDE BEACH TOWELS!The crack in the bathroom sink - there upon arrival- was not repaired whilst we were there. We reported very loose electrical socket situated immediately next to a tap in the bathroom - a real health and safety issue.  Repeated promises to fix were broken until after several days of phoning to chase, and having 5starshome staff raise their voices to me, and on one occasion slam the phone down on me, it was fixed with super glue  (we think by the cleaner's husband who said he was NOT an electrician, but very kind and keen to help.) There was no air con in the living areas which became horribly hot, humid and stuffy. The shutters all around the property were not well maintained and some stuck completely so we were unable to open or close them.  We did not bother to report as dealing with the company was too stressful.We were asked to submit a review by 5starshome , but it has not been published....We would return to the location in a heartbeat but will not use HomeAway or 5starshome Home again.

The umbrella will be reserved for you the entire day, so you can go back to your hotel and return later.There is also a safe on the umbrella! So dont be afraid of leaving your values while you go for a swim.The sea is clean and very calm.You will see small fishes swimming around your feet.Just wonderfull!

reviews.title: Amazing family beach
reviews.text: We visited this beach twice on our recent trip to Mallorca. The sand is fine, the beach is clean and extremely long and the water clear and shallow. It was literally perfect for our family with two children aged 6 and 8. On both occasions we drove down the Ma-12 and parked just past the Hotel Iberostar where parking was free. This stretch of beach seems to be slightly less crowded as there aren't the cluster of hotels backing the beach, although as a result there aren't sunbeds to hire. Bring a beach umbrella instead and lay on the sand!If there was one downside, there was a faint smell of sewage on the first day that crept in about an hour after our arrival. Not sure the cause or how long it lasted as we left. The smell was completely absent on our second visit. I believe you would be hard pressed to find a beach more suitable for kids to swim in the sea. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Aggressive peddlers ruin an amazing beach!
reviews.text: One of the most gorgeous beaches I have ever been to, and we usually vacation in Mexico or Thailand, so that is saying a lot. Soft sand, turquoise water, gentle waves, and shallow clear waters perfect for wading in. Unfortunately, as we were trying to relax on our towels and play with our kids, peddlers kept walking right between our towels and toys and tried to sell us cheap crap like knock off purses and sunglasses. Like every other minute! Our 6 year old politely said “No thank you” every time, but when the same people keep passing you by repeatedly, it gets annoying. By the 20th time, my husband had had it and told the guy selling a pile of scarves on his head to leave us alone. The guy completely lost it, set his stuff down and came at my husband aggressively and kept saying “I f*** your mother”. He caused a big scene on the beach over nothing , with everyone around us staring, and terrified our 2 young kids. He wouldn’t stop dropping the F-bomb and would not leave us alone, so we had to pack up and leave an hour after getting there, and ruining our last day in the area. The sheer volume of peddlers makes returning to this beach a turn off, and make sure you don’t piss any of them off!!!

reviews.title: The best beach on Majorca I think
reviews.text: Huge stretch of nice yellow sand, beautiful clean water, have been here in february so cannot say how many people come here in the summer

reviews.title: Fabulous family beach
reviews.text: If you are looking for a long beach with soft white sand, look on further.  It is incredibly clean, lots of sun loungers and umbrellas.The water is very clean and shallow, great for younger children.Lots of shops selling beach items and plenty of places to get food, drinks and of course ice creams

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: a very warm and beautiful beach, but dirty. For The sunbeds you have to pay.  There was a man selling fruits on the beach.

reviews.title: Nice and relaxing
reviews.text: We stayed in the local area at the end of October and had a lovely walk along he beach and a dip in the sea one day. The board walk was nice to see the fish, although some of the boards needed replacing.The atmosphere on the beach was relaxing and there were plenty of places to lay

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely, clean and quiet, golden sand beach. Has lifeguards, plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas. Beautiful clear waters.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Long beach, not too crowded and you can walk for long promenades ! Really nice. There is a promenade where parents can walk with pushchairs. Really easy for everyone.

reviews.title: Lovely beachside stay
reviews.text: We stayed in Muro for 5 days in March. Be aware that this is off-season so majority of places will be closed. There is also not much to do if you don't drive or choose not to use local transport. The beach was  5 minute walk from our hotel, and although the first few days were chilly, walks here became a regular thing. One of the good things about it being off-season was that it was pretty much empty so there weren't hoards of people trying to catch the sun. The water is beautifully clear although somewhat murky where the seaweed comes in, but that's just nature for you. There were also tractors picking up mountains of seaweed, most likely clearing it up for the summer tourists. Nice walk and if you choose to, can take you all the way to Alcudia.

reviews.title: My girlfriends birthday
reviews.text: We drove to this beach and wow it’s like a hidden gem, glad we found this quiet relaxing beach, noticed there was only 1 place to eat but didn’t care as we enjoyed the beautiful water and sand.

reviews.title: Great for Kids and Sport
reviews.text: This beach offers plenty of recreational opportunities. Great smooth sloping, facing to the East allows beautiful green/blue hues in the water.

reviews.title: White sand and a blue water
reviews.text: Perfect to rest and swim with kids. We have been there three times and almost satisfied every time. But they could clean garbage from the sand better.

reviews.title: Beat the crowds
reviews.text: As others have said this beach is stunning and the waters crystal clear. Its on the same stretch as Alcudia beach and is just as nice but with half the people. Its quite funny to see people fighting for space when only a short walk away there's a beach that's empty by comparison.A walk to the end of the pier is a must to see the fish that get bigger as you walk out further. Bring a slice or 2 of bread and watch the mad frenzy.The water temp in late October is still quite warm.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful crystal clear waters! Recommend a walk along the pier! Stunning! Best beach I have ever been to in my life.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, kept clean and we went in May so wasn't too busy. There was plenty of restaurants and shops nearby.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Just a dream .. was bit windy but we went on late October.. so beautiful..we walk through.. The best beach I have ever seen xxx

reviews.title: Fabulous Playa de Muro, Majorca, Spain
reviews.text: Another excellent Majorcan  beach. We left our gorgeous Alcudia bay to jump the waves late Oct. at Muro beach.  Recommended by locals. Reassuring attentive lifeguards in attendance.

reviews.title: Playa de Muro Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, clean and tidy, plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas.  Nearby bars and restaurants.  Easy to get to on the local bus.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach for kids. Very safe sea which is shallow for a long way out. Only problem is all the illegal sellers on beach who don't leave you alone!!

reviews.title: Lovely October half term holiday
reviews.text: Playa de muro was perfect for an October half term break. Located between alcudia and can picafort both are a short bus journey and make great day trips. Plenty of restaurants are still open and no crowds, warm weather and a calm sea. The inflatable fun park was ideal for my children (aged 6 & 3), As was Dakota restaurant with its bouncy castle and the lovely swan pub for a British meal and cocktails which was really reasonably priced. Fun time and definitely will be returning!

reviews.title: Super beach
reviews.text: Really nice lovely beach, the best in the NorthClean no cig butts in the sand ! Nice beds was 22.25€ for 4 beds.

reviews.title: Fabulous beach
reviews.text: Visited on a cold and blustery day and even then the beach is a lovely space and would be wonderful on a sunny day.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We arrived to beach around 6pm, the sand is white and beach looks really nice. It might be different in high season and during "frequent" hours

reviews.title: lovely white sand and beautiful views
reviews.text: a stunning  beach with lovely views out towards Minorca. White sand and stunning blue gteen clear sea

reviews.title: Great sandy beach,safe swimming - with life guards and miles of walks.
reviews.text: The sea is warm by September after the Summer sun and safe for children and not so confident swimmers as it does not get deep for about 25 metres out. The beach seems to have life guards situated in towers every 1000 metres or so. Sun beds + parasol can be expensive to hire.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Fairly typical Med beach, not too busy in October.  We just walked along the shore for a bit didn't sunbathe or swim.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: We walked here from the hotel. It was full of people. We loved it. We went for a swim. It was nice and warm. Definitely refreshing. People were enjoying themselves. There was some water activities going on as well.

reviews.title: Totally beautiful
reviews.text: Totally beautiful beach , lovely blue and very clean . If you can watch the sunrise and the sunset it's beautiful xx

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Nice for kids as it's quite shallow. Great sand and very view with the mountains in the background. (of course) a bit crowded.

reviews.title: Beach views...
reviews.text: Fantastic views! Surrounded by a mountainous scene, the clear blue waters and golden sand serves as a great break from hotel pool life. The down side is that the beach as lovely as it is, is very small and can possible be considered over crowded. Close to local restaurants that serve great food I would recommend at least one visit.

reviews.title: Clean, shallow water, great for kids
reviews.text: Sandy bay stretching from Alcudia to Can Picafort. Various areas offering loungers, parasols, etc at different costs. We went paddle boarding on the stretch of beach just before the canal. Exits from the beach all offer free showers.

reviews.title: Shallow and safe
reviews.text: A great beach for small children. Not deep for a while so children played safely and loved jumping the waves.

reviews.title: Very Safe
reviews.text: A very long beach and a safe ocean to enjoy. Lots of bars and restaurants located at the beach so you are spoilt for choice

reviews.title: Nice wide sandy beach, good for kids
reviews.text: Nice wide sandy beach stretching far out into the water, so the kids could wade out quite a way.  The main downside was that it was really crowded.

reviews.title: Very popular
reviews.text: Very popular beach - hence pretty crowded. Still nice to hang out for the day and people watch. Clean shallow water and lifeguards on watch.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very Clean sandy beach with sun beds and parasols. A couple of bars for food and drinks. A fair few pedlars on the beach who will continue to ask for sales but they are polite and leave you to it. The sea is very shallow and clear for quite a way out with very gentle waves and it’s a pleasant respite from the sun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, nice little family friendly resort
reviews.text: Stayed towards the end of the season. Beautiful long white beach with lifeguard cover and shallow waters. Ideal for families and those wanting a quieter relaxing break. Some good eateries and shopping too. Great bus links to Alcudia, Inca, Pollenca and Palma as well as a local taxi service. We loved it and will return. Very close to a nature reserve so would recommend you a prepared with mosquito repellents, they can be a bit bitey in the evenings :-).

reviews.title: the best of mallorca I think
reviews.text: very large and nice sand, slowly going down in the water, good survey services - this must be one of the best playas of the hole isle .  One negative point could be that many people knows that and it could be very crowded during high season

reviews.title: very nice uncrowded beach with lovley fine sand
reviews.text: small in width but long and really nice soft sand...claer blue sea a pleasent evening walk or sit in the sun,,,nice little beach terraces infrequently along too....not spoilt at all..

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Sandy beach with clear blue sea. Close to amenities and good quality sunbed, shades and safes with friendly beach staff. €13.75 For 2 all day. Toilets were free and fairly clean but often without paper and soap. Only drawback is lots of masseurs and sellers all day. It does get a bit too much when you're trying to relax.

reviews.title: Nice out of the way of bustle
reviews.text: Nice out of the way resort but with very good regular public transport to busier places .Sineu a good day out with bus at 9.15am and return at 1pm on Wednesdays, bus every 15mins to Port Alcudia Pollença etc

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Lovey beach. Plenty of bars and restaurants. Lots of shops nearby for food and souvenirs. Friendly atmosphere

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach to visit. Next to some bars and resturaunts. I think we paid €13 for two sunbeds for the whole day, lots of people trying to sell you rip off sunglasses/bags act though. There's a lady who comes round selling fresh fruit. Later on in the day she came back selling cocktails! Brilliant

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, if a bit busy
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful and water relatively shallow and crystal clear. It was pretty busy even at the end of September.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Nice beach with sunbeds or area to just to lay on sand. Public toilets and shower on the beach. Shops and cafes nearby

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Very long long beach and quite calm in October. Really peacefull place with a forest nearby. Recommend to stay there.

reviews.title: Ok but there are better beaches
reviews.text: Fine but not very sheltered there was always a breeze. For snorkeling and I recommend Cala Moullins about a 40 min drive

reviews.title: Beautiful, but avoid it in high season
reviews.text: Nice, warm, transparent water. Beautiful views. Completely crowded in August (It took 1 hour to park the car nearby and another 30-40 minutes to queue for lunch).Some of the umbrellas are "reserved" for the whole season, and I wonder why the local authorities allow this practice. It's nice to have a security box paying 1 euro more.avoid it in August

reviews.title: Sun burnt
reviews.text: We spent 2 days down on the beach with our rubber rings. Lovely crystal clear water and nice and warm. Water melon man was so funny srlling his fresh fruits.€12.75 for 2 sunbeds and umbrella for the day was very good also safe box €1.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: It's easy to stay near this beach at reasonable price. Good food all around  I didn't swim but many did sand is nice good for families

reviews.title: Great beach for children
reviews.text: A nice beach to spend some time with your children. Shallow water with perfect temperature. Don’t forget to try the pedal boats when you’re here.

reviews.title: Clean beach shallow clear water
reviews.text: Nice beach well kept with lifeguard stations and toilets / cafes suitable for families not sure about disabled access though

reviews.title: Great beach,
reviews.text: Good beach, plenty of activities. Good, safe swimming with plenty of lifeguards. Sunbeds on the expensive side, but just about enough open beach.

reviews.title: 4th year
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach, annoying people trying to sell glasses etc all the time..... remove these and would be heaven!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This a wonderful 7km beach. Very clean with public toilets and shops close by. Lots of wooded areas further up the beach for shade. The sea was very warm in early Oct. There was a small jetty where day trip boats come and go in the morning and back in the afternoon.This a fantastic beach for families and those who like a nice walk along the shore.

reviews.title: It was a beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Clean enough. Was not overcrowded, nor was there any litter to speak of. Very nice shallow water. And it the sea CAN be very calm (despite what cretins in the one-star section might claim) if the wind is coming from the right direction, or if there is little-to-no wind at all.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: The beach is lovely and sandy. We walked all way along to Alcudia in about an hour with a stop off for a drink.

reviews.title: Nice beach with beautiful clear water
reviews.text: The beach had light yellow sand and beautiful clear water. It is fairly shallow for around 50 metres so it is good for children and paddling out. On a hot day it is very busy due to all the surrounding hotels. A half an hour still from Alcudia Port down the Playa de Muro Beach just before dusk / sunset was very beautiful and highly recommended.

reviews.title: Even better than Puerto de Alcudia
reviews.text: Not so wide, that make it more the beach "confy" Another thing that are nice for us adoults, we do not need to walk 100m to come to deep water

reviews.title: one of the best "hotel+sandy beach" locations on Mallorca
reviews.text: Clean, it is ok if you stay in a hotel there, but not worth a trip from other locations, the hotels located further south from Alcudia and better since the beach does not get so busy, nice chairs, umbrellas and even a safe available for a reasonable fee up to 20 euro per day (2 chairs, umbrella, safe box)

reviews.title: Clean although crowded.
reviews.text: We spent a few hours on the beach out of the seven days we spent at Playa de Muro. That was enough. Although the beach was clean and the water warm it was too crowded for us, and this was after the schools were back in the UK. God knows what it's like in the peak season ! The area of Playa de Muro was nice and friendly but very Blackpooly .We hired a car for five days to see the islands coves and hidden ports and beaches, sadly we won't be returning due to the anti-tourist demonstrations and the anti-tourist graffiti written on the roads up the mountains. Never bite the hand that feeds you !

reviews.title: Overcrowded
reviews.text: overcrowded, not clean water. tiny beach, long but only 10-20 m wide. Playa de Alcudia is much better, and in Palma as well and other small beaches in this Island

reviews.title: Worst holiday ever
reviews.text: Was the worst place I have been to. No service, they take glasses but don't ask if you want another. We had no one offer to get a  drink meal times had to get ourselves.we had them spray chemicals while we were round pool to kill mosquitoes covering our towels and us. They spent all day cutting small area of grass and hitting people with bits from the strimer. They had a bad choice of all in on drinks, trying to charge for a lot of things in other hotels would be free. We got treated lovely by the bar they use near beech also table service. Shame hotel was not the same. The pool freezing. If you like mosquitoes, this is the place for you. I can play join the dots on my body, I have 11 bites on neck and face not including other body parts that got infected. Cost £50 at chemist, I advice all going to use there repelants as ours are useless. The jungle one and Badham's chemist one is useless.  The complex looks nice.

reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: Clean, beach, great views. Lovely atmosphere with lots of shops around it.  Would definitely recommend going there.

reviews.title: clear water,, nice sand
reviews.text: nice clear water, white sand,  sea is not deap... wonderful for children....the only problem,, there are some people offering massages

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water
reviews.text: A little too many "lookey lookies" on the prowl offering everything from melon and margueritas to sunglasses and massages.

reviews.title: Clean with lots of sun beds and sea shallow
reviews.text: We liked this beach as it was clean with lots of sun beds or you could just sit on the sands and it was close to bars etc

reviews.title: Lovely area, very clean, gorgoeus beaches and friendly people.
reviews.text: We stayed at the JS alcudimar hotel, great hotel, great area, hired a car to explore other beaches, Muro beach is clean and water is safe and clear, just beautiful. Pollensa a beautiful beach with lovely promenade and little cafes/restaurants. Toured the mountains, well worth the steep 'edges' Would definatley visit this area again.

reviews.title: Credit Card Warning
reviews.text: IBEROSTAR  Playa de Muro Village Review  WARNING : This hotel has taken money from my credit card against my request and their promise not to do so . I paid the hotel a full up front pro-forma invoiced  payment €9511.48 Euros eight months in advance for an all inclusive weeks holiday inclusive of tax’s .  On arrival to this hotel on 27th May 2017 my credit card was requested with reason given they needed for security of any debts I might incur during my stay . I was concerned that my credit card details could be compromised and asked to leave a cash deposit instead for security This was declined as potentially I could run up debts in excess of deposit . Given no compromise on this point by the receptionist I received an undertaking and assurance that the hotel policy was not to make any transactions from credit cards unless and on checking out debts did not get paid by clients . On checking out I was advised that no debts had been incurred by my party and there was nothing to pay .The receptionist at my request and with agreement from her manager wrote in Spanish on my checking out receipt that my credit card had not been used . On my return home to England I received an account from my credit card company showing in-excess of  £117 had been taken by the hotel without my consent or authorisation during my stay . The hotels Sub-director Daniel Garcia Marquez has confirmed this transaction from which I quote in part  “  charges were made without your authorization is true.” Further the hotel refuses to refund the money back to my credit card in defiance to my requests . No expiation has been offered by the hotel to justify what I have advised them of my considered fraudulent transaction .

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach stunning sea... there was a great water park in the sea but was too expensive in my opinion from other ones

reviews.title: Very clean
reviews.text: Very clean with clear and shallow waters. You will have to pay for sunbeds & umbrellas if you want to use them - around 10 Euro p/day. Toilet and cafe facilities. Nice long beach to walk along.

reviews.title: most beautiful beach i see in my life
reviews.text: Very nice , beautiful and quiet beach .perrfect to go and have fun with family and children .not dangerous and safe.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: We loved it .beautiful clean beach the sea was perfect not many shells or seaweed, the beach workers were great especially the fruit man and cocktail lady, sunbeds were pricey 14 euros for. Beds and a brolly with a safe for valuables. Always managed to get a bed , toilets and shower facilities also. Lovely place. One thing id go back for.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice place to go for a few hours. There is always a little space to lay & a massage table with shops and bars close by

reviews.title: Not that great
reviews.text: We took a walk from the hotel to the beach and I must say we have seen better, the beach was very crowded, the loungers were chained to the umbrellas so it looks like they don't trust persons, narrow beach sorry but not somewhere we would pay to lounge in

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is an amazing beach with beautiful sand and sea. There are a lot of people visiting this beach, but it is worth the crowd to take a dip in this entrancing blue sea!

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: The beach is kept very clean, sea absolutely lovely. I'm not a beach or sea person but spent 3 wonderful days on the beach. Lady comes around selling pineapple, coconut and melon. Very reasonable price and very tasty.

reviews.title: Nice bungalows and very good food
reviews.text: We would certainly recommend this hotel, except the beds. The beds are very hard, unfortunately you can feel the bed spirals in your back. If this is resolved for sure we come back one day. Because the food is delicious and the staff is very kind and helpfull.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach and beautiful clear water . Plenty of restaurants nearby and toilets and shower .you have to pay for sun beds etc but worth the charge I think .

reviews.title: A beautiful beach - but VERY busy
reviews.text: Playa de Muro Beach is a white sandy expanse of shoreline that stretches as far as the eye can see. In high summer, the water is beautifully warm and it's pretty shallow, so good for children and unconfident swimmers. However that does mean that the beach is PACKED. It's very noisy and has lots of sun loungers to rent. Trying to find a quiet spot away from the crowds is a bit futile. However, given how many people are on the beach it is incredibly clean. There are public showers and recycling points along the beach

reviews.title: Clean, sandy, perfect for children
reviews.text: Very nice, long, sandy beach with plenty of sun-chairs but also place to put the blanket down. Access to the water even and gentle, for good 70m shallow enough to stand even with big waves. Very clean. The only minus is lack of classical chiringuitos.

reviews.title: Greta
reviews.text: Loved this beach, beautiful and warm sea. Stunning. Sun beds are available and boats for the kids, you can actually walk right along the coast.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: what a lovely beach golden sand and clear waters cant go wrong. loads of families and couples enjoying the sun. if you see the mango lady selling fruit it will make your day haha shes amazing. loads of lucky lucky men selling crap tho which does ur heading all in all lovely place

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach, clear water, fine light sand, but overcrowded in the season. Beach is very long and you have possibility to go out of resort to free nature for several minutes and you reach nice quiet part of beach with a cup of poeple and still nice sea. There is no bar, nor noise, no music, no childers, simply you and sea and wind noice.

reviews.title: Nice sandy beach
reviews.text: The beach is long and shallow, perfect for children. Crowded when we visited in September, but you can always find a spot. The downside was that there was some garbage in the water (plastics and so on).

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: Lovely sandy beach with boat trips available and good snorkeling to see small fish.Beach is kept clean and plenty of sunbeds if you want to pay for them

reviews.title: BUSY BUSY BUSY
reviews.text: We read about this beach on a 'secret beaches' list so drove across the island to get to it. Just a tip - it is far from secret! It's the busiest beach around. When we pulled up in the nearly-full car park with fly-tipping everywhere, I knew something was up. A little walk through a pretty national park along a lovely wooden walkway reassured me. Then we descended onto the ten-foot strip on sand with 200,000 Russians on it, all fighting it out to have the biggest beer belly with the tightest budgie smugglers. I've attached a few pictures to give a realistic impression. One of the pics shows that the actual sea is really nice, and would be paradise if Yuri and Vladlina not been almost lying on top of me.We bailed after a few hours and drove to another place. If you are staying in the nearby towns, this would be a nice enough beach to have on your doorstep, but don't travel too far because your own local beach is bound to be better.

reviews.title: Beautiful and shallow
reviews.text: Came to this beach a few times! Lovely, clean and shallow waters...lots of fish swimming too! Even on an overcast day its lovely to visit!

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Very clean and plenty of paid sun beds with lockers with some  of them very shallow water so safe for all ages

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice and clean beach. Arrive before 10 am to have first row sunbeds. Water is not deep so it is suitable for small children. In the afternoon waves are bigger, but very funny.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Put quite simply. This is probably one of the best beaches I have ever been to. Soft golden sand, the sea is like being in a bath and the view is rather good too. It's so safe for kids because the sea is shallow. So even the youngest can have a dip. You also get the fruit man with his wheelbarrow full of fruit that comes round about 2-3 times a day selling pineapples, melon, coconut, mangoes and bananas. All freshly cut infront of you as so juicy and tasty. In the afternoon a lady walks round with a wheel barrow selling a cocktails. Further down the beach there's an inflatable assault course for anyone to do as long as you can swim out to it. There's also a boat that tows  an inflatable banana and an inflatable arm chair. Plus another boat the does parasailing. There are boats that come and go from the pier all day long for trips out to sea. Behind the beach there's a square that has a few restaurants,  a supermarket and a couple of bars. Most nights the square has a market on. Which is ok.

reviews.title: Very quiet and clean beach
reviews.text: Most wanted and beautiful beach.  Very clean, friendly and close to everything.  Umbrellas available for around €12 with two beds. Good food around.

reviews.title: Best beach I've ever been to.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Sunbed, umbrella and safe hire is around 15 euros but is worth it. The sea is very clear, warm and shallow although does go deep in some parts and then shallow again. There is a blow up obstacle course in the sea you can swim too also. 'Looky looky' men are around and do offer you watches and sunglasses etc but you just have to be polite and firm and they leave you alone. There is also a hilarious guy selling fresh fruit out of a wheelbarrow, his sales pitch is hilarious. I'm not sure if it's a chant or a song but it works and I bought a huge slice of watermelon and 3 bananas for 5 euro. There is also a lady who has the same sales pitch selling cocktails. It's hilarious to watch. Take a walk along the pier and watch the fish!

reviews.title: wonderful beach with several sand banks
reviews.text: excellent beach with warm and clear water where one could stay the whole day.not a lot of space to lay a towel between the chairs for rent and the water though

reviews.title: The most exciting thing in Boring Playa De Muro
reviews.text: Playa De Muro is possibly the most boring place on the planet, unless of course you just want to lie on the beach for your entire holiday, in which case it is perfect for you, as the beach is absolutely beautiful. But don't expect to leave the beach after sunning yourself all day and find any sort of night life / entertainment, other than what your hotel provides. When we booked our two weeks holiday we were told that there is plenty to do in and around Playa De Muro, well that simply isn't true. There are some good restaurants, serving really good food, but very little atmosphere

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Stunning beach and crystal clear blue water. €12 for the day for 2 loungers and parasol. €1 for safe for valubles. Only downside is constant flow of men trying to sell you stuff such as, watches, sunglasses ect. Was hard to relax with them keep asking you everytime they pass and it got very annoying. Lovely Spanish lady selling gorgeous fruit however!

reviews.title: Sandy
reviews.text: Lovely blue sea sandy beachs lots of sunbeds pay for the umbrellas.. choice to go on jet skis paragliding.. you can walk far out to sea.. and still swim

reviews.title: Crystal clear water
reviews.text: Unbelievable crystal clear water , the stretch of the beach is so long and is so clean.Really worth a swim as the water stays really shallow before going really deep in the distance but you can walk out so far best beach in Majorca

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach clear sea soft sand. Goods sun beds umbrellas and safe box is needed all at a cost.

reviews.title: Fabulous local beach clean with excellent facilities
reviews.text: Had a lovely day here next to the pier , kept the kiddies entertained looking and feeding up the fishes , nice and shallow except for the end where the boats docks for day trippers ! Toilet facilities good no problems with looky looky men, stay away from the fruit sellers they are unlicensed! Will return again another year, clean clear water and a view across the bay to the mountains, what's not to like!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Approx 7km of fine sandy beach with crystal clear water . very shallow so great for kids. Plenty of sunloungers to hire as well as watersports .

reviews.title: relatively quiet beach considering peak season
reviews.text: Clean,gently shelving narrow beach, safe for children although slightly tidal. quite a hike along the beach especially with 2 kiddies buggies.

reviews.title: Beach is great for a run, loads of cycle hire places
reviews.text: Light clean sand with crystal clear waters ....great for a beach holiday .Hired a BMC Grandfondo from the shop up the road. The bike was top quality, cycling is amazing, with mountains, flats, hills and compliant traffic.

reviews.title: Our favourite beach
reviews.text: Playa de Muro beach in our opinion is just amazing. This was our fourth year here and we still love it. The beach is clean and family friendly. The sea is blue and shallow so the kids are safe playing out on their inflatables, riding the waves. A huge inflatable in the sea for adults and kids alike and the usual pedalos etc for hire. Plenty of beach bars for refreshments. We walked along the beach to Can Picafort and accidentally discovered the nudist beach (kids thought it was hilarious!) so be aware if you intend walking this route. We will most likely be back again near year 😀

reviews.title: Nice Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We were there for a week, a sandy nice beach however in most days there was lots of woody stuff in the shoreline which made it difficult to enjoy it.

reviews.title: Brilliant, very nice sea.
reviews.text: The beach was very relaxing, offering sunbeds, they are usually taken though. The sand wasn't very hot either, which was very good. People do come around with sunglasses, watches, beach towels and offering hair braids etc. The sea wasn't cold at all, it was quite warm. And so shallow! You could definitely walk 90 metres into the sea and still be up to your knees. My three year old sister could go in the ocean on her own, being safe. Although I did keep a very close eye on her and rarely let her alone. There are shops nearby, selling lilos, water, fruit, lollys and all the things to supply you for the beach. I recommend very much coming to this beach if you're stopping in Playa de Muro or alcudia! :)

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very busy but very clean. Close too several cafes etc for a refreshment when it gets too hot. Many families there with small children so I assume it can be considered safe.

reviews.title: Nice sandy beach
reviews.text: Nice sand. Sea is very shallow so it is suitable even for little babies. Also it is very warm. But during the waves there can be too much water plants on a sand.

reviews.title: walking
reviews.text: good for us as we wanted long walks so we did it every day, good for children as is not so deep sand, sun, fun

reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.text: Great spot to relax while in Majorca if you are traveling with kids. White sands, long beach and a lovely pier. There are . restaurants along the way and some voleyball courts. Its a bit far away from the alcudia center but the beach is definitely better

reviews.title: Plenty to do
reviews.text: There are loads of water activities available including Banana Boats, giant inflatable, paragliding. Two sunbeds with a parasol and lock box was 14euro for the day and well worth it just for the security. There were beach hotels where you could get lunch or a Spar if you wanted to make your own. The Banana boats were 10 euro pp and great fun. The beach was clean and you waded out a fair distance before the water got deep do safe fro little ones.

reviews.title: The hotel was right on the beach
reviews.text: The sea was warmer than the pool very safe for young children beautiful sandy beach if you wanted you can rent sunbeds and an umbrella

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Perfect sandy gently sloping beach.  Ideal for little ones.  Loads of sun beds.  Very clean.  Nice walk out on a small jetty for photo opportunities!

reviews.title: Lovely safe beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely sandy beach that is clean and well maintained. The sunbeds and parasols are very reasonable to rent for the day and can include a safe which was a great idea for when the whole family went in the sea. There is a huge inflatable activity structure that any age can use for 12€ an hour . Fruit and cocktails are offered occasionally during the day and are  good value. There was quite a few sellers ( we call them looky, looky men ) on he beach but they were always polite and never became a nuisance . Massage and windsurfing was also available as were boat trips from the pier.

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: the beach around this area is lovely for young children as it doesnt get deep for quiteif you go one stop or several stops.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach.
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful but would be really busy in the height of summer. The only problem is the pestering salesman/women. No I don't need sunglasses/sarong/watches/bracelets or even a massage. Don't sit near the trees on the beach that's where the accumulate and talk very loudly to each other all the time. Apart from that it was great. Close to supermarkets for drinks and snacks and we also bought cheap sun umbrellas and left them in the hotel at the end of our stay. And close to restaurants for the lunchtime litre of Sangria. Wonderful.

reviews.title: Lovely, swimming with the fish
reviews.text: Very nice beach, not overly commercialised but still get everything you need. Clear warm water and loads of fish to swim with. Our kids loved this. Just take some googles (our buy them at the beach)

reviews.title: Shallow a distance, fish & fruit
reviews.text: The sea is shallow for quite a way out allowing space for all to play. There are fruit sellors walking along who are great for a refreshment. Beds are pricey, nearly €15 for 2beds and an umbrella but you don't need them tbh. Enjoy!!

reviews.title: Good beach for children
reviews.text: The Alcudia area beach is very nice, if you have children.The depth increased quite slowly, so you can let the children play without holding hands all the time.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Beautiful long beach with soft white sand and lots of possibilities for water activities. Not too overcrowded. Sunbeds available for hire.

reviews.title: Safe beach
reviews.text: Good for swimming, sunbathing or boat trips. Lifeguards on duty. Clean sand. Closest to our hotel. Recommended.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach. Not many free sun loungers but we were fine with beach towels. Bit windy at times, but that's fine when it's really hot.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A truly beautiful beach, with white clean sand and turquoise water.  The water is warm and clean and is shallow and great for smaller children.

reviews.title: Nice but overcrowded
reviews.text: All right it is nice and shallow water from 09h to ...almost 11h, but after that poeple come to put their towel 1 m away from yours. When you are not used to mass tourism,  either go early or go off season otherwise forget it. The pictures speak from themselves. Overcrowded and seat by seats. Good to know if you are not used to it, I don't bother but their are some nudist areas here and there either.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach great for kids and safe sea swimming. Would definitely recommend a visit. Lots of fun with water sports as well.

reviews.title: Spain with a Carrabean feeling
reviews.text: Long sandy beaches, clear emerald shallow water: the Carrabean feeling just a couple of hours away!! And highly reccomend for families!!

reviews.title: Nice beach terrible facilities
reviews.text: Visited the  Beach last week four or five times. We rented 2 sun beds  for about €13 for the whole day. It was close to the sea which was really warm and perfect for swimming with younger children as it is quite shallow. Apart from the constant barrage of people trying to sell hats watches sunglasses fruit  every two minutes we found the beach to be quite pleasant and although busy we still had  plenty of room for the children to play.  However the main drawback of the beach has to be the horrendous toilets. Our hotel is quite a walk away and with three young children we relied on the toilet, but  were unable to use them on several occasions because they were so filthy to the point were people were retching as they left. There was excrement plastered all over the toilet and walls and floor. It is the dirtiest toilet I've ever seen and was in pretty much the same state every time we try to visit. We ended up eating  or buying drinks from nearby restaurants so we could use the toilet facilities. Such a shame to what would've been a decent beach.

reviews.title: Beach looks like paradise
reviews.text: White sand, the colours are amazing, very clean and family friendly. The temperature of the water was great. Next holiday will be here again.

reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text: We had a fantastic family holiday here, beautiful clean, air conditioned bungalow, lovely swimming pools our 2 grandchildren adored and best of all amazing food in the restaurant with very friendly, helpful restaurant staff who couldn't do enough for us, especially Jose, Marga and Kinga, it was one of our granddaughters birthday while we were on holiday and they laid a special table for us, it was so thoughtful, thank you again to all the staff, can't wait to come back.

reviews.title: Really clean with perfect sands and blue waters.
reviews.text: This is the perfect beach. No stones, seaweed, crabs or anything to hurt your feet. Perfect for kids and shallow for a good distance out. The water is so warm and very salty. Clean toilets and showers all along the beach. Sun loungers to rent. Be sure to go.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Nice relaxing beach. Very appropriate for children. Services easily available. Amazing colours. Walking on that beach has been one of the best experiences of my holiday

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Love this beach, could spend all day there. Plenty of space although a very busy beach. Shops nearby selling everything you need.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Soft sand, gentle slopping waters, plenty of sunbeds and brollys (with a  beach safe €13.75) for the day. Good value. Plus the royal beach bar /restaraunt for a lovely lunch or drinks. A few hawkers and masseuses but they don't nag you.

reviews.title: Fab beach
reviews.text: Would rival Mexico and more tropical places. Beautiful beach with loads of activities on offer. Loved it

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: But very busy! Sun beds get booked up and taken quickly. Booking in the section we went to towards alcudia is minimum of 4 days and then 4 day booking increments. €5.25-€6.50 per bed per day and safety box is about €1 a day. The blue ones look less classy but far more comfortable!

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach.
reviews.text: A lovely clean beach with lots of sunbeds and umbrellas for hire, with safes.  Kids loved it here.  Local supermarket and man selling fruit on the beach are good for lunch/snacks.

reviews.title: A place to rest
reviews.text: Beautiful, wide and sandy beach which offers a variety of water sports, both for kids and for adults. You will pay for a beach chair i euro per day. It is a calm place where you do not find many clubs. Plenty of hotels, restaurants and street shops.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach with fresh wind and some waves. It's possible to rent umbrellas and sun beds. The only problem regards theshower, few and distant from the beach.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Very busy but so clean and the water is shallow and warm. The waves gave us hours of entertainment. Loved it!

reviews.title: Pleasant beach with plenty of room
reviews.text: This beach is part of the long sweep of beach between Alcudia and Can Picafort on the north of the island of Majorca. Clean, pleasant beach and sea, with watersports available and other services like restaurants, fruit vendors, shades and massage. Boat trips available around towards Formentor and Pollensa. Very pleasant place to relax.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: We loved this beach. It was very busy but the sea was lovely and warm and shallow and a nice way to spend time away from the pool.

reviews.title: Great clean and safe beach
