reviews.text: We really enjoyed going to the beach it was very clean and safe as the sea was shallow a long way out meaning the children were safe while swimming alone and it was very warm. The  beach did get very busy so it was hard to get a sunbed sometimes.

reviews.title: Nice beach lots to do
reviews.text: Nice beach easy access with lots to do including water sports and massage. Approx 10 kms long so plenty of distance to go for a walk.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Playa de Muro Beach was stunning. It was very clean and kept well - with calm and warm water it was perfect for swimming and relaxing.The area of the beach we visited also had an inflatable play area in the sea, and other water activities available, such as Jet Skiing, Boat Trips etc. There were plenty of sun loungers with sun shades, in which you would have to pay per day to use.Overall, we really enjoyed this beautiful beach.

reviews.title: fantastic beach
reviews.text: long sandy beach with blue water. great for families although quite large waves when the wind picks up.

reviews.title: Very nice beach!!!
reviews.text: Nice sand and view over the mountain, water perfectly clean!!!! Great to relax with the whole family!

reviews.title: My heart belongs to Playa de Muro
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Clean, safe beach with lifeguard, paddle boarding windsurfing and shade.  Shallow water - choppier in afternoon.Returning next year - need I say more.

reviews.title: Steve
reviews.text: Amazing beach with clear water, clean sand and excellent facilities.. regular lifeguard .. shallow water perfect for families and cleaner regularly by the local council

reviews.title: very nice beach
reviews.text: this beach is very nice, clean water, nice sandy beach, close to restaurants. i would recommend to visit this beach.

reviews.title: It's nice, but not as spectacular as expected
reviews.text: Our stay in Majorca was short, but we wanted at least one day at the beach and chose Muro having read the many reviews about it being the best in Majorca.The strip is long and golden, but far from the cleanest. The sand was peppered with sea debris and some stretches bring in a lot of debris with the tide.We stayed in Port Pollenca and by comparison, whilst the strip of beach is far smaller, it was raked and cleaned regularly throughout the day. Given how many holidaymakers use the beach at Muro, I would have expected the same.The water was lovely however, and warm and quite shallow, so our 5 year old son was very comfortable after a short time in the water.Good to have experienced, but if we return to Majorca, we'll try a different beach.

reviews.title: Hotel Alcudia Park - an EXCELLENT stay in Playa de Muro beach
reviews.text: Once again in July 2017, a VERY GOOD two weeks beach vacation stay in the Hotel Alcudia Park - like in the last 5 years, in a All Inclusive program. All the hotel services are VERY GOOD - reception, food and beverages, cleanliness, entertainment activities... We didn't have any problems at all! This year we got a 'STAR Prestige' room (in the block 5), with an EXCELLENT exclusive service - something unforgettable!!!The very clean hot water Mediterranean beach is just aside of the hotel, a few steps out of the hotel backyard, we could take as many sea baths as we want, swim, never getting cold... My wife and I we really enjoy very much to return every summer to this hotel for a seaside vacation period of two weeks, and we look forward to came back again in July 2018!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great Beach very safe well lifeguarded with ample warning signs and danger flag system in place to ensure all take notice when required. Water entry and exit safe on a low shelving sand bank. Area of improvement could be made by a better beach clean operating during high season due to higher usage and users failing to use the bins provided for the dreaded cigarette butts.

reviews.title: Wonderful shallow, clean beach
reviews.text: Lovely and shallow with crystal clear water and gently waves.  The beach is kept clean and tidy with beds to hire if needed.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach within walking distance to apartments, I would recommend alcudia beach as it has less sea weed! It's a nice place to go and walk along.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach and view of the bay
reviews.text: Lovely gently shelving beach ideal for children.  Golden sands and clear water with plenty of sunbeds and umbrellas on offer (have to be paid for).

reviews.title: Lagotel
reviews.text: Beach is ok. Usual naff shops selling inflateables etc. Get a taxi to alcudia beach. Much nicer and only 4 euro's.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach the water isn't too deep and is lovely and warm. You can hire sun beds and parasols however we didn't bother! The only downfall are the people trying to sell you fake Rolex and sunglasses! We walked down nearly every day even if it was just for a paddle! There is a little market in the evenings that sells Nic nacks. My daughter had a braid in her hair which was €10!! But it was her money and she really wanted one!!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely beach with sea that is like getting into a warm bath!Beautiful colours as well! Spotlessly clean

reviews.title: stunning beach
reviews.text: this is one of the best beaches ive been on. the sand is super soft and stretches for miles, the water is safe for children and quite shallow. it is very popular so gets crowded so go early to get your spot!

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Amaxing holiday all brillent coming back  near the beach and shops good lovely too.s lovely bar staff called roly and Ige are lovely

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: Fantastic views, spotlessly clean but you should watch for the jellyfish - we saw a few of them although this was a good 200 metres out from the shore.

reviews.title: Plays de mura beach
reviews.text: Fantastic beachPlenty sun beds and parasols 18euro for 3 beds and parasol best going towards iberostar hotel area as guaranteed beds. Less crowds Shallow clear water perfect for children Kids loved it as did parents.

reviews.title: Beautiful heach
reviews.text: Stunning stretch of white sand beach, with gentle waves, ideal for young families as safe and gently shelving.   Great to be able to catch the sightseeing boats from the jetty along the beach.Sun beds were a bit pricey, but worth it as stunning location

reviews.title: Fantastic beach with watersports
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful with shallow warm waters for the children and gently waves.  Lots of water-sports available including par-sailing, banana boat rides, jet skiis, paddle-boarding and more.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: A lovely, clean beach. Within walking distance for Most hotels in the local area. Close to amenities

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with plenty of space
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, even in high season not over crowded, has some smaller bars next the beach too and offers plenty of parking. Just a few minutes walk towards the direction of the nature reserve will get you enough space for a relaxed beach day. The sand was white, the water clear and everything appeared clean and looked after.

reviews.title: Mother daughter holiday
reviews.text: Lovely beach, well worth a visit. Sun beds and parasols are available to hire for the day at a reasonable fee.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Very safe clear blue sea ,very shallow water  for small children,sand clean.Sunbeds 6.50 each but ones with parasols need booking in advance so maybe look to book online beforehand?

reviews.title: Beautifull beach
reviews.text: A " must" visit it if you are on Mallorca! If we knew how nice it is we would rent a house there. It is not crowded eventhough a lot of people are there, but it is so long that everybody can find it's own private space.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: A little slice of paradise on the Majorcan island!  Clean beach, plenty of beds and umbrellas for shade. Idyllic place to relax and unwind.

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: This is my favourite beach ever, the water is shallow and warm. For most of the time the water is completely clear and teeming with fish.

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach with parking and a beautiful outlook. The sea shelves away very slowly so you can walk out quite a way and it is safe for little ones. The umbrellas and 2 loungers were 12.75 euros for the day and each umbrella has a small safe on it so you can lock your money, keys, phone away when you go to eat/swim. Amazing! There are ladies walking around offering massages which I did have. A full body massage taking 45 minutes for 20 euros. Then there's the man selling fruit which was so refreshing. Everything from pineapple, melon, bananas & coconut. It's a lovely beach and with these extra touches it makes a lovely day.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: The beach is stunning with clear sands, clean and can walk out for ages with it still being shallow.This may be due to us going end of may/start of June but there was no sunbeds (there was last year)  and there was no showers or toilets at all " to save water" This meant you had to go and have a drink in the bar in order to use their toilet.

reviews.title: Excellent beach,
reviews.text: Excellent beach, safe for young children and the older folk in our group. Long golden sandy beaches, warm water

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: Perfect beach: clear water, warm temperature and light sand!Ideal for families with small kids.The second part of the beach is the best. The closer to Port Alcudia the more crowded it gets..

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Shallow for a long way out so the sea has a lovely turquoise colour, also reasonable priced sunbeds and lifeguards

reviews.title: Clean and tidy...
reviews.text: A beautiful golden beach, with clear waters. Clean toilets and shower facilities. Make sure you but buy some fruit from the man with the wheel barrow. He was great value!Shame the 'looky looky' men - selling sunglasses , Sun blankets and the such like, 'hair braid' ladies and 'massage' ladies aren't better managed as they did tend to be a pest when you're asked 10 times a day of you want anything...

reviews.title: miles of golden sandy beach
reviews.text: Miles of golden sandy beach. Plenty of small bars/restaurants and water activities. Only a 10 minute walk from Holiday Garden Village. Plenty of shops on the adjacent main roads.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach Sun lounges were a little expensive  clean and lots of restaurant around with varying prices

reviews.title: long sandy beach
reviews.text: this is a nice beach, we stayed in a hotel on it. Sandy, shallow water. Liked it. I can't say it's the best ever as 1. I prefer smaller beaches/coves and this is 4 miles long! 2 Was windy all week

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: One of the moat clean and white sand beach what I have seen on Mallorca. Definitly I will come back!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great family beach clean with plenty water sports nearby.Plenty of space to take your own beach gear if not using the sunbeds

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Shallow so perfect for youngsters, large inflatable for teenagers, walk to Alcudia along beach took 50 minutes at a good pace. Restaurants/bars close by.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice beach with warm water, when we visited there was an onshore wind which brought in a little bit of seaweed, visibility not so great for snorkelling due to that. Clean and plenty of local amenities. Frequent bus services to and from in either direction to Alcudia etc. Sandy beach with a slight coral bit as you enter the sea which then smooths out into sand again. You can go quiet far our and still be waist deep. Lifeguards present at some locations with flags up. Various water sports attractions

reviews.title: Clean, popular beach
reviews.text: We had a free shuttle to the beach from our hotel. The beach is clean, well stocked with shops, bars, restaurants, sun beds and street sellers. Some shade available from trees but lots of sun beds with umbrellas for hire too.Water is very clean and fairly shallow to start with. Lifeguards on duty and there are markers to show you not to go out too far.Lots of activities too from boat hire, parasailing, and inflatable obstacle courses on the water. The beach is that long, if you don't like the one bit you only have to walk 100m to find a bit you do like.We'll worth a day out or two if you're in the area.

reviews.title: Very busy but worth a visit
reviews.text: This is a lovely sandy beach with crystal clear water. It is very busy with families. There are lots of bars/restaurants and shops nearby. Worth a visit.

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: Soft sand, clear lightblue water, shallow so you can easily bathe with kids and funny Waves! Lifeguards during the day, lots of fish in the sea...simply a perfect beach!

reviews.title: Hmmm, could have been such a great beach...
reviews.text: Ať first sight - totally fabulous beach!!! But... Let's put it the way, this beach is soooo far from getting the blue flag, which really is a pitty... Could for example start with forbiding smoking on the beach, for their are big amounts of cigaratte butts throughout the beach, brf... Really pitty...

reviews.title: Sandy beach heaven
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand, turquoise water & lots of space to play racket ball! You also have various options for renting out sun beds at decent prices. Great beach for a lovely beach day!

reviews.title: Ansel Ponce Diama
reviews.text: Love this beach. It is very clean, has clear water, and white sands. I highly recommend coming to this place if you want to relax! - Ansel Ponce Diama

reviews.title: Nice clear warm water
reviews.text: Nice clear warm water, loungers, watersports, various bars from refreshments at points. Loungers we used were €6.50 between 10am - 6pm and have a plastic safe to put your stuff in under the umbrella.

reviews.title: Beach life
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach miles of white sand. No one bugging you for money to hire loungers. Lots of restaurants and bars on hand also supermarket that sells beach goods

reviews.title: cracking beach
reviews.text: very clean white sand, can get busy only been in June for the last 5 years so cannot comment on what it would be like for July and August, quite a few pedlars but not oppressive, lovely sea

reviews.title: The best in mallorca
reviews.text: After the beaches palma and illetas it is the besth beach three of them. We paid 14 Euro for two sun beds and parasol. It is a very big beach and you can find carpark, restaurants, toilets easily.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Crystal clear water, beautiful sand (that does not burn little feet) and you can walk out very far before the water gets deep- so perfect for playing water games and for small children. Very clean...busy on weekends but still room for everyone without feeling crowded. Such a relaxing spot ❤️

reviews.title: Nice beach!
reviews.text: Lovely picturistic beach. long with many sunbeds, although they were often reserved without being used.

reviews.title: A favourite
reviews.text: Big, so crowds seem to disperse, very broad and wide and some waves: lots of action for teenagers (SUP, kayak, windsurfing, banana boats) and excellent chiringuito (Moai) and very clean water. No intimacy but fun guaranteed!

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: This beach was the highlight of our holiday. The sea is so clear and you can go out for miles and still be able to touch the bottom!

reviews.title: Incredible Beach
reviews.text: An amazing beach that stretches for miles. It helps too that the sea is like a bath. Our hotel was right on the beach.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Small but stunning beach with views of the coastline, also great for evening strolls. Nice atmosphere and is lined with restaurants and a little market

reviews.title: Beautiful Beaches
reviews.text: Fantastic beach and beautifully clear sea. The shallow seas are fantastic if you have small children, the beaches are cleaned daily,

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, lots of Activities, Clear waters!
reviews.text: Visited this beach on multiple occasions and at different locations, this is one of my main reasons for returning to alcudia, the beach stretches for miles and is golden sand all the way around to the port where it is very shallow with clear water ideal for paddling with young children, there are food & drink stands located almost the entire length of the beach. There are also various watersports & activity points located halfway down. Very highly recommended.

reviews.title: Clean and safe bathing
reviews.text: Small or narrow in places extends quite a distance, clean clear water, could be crowded at times. Good for a few hours but very hot days could be uncomfortable for young babies as no shade unless you buy an umbrella or hire a sun bed with one, but pleasant. No walkway path so access through side streets by big hotels

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Lovely beach, lovely sand, gets very busy in peek season. Shops and restaurants around. There was an inflatable gym in the middle of the sea you could swim out to which looked fun although never went on it myself as I'm not a fan of the sea.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach gorgeous clear blue waters and light golden sands looked like a beach you would see in Mexico!! Definitely worth a visit..

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach for the family. Beautiful cleans sands and waters. Lots of space to stretch out and enjoy the sun, sand and sea. Local boat trips available. Pedaloes also available and an inflatable assault course within swimming distance. There will always be looky looky men selling some items and on Playa de euro there are even some people offering massages but as long as you don't mind the very occasional chat its all fine.

reviews.title: safe and popular beach
reviews.text: nice sandy beach ,popular with all and easy to access .main road is very close so easy to get the bus to alcudia or can picafort if you want more action . a daily evening market with several stalls selling budget jewellery trinkets and souvaniers

reviews.title: paradise found
reviews.text: long white sandy beach & crystal clear turquise waters, this is one of the best beaches on the island

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A great beach with amazing sand and clear water. It can be very busy, especially at weekends. Close to amenities and shops.

reviews.title: Excellent location and ideal for beach lovers and cyclists
reviews.text: Stay at the Los Principes Hotel and Spa. Welcoming, clean, good service and good freshly cooked food. Then hire your bicycle from Heurzeler which is attached to the hotel grounds.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but very few places to eat/drink along it, and FULL of sun beds. Very busy with families but beautiful none the less!

reviews.title: Perfect playa
reviews.text: 2 weeks in family at this beach. The water is turquoise and warm. You can reserve the sunbed for a nice price. We will come back.

reviews.title: Lovely beach, soft sand and clear sea.
reviews.text: Only visited here once during the week but I could have come back for more. The sea seemed clear and clean with a huge inflatable assault course for kids. A few showers for cleaning yourself off and plenty of bars within walking distance for refreshments.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches very close to the hotel couldn't ask for more clear blue and no seaweed

reviews.title: Great Beach for Toddlers
reviews.text: This beach has beautiful soft, white sand and the sea is amazing, warm and only knee deep for a long way out so it's great for toddlers. There are small waves but nothing which is scary for little people.

reviews.title: good & clean
reviews.text: found beach to be very clean with nice sand - water was very shallow so good for young ones , plenty of water activities going on + play area actually out in the water

reviews.title: Very reasonable walk to the beach
reviews.text: 10 minuets from the resort and very lively and enjoyable many food establishments on the way including spar convenience stores

reviews.title: nice, easy, shallow beach
reviews.text: This is a very nice, white shallow beach that is very kid friendly. It stays shallow a long ways out and the there are fun, but not too rough waves to play in. The palm tree umbrellas and sun chairs were a nice bonus. The beach is not too wide but makes up for that by being quite long, so you can get away from crowds if you like. Close to town and shops, restaurants, etc. Easy parking as well.

reviews.title: Paya du Muro Beach
reviews.text: Very clean and so safe for children. Can walk out in the sea for quite a distance and still not be in deep water. Water is so clear you can see the fish swimming. Only downside is the sellers on the beach trying to sell you watches,hair braiding etc which is a nuisance and later in the day the seaweed

reviews.title: Best part of the holiday
reviews.text: Loads to do would definitely go again, obstacle courses in the sea and food and drink nearby a long with sun beds.

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Had some great days at the beach whilst on holiday.Only 2/3 minutes walk to restaurantsAlso boat trips, parasending  and bouncy water slides available along the beach 5/10 minutes walk ether way.Fantastic beach well looked after.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with a pier
reviews.text: Wonderful sand beach. The water is clean and beautiful, very picturesque. Two sunbeds + parasol cost 12€ for a day, but the staff appears to start checking them around noon. There's also a pier offering several boat trips which you should definitely go on!

reviews.title: A little piece of paradise!
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely stunning. An excellent place to relax and unwind and enjoy a swim in the sea...just perfect!!

reviews.title: White sand
reviews.text: The beach is lovely, with white sand and clear blue water. Really shallow which is good for children paddling. Lifeguards on duty toilets showers and changing facilities, also water sports if you want them.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Playa de Muro is a great beach for families  with kids and all other. The water is shallow and the sand is white and soft. Umbrellas and chairs for rent but lots if space for your own towel and umbrella. There is a small square with wc, restaurants and a supermarket.

reviews.title: Great day at the beach!
reviews.text: Clean, clear water. Sandy Beach with no algae or seaweed. Breezy day keep the heat off! Perfect beach! Only fault- minimal shells to collect. Very clean beach!

reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.text: Very nice beach, but missing beach clubs. Very clean and not so much crowded, beginning of July. Perfect blue and clean water. Very close to the markets and small restaurants.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Cocktails are amazing! Best in the area. Staff are friendly and efficient too.Very nice location looking out onto the beach/sea. Very open sitting areas with nice low music and dim ambient lighting. Very calming place :)

reviews.title: Beautiful day and night
reviews.text: We visited both day and night, both offered different kinds of beauty. In the day the blue sky is complimented by clear waters. We didn't stop and lie on the sand but we walked along and up and down the jetty. Sun beds and umbrellas were available but the sand was crowded. At night the sand cooled, the sky turned a purply blue as the sun set and we sat on the end of the jetty as the air cooled. Definitely recommend going down to see the sun set behind the mountains.

reviews.title: Sun Paradise
reviews.text: Playa de Muro in the center of a large bay in the north of mallorca is a spectacular place. A clean white sand washed by a crystal clear water that makes you feel in paradise. I stayed 5 days but will return for longer because it is the best I have ever seen. I was in the Alcudia area and the beach is still spectacular to the other side I was not there but the view from the Muro Palace was very nice.

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sea and beautiful sand with plenty of activities if that is what you like. Toilets easy accessible and shops are close for refreshments.

reviews.title: Great relaxing
reviews.text: Lovely beach great bar / restaurant near by called the swan easy to get a boat trip if wanted had a blow up water activity in the sea restraints near by shops lady on the boat trips on the day we went was so helpful happy and so friendly we couldn't say a bad word about it

reviews.title: Beach like fairy tale
reviews.text: Pure water, azure, sandy and soft sand. Fish added charm. Hard not fall in love The only shortcoming is the lack of children's play areas like in Salou

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: It was a long shallow beach, so perfect for children to swim. Its open area, toalett facilities, and good possibilies for wheelchairs aswell.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach with lovely warm, clear water that stays shallow for ages! We spent a gorgeous afternoon here with our two little ones who had a whale of a time!

reviews.title: very lovely clean beach
reviews.text: stayed at playa de muro suites. beach was lovely x very clean x also had life guard x check out the traders on the beach have some nice copy glasses cheap x nice men x

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel on the beach and was really lovely with the pier right in front of us. Just a little too much seaweed around but nothing to stop me going in the sea. Few shops and restaurants just off the beach too. The water was lovely and warm...

reviews.title: Wasn't very clean
reviews.text: Nice beach in general-with sandy shore and rocks around. Right beside S'iilot main street with restaurants, bars and other attractions. We did not swim a once cause we found much better beaches around like cala anguila and another one next to it. But for a walk it was lovely

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: We booked a hotel at this area of Majorca, purely for the beach. We stopped close to the Las Gaviotas Jetty, which offers boat trips and a lovely bit of scenery. The water was beautifully clear, the beach is fairly quiet. Our favourite thing about this beach is the fish which swim close to the shore, they like being fed and it is great for children and snorkelling enthusiasts to get close to the sealife

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Stayed at family life alcudia pins, right on this beach. Everyday it was kept very clean, perfect blue waters, lifeguards actively patrolling. Only down side buy about 3/4pm seaweed had covered the shoreline, but not a massive issue.

reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: This hotel are located in a perfect area. Very close to the ocean. The hotel are very clean. The food also fantastic. Friendly helpful staff. Only the wifi connection are very poor and the Gym need some upgrade but highly recommended for everyone who like quality stuff. AAA+++

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean , clear beach , calm water and shallow for a few meters . Boats came into the jetty to take people on trips .

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Lovely beach, very clean and well maintained.  Shallow, calm waters so the children were able to really enjoy it.

reviews.title: Super!
reviews.text: Perfect water, crisp and clear, very nice sand and a super super Long Beach with chiringittos, bars and restaurants and clubs ... normally a little bit of wind in the afternoon, so great for all different sorts of watersports

reviews.title: well kept
reviews.text: the beach was good with chairs and umbrellas (14euros) and a life guard--the water was very shallow so family friendly

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach for kids. Very safe sea which is shallow for a long eay out. Only problem.is all the illegal sellers on beach who don't leave you alone!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Spent a lovely afternoon here at muro beach clear water white sand.Was surprised to see no sun beds available which would of been an added bonus.A lot of lucky lucky men and hair braiders about but with a stern no they did leave us alone.Kids thought the beach and riding the waves was brilliant, some lovely restaurants nearby and shop just as you come off the beach to the left.Beach was well supervised by lifeguards and plenty of activities to take part in if you are daring plus the harbour for the boat trips which looked fun

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach! White sands and crystal clear ocean! There is so much to do from water sports to plenty of lovely little restaurants to sit in the sun and have something to eat and a drink! We went banana boating and on the peddle boats with a slide and has an amazing day

reviews.title: Great, clean, beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Playa de Muro Beach is beautiful. Clear water, very clean, umbrellas to hire, lots of bars/cafes close by, and a little market at night. A really lovely place!

reviews.title: Clean beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach, public restroom available and a docking pier where You can book excursions. Very clean water and very shallow.I am 1m68 and I could walk to end of the pier and still head above the water :)

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Lovely Long Beach. Sea temperatures are great, feels luke warm by the afternoon, some fish only small ones mind do swim close to the shore. very shallow for a distance out. Which is great if you're taking little children or a non swimmer who can still have fun slashing around. Check prices before buying from beach huts. €2.80 for a small water. Robbery. Buy multipacks from a supermarket and a cool bag.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Excellent sandy beach, shallow waters for children, umbrellas and chairs for hire. Restaurant just off beach and lifeguards in attendance.

reviews.title: great beach!!!!, very suitable for kids
reviews.text: This beach is very pretty. is very good for kids, since is very shallow and safe. We were in the area of the iberostar hotel albufera park and is a very nice area and it has the pick up point for the boat trips which is quite useful. Is our favorite beach area.

reviews.title: Nice and clean beach
reviews.text: We are staying in alcudia for two weeks and playa de alcudia surprised: a lot of sludge, foul odor... its strange cause last year, the same time everything was ok. Thats way we looked for another place. Playa del muro - only few minutes by car from the centre of alcudia with clean water!

reviews.title: Feels like being in the Caribbean
reviews.text: It’s definitely worth visiting playa de muro. It feels like being in the Caribbean. The sea and beach are clean and life guards are everywhere. There are also free showers which adds a little extra if you are not staying at a private beach section.

reviews.title: amazing beach
reviews.text: best beach ever visited in Mallorca ,beautiful clean sand and sea, shallow and safe several lifeguards

reviews.title: Clean beach, clear water
reviews.text: A clean beach that is quite shallow so good for young kids.  The water is clear but we didn't see any marine life.

reviews.title: long beach
reviews.text: One of the longest beaches in Mallorca, supported by various beach bars out of the sand and with its sea line fully occupied by hotels it looses the beauty because of it.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach and the drinks are all inclusive when u are at the beach when u go in the hotel bus

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach crystal blue water you can go out a fair way , only down fall we went end of may no sun beds or umbrellas I bought a good umbrella with sun protection on it for twelve euros and took it back home end of holidays .

reviews.title: Lovely.
reviews.text: Lovely and clean beach with easy access for pushchair. Water calm and safe for the children. Beautiful

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous we visited recently and stayed at alcudia pinns hotel which is in this beach we went on the beach on our first full day the weather was hot the sea was clear and nice and warm the views are stunning its nice and clean id go back here just for the beach

reviews.title: No umbrellas for shade and the shower/foot wash didn't work.
reviews.text: Bypass this beach and go to Can Picafort instead, more shops, restaurants/bars and umbrellas/working showers.  This is a shame for the shops/bars in Playa de Muro but it needs a little attention to detail.

reviews.title: Quiet beach, few facilities
reviews.text: We stayed in a nearby hotel and visited the beach nearly every day of our stay. The beach is made accessible by wheelchairs (and has a few other facilities for disabled), which was also convenient for visiting the beach with our stroller. There are no beach beds available on the beach, which whe didn't mind, but be sure to pack enough for a comfortable stay. With our 3 month old daughter, this included a stroller, umbrella, little beach tent. We managed fine. Hotels near the beach offer bar service (and provided us with bottle service).Surf is calm and the sea is very shallow, so very kid friendly. The shower didn't function fully, but with our hotel nearby, we didn't mind.The wind was getting strong each day after lunch time, so we then packed up our stuff and moved back to the hotel.Since the beach is facing east, early birds have the pleasure of viewing a beautiful sunrise. Get up early!Few vendors offer sunglasses/massages/rugs/braids/fruits, but we didn't mind.

reviews.title: clean well kept beach
reviews.text: just one or two toilets would be the only down side, a few shops and restaurants make it feel like a quaint little beach

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Good clean beach safe for children as the water gets deep very gradually, sand cleaned each evening, lovely

reviews.title: Clean, family friendly beach
reviews.text: This is a perfect beach for families as the shore slopes very gently into the sea. Even toddlers could run in and out. There was no music blasting when we were there. Beds and umbrellas could be hired but most had taken their own things. The beach is clean and the water sparkling. I believe it has a blue flag. Very nice, safe family orientated beach with enough amenities to make it a pleasant destination.

reviews.title: Lovely beach, unsurprisingly it was busy at May half term.
reviews.text: Lovely beach, lovely sand. Was very busy with sun loungers/umbrellas and other people when we went but it was May half term week   The water stayed shallow for a long way so was ideal for our young children to splash around in. The people selling on the beach are a bit irritating but not persistent - a polite 'no thank you' and they went on their way.

reviews.title: Lovely holiday
reviews.text: We had a week there on 23rd May this yr and spent it all on the lovely beach, last yr they had sun beds as you walked onto the beach( near the Swan Resturant) and portable toilets( which were not open this time,we were told they don't have the sun beds or open toilets until beginning of June so we had to walk a little way to the left of the beach to find some beds and use the restaurant toilets,apparently there is a bit of the beach which is Alcudia beach( where the sun beds were and the other bit where there weren't any is Playa De Muro, just a note about sun beds in general ,we noticed around our hotel( BQ Holiday sun village) the sun beds are not adjustable so if you book there be aware if you have a bad back when using the beds.the ones on the beach which were Pink were adjustable so okAnd right on the beach is the Floridita Beach Bar and restaurant but beware of the portable loo a little bit behind it, it was so bad I couldn't use it, you get the key from that coffee bar I mentioned it to the staff they said something in Spanish and didn't seem to worry about it, disgusting.Had coffee/ beer lunch time every day at El Leon Rojo  restaurant good food and great staff, and the Swan next to it was great too the staff there,Sebas, Clau,Jaime and Marina were lovely always helpful, we ate there in the evenings, good food and reasonable prices, also good for football fans they have all the matches on,lol it's a family run Restaurant.We have been to that area twice now and really love it, the sea is lovely to swim in and great for little ones.you can go on boat trips from the beach, but unfortunately there was a lot of what we thought was seaweed but it was grass from under the sea when the weather is rough out at sea this grass comes in, it's ok to walk on at the waters edge but bit messy , they had a digger collecting it up,it's dark brown when wet.

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: This is a long, gently shelving and clean sandy beach with lifeguard in attendance. Looky-looky sellers and patrolling Masseuses are easily dissuaded.

reviews.title: Okay beach, no boulevard
reviews.text: Good beach, clear water and well suited for holiday with little children as the water does not get very deep for a while. Little facilities on the beach though.But we missed that there was no boulevard or boardwalk with shops or restaurants or bars, a few little streets end with a bar that overlook the ocean but for the most shops and restaurants you need to cross a busy road first and than there are plenty, but not with sea view. Vibe is good and relaxed.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Miles of white sandy beach and shallow clean waters. Perfect for kids! There were water activies for the adults and several boattrips from the pier! Sun beds  & umbrella rental available too!

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach and lovely  BaySafe with LifeguardsGreat for all agesSunbeds for hire in certain areas

reviews.title: Muro Beach
reviews.text: Water is shallow for quite a distance. When we were there, there was a lot of seaweed debris at the eater's edge.

reviews.title: Very nice view
reviews.text: Very nice view and clean water, the only major problem is the services which does not exist, WC, shower all are missing.

reviews.title: Very nice and clean beach
reviews.text: It is a very beautiful beach but quite crowdy even in September and you can also expect some nude people.

reviews.title: Accessed direct from our hotel
reviews.text: Long, white sand beach. Clear, quite shallow water. Always very clean and due to it shear size, never crowded.

reviews.title: Beatuful blue sea and spotless sand
reviews.text: The beach is spotless and clean it is cleaned everyday and kept well maintained . The sea is great for the kids it is very shallow and calm but can get a little choppy if there is a breeze . The water is an mixture of beautiful blues and with the white waves can be very pretty . The early morning sunrise is a lovely site it comes up at the end where the lighthouse can be seen try to see it once . The walks along the beach are nice and relaxing can be a bit busy in high season. Great location

reviews.title: A good long walk
reviews.text: The beach is clean and very shallow.  However there is a strip on the tideline of what appears to be coconut husks which can be a bit sore on the feet.

reviews.title: Nice, but don't believe the hype.
reviews.text: This is a very nice beach with a decent selection of bars and food outlets nearby. Pros:- gently shelving smooth sandy seabed which is great for families- water is generally quite clear- plenty of places to eat/drink nearby- water sports nearby- always a breeze to take the edge of the heat, but you could probably say that about most beaches. Cons:- don't believe the hype about it being better than the Caribbean or the Maldives. It's certainly not a patch on any Caribbean beach I've visited.- every 100 yards or so there are large piles of seaweed at the waters edge, and large patches of seaweed floating in the sea. - the surrounding area is very touristic - a touch of the Blackpool-in-Spain atmosphere that plenty of us try to avoid. There were plenty of places advertising all day English breakfast. I'm not knocking it, but for me that's not a positive.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Fantastic beach!!! Nice and clean.... be aware of locals trying to sell stuff on the beach or lady constantly asking if you want a massage!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the Playa Garden hotel which backs on this beach and were lucky enough to be able to see it from our room. It's a beautiful unspoilt beach with sand dunes and a lovely long jetty. We were there end of April beginning of May so it was very quiet. Lovely views of mountains both sides. Lovely skies in the evenings which lit the mountains beautifully. Lovely soft golden sand. Great for children to make sandcastles !

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but....
reviews.text: We've been coming here for years, the beach is absolutely beautiful and the water clear and shallow and really safe for kids, but has now it seems has become infested by an army of lucky lucky men trying to sell you fake sunglasses and people offering massages. Can't spend more than a minute without trying to fend them off.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Very nice beach. We got the boat from there. Shame that the shop we visit was on fire on our last night.

reviews.title: Wonderful day
reviews.text: Lovely beach that is clean slopes gently into the sea for safe bathing for young and old.and of cause there are lifeguard stations all a long this beach.There are restaurants near by which all add up to a nice place to send the day.The only draw back is there is no paved walk way along the edge of the sand so those with walking problems may find this hard.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: The best experience ever for my 3yr old daughter. Shallow water and clear water. So much activities going on at the beach like water sports at far ends. Boat rides. Fine sand.

reviews.title: excellent view!
reviews.text: The beach is easily accessible and has a superb view!The location is ideal, especially for cyclers!

reviews.title: Mr and Mrs Hoggard
reviews.text: Wonderful clean beach,shallow water,( safe for babies and children) easy access from hotel.Life guards stations all along the beach right up till Alcudia port.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with lovely clear water
reviews.text: Beach clean and sandy, water beautiful light blue colour. Would benefit from a tap/shower when you leave beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach warm water and shallow for kids toilets are located close and there are plenty of shops bars and restaraunts in a 5 minute walk

reviews.title: Playa De Muro
reviews.text: Our apartment is faultless.  The location is geared for tourists who enjoy  the sun, sea and relaxation.  In other words doing nothing.  We like walks.  The Nature park is excellent.  The available excursions are expensive and not that interesting for us.  We had a No Frills to Palma.  It was definitely an accurate description.  We were mislead but can't complain for the price but it was too long for what interest on offer.  Would not come back to this location

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Clean beach! Loads of space! Safe! Close to bars and shops! Offers sea trips! Can get a massage there

reviews.title: Nice, clean beach
reviews.text: Nice clean beach with sun dunes and turquoise watersGood for little children although lack toilet facilities

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: Really nice chilled out beach especially pre-season. Nice clearblue water. Enjoyed my early morning barefoot runs. Some beachvendors trying to sell sunglasses and stuff but they arent to annoying.

reviews.title: Nice naturist beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely, clean, sandy beach, with dunes that have been preserved. We visited the naturist part, which was relaxed, and not very crowded.

reviews.title: lovely white sand beach
reviews.text: Lovely picturesque walk into Alcudia, plenty of beach bars and restaurants to call in along the way, great for a peaceful amble, my idea of bliss

reviews.title: Amazing beach day
reviews.text: The beach is really beautiful and offers a lot of space to sunbathe! The water is clear and has amazing colors. Definitly worth a visit!

reviews.title: Clean, quiet beach
reviews.text: long stretch of sandy beach, clean, few areas of sea weed depending on tides. No sun beds and parasols on beach when we were there.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach nice and clean a few beach bars and boat trips. Very picturesque nice shallow water. Well worth a visit

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This beach is a nice one to go to and smaller, quieter and less commercialised than the ones in Alcudia.  Well worth a visit if you are in the area.  It is a dinky little town, yet with great views, lots of shops, hotels, restaurants, and pubs.  Also, some quiet lakes and canals, as you walk away from the beach.

reviews.title: Scenery
reviews.text: Popped down for a visit a couple of days, scenery is beautiful, place wasn't to busy and looked fun if beaches are your type of thing. Shops around and places to eat. Most people we spoke to had a walk right along the length of the beach which takes a couple of hours and they enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Lovely beach but no sun loungers due to it being the start of the season
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach 🌊 the only Downside to when we visited there were no sun loungers or toilet facilities due to it being the start of the season

reviews.title: Lovely white sand beach
reviews.text: Long white sand beach. Beautiful. Can get quite busy but still doesn't feel packed with people. There is some people going around selling fresh fruit, coconut, watermelon, mango and that's nice. You can also get massage and have your hair braided.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely sandy beach with crystal clear waters. Good location. You can walk all the way into the main town of Alcudia from Playa de Muro.

reviews.title: Lovely sand and clear water
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach white sand and clear water and lovely for children to play there there are no cars allowed close to the beach and there are pubs shops close by

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: lovely clean beach. water is very clear. sun beds on the beach loads of bars and food places near by

reviews.title: White sandy beaches
reviews.text: This beach was lovely & clean with proper sand (no stones like you get in England)!! with clear, warm sea that you could swim quite far out before it became too deep but also perfect for paddling or leisurely strolls as it is a long stretch.

reviews.title: Lush
reviews.text: Lush white sand and blue sea. A little cold at this time of year but still very nice. A fairly quiet area but enough shops and bars to keep you busy.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Clean beach in the National Park, with lovely clear sea and good views across the bay. Nice to come here to get away from slightly smelly Alcudia!

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Lovely beach, you can buy fresh fruit from locals or if you fancy someting stronger its close to local shops. Banana boat and other fun water activities available.

reviews.title: Beach review
reviews.text: Whilst it's been really windy over the last few days it's still been easy to appreciate how nice the beach is, very clean and lovely blue sea... such a pleasant place to be 👍👍👍 🌊

reviews.title: Just stunning
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely stunning. Came here most days of my holiday.  Pure white sand.  Family friendly. Toilets.  And places to buy food and drinks.  Lovely place.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely sandy which beach. It was very quiet and peaceful. I watched my kids make some sand castles and playing with the sand. Lovely

reviews.title: Famiky
reviews.text: Beautiful beach - safe for family's. Golden sands - one of my favourite beaches in the world. Clean sands with blue waters

reviews.title: stunning beach
reviews.text: fantastic holiday had by myself and 2 teenage children sun village was lovely and clean hotel staff were polite and helpful and any problems dealt with asap the entertainment reps made our holiday they were friendly entertaining and encouraged everone to join in good job yann and adam :) we would definitely go back here!

reviews.title: Big and quiet beach
reviews.text: Impressive Alcudia bay. Excellent beach experience. Clean water and sand. Landscape of dunes, perhaps too affected by the erosion and human works.

reviews.title: Beautiful Sandy Beach
reviews.text: Playa de Muro Beach has lovely golden sand and is ideal for children and adults alike.  It is popular for watersports.  The sea is various shades of green - it's a lovely beach.

reviews.title: NICE AND CLEAN
reviews.text: Went to the beach 1 day of holiday it woz nice and clean and sun was shining and really nice views 👍👍

reviews.title: Bit disappointed
reviews.text: I was really excited to visit the beach because everyone I had spoken to about visiting here raved about how great the beach is. I was really disappointed, the beach is nice, just such a shame it had a lot of rubbish lying around and if you have children please be careful of dog poo, unfortunately people do take their pets there for walks, which I'm not opposed to at all, I love dogs, but when they don't clear up their pets mess, it's just disgusting.

reviews.title: A most beautiful beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, soft sand and crystal clear waters. Visited in April so not at all busy. You can walk along the beach in both directions for miles.

reviews.title: We love this beach!
reviews.text: We've been to stay on the beach several times & will never tire of it. The sea is warm, clear, shallow & calm and is perfect for the children to play in. The sand is free of rocks & pebbles & its very clean.It does get busy but any beautiful beach would.My children like to take bread & sit on the pier to feed the fishes, if you stand in the water & drop in bread the fish will swim around your legs! Enjoy!

reviews.title: a beautiful beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach, especially in the evening when it quiets down after the sunbathing soles. Cafes over looking the sea are superb too, Water facilities to wash your feet and lifeguards onsite is great.

reviews.title: Greatest sandy beach on this island!
reviews.text: This is one of the greatest wide, sandy beaches I have ever been to! I guess there is no better beach somewhere else on this island. I enjoyed it very much :)

reviews.title: Playa de Muro Beach / Majorca
reviews.text: Playa de Muro has a lovely beach to satisfy every expectation for a pleasant stay with friends and familiys, clean waters, restauration nearby inviting for more energy.

reviews.title: Beautiful uncrowded beach
reviews.text: Lovely family beach, safe shallow water, turquoise. Always been quiet​when we visit, April and October and water still warm!

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Such a lovely clean beach. Long walk to port de alcudia. Very quiet out of season but we enjoyed that. Sea very cold in march. Lovely views

reviews.title: Lovely holiday
reviews.text: Would recommend this place for family holidays.Lovely family friendly beach.Nice 2 week vacation. Hotel right on the beach and a beautiful sea view.Would like to go back!

reviews.title: First class hotel.
reviews.text: Great holiday staff superb.beach absolutely perfect for all ages, was taken to play padel tennis by lovely lad on reception he was a master gave me lesson instead of game so kind, hope to go back this year.

reviews.title: Most beautiful and quiet part of the beach is a nude area
reviews.text: Playa de Muro is a long stretched Caribbean beach with shallow warm water that makes you believe you just spend €1000 on a plane ticket to Cancún. To reach the beach you have to walk about 10 minutes through a beautiful nature conservation park, meaning the beach is not surrounded by beach resorts. However, the most beautiful and quiet part of the beach is a nude area. The rest of the beach is very crowded and noisy. X didiandyasaroundtheglobe.com

reviews.title: Pure perfection
reviews.text: White sand, hills on the horizon, turquise see: bahamas in Europe. And there are places on this beach where you can have nobody 50 meters aroun you.

reviews.title: Great sandy beach
reviews.text: Excellent, wide and sandy beach, friendly for children. Feed fish straight from your hand. Enjoy warm sea.

reviews.title: Nice sand beach
reviews.text: This beach is nice, for it's sandy and you can walk into it for very long before it gets deep. It's warm in the summer. As it is on the east side, there are a bit more waves than on the west side, but nothing to worry about. Also, the beach is very long and you can make a night walk all the way to Alcudia.

reviews.title: Holiday through illness
reviews.text: Excellent holiday lovely beaches lots to keep you occupied good restaurants, plus some nice walks along the promenade

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the lagotel and there was a free shuttle bus to the beach. Lots of shops around the beach. Beach itself is really nice, we just put our towels on the sand, I recommend going early to get a good spot. The water was lovely and clear, could walk very far out and the waves were quiet so good for swimming. Lovely beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful soft sandy beach with clear blue water
reviews.text: This beach is amazing! It's so clean and you can walk for miles. The water is so blue and you can see thousands of little fish swimming about in the sea with you. You can see exactly where you are treading. The sand is so soft. There are people offering there massage services (paid) on the beach which is a must. People don't even notice that you are getting one done as everyone is too busy sunbathing.

reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text: Unbelievable place, shallow water, clean and beautiful beach. Kids was very happy and staying long time in the water,  no waves.. Clean water so kids can play and we don't need to worry. I will be back again.. Thank u Majorca.

reviews.title: Good clean beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach. Wheelchair access-friendly place. Highly recommend this beach. Good places to eat around the beach. Close to almost every hotel in Playa de Muro. They also have day trips from this beach.

reviews.title: Best beach ever!!
reviews.text: OMG forget the Caribbean!!You his clear blue water which is waist high when your over a mile out is the best sea and beach I've ever been onWe had some amazing days and nights in this beach, it's proper romantic and is really clean!I will defo return very soonThis is my favourite place at the moment

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing beach.  Shallow water.  Lovely.  Loved it. My children spent every day on this beach. You can walk into the water and know that it's shallow enough for the children not to be at risk.

reviews.title: Little Paradise
reviews.text: It was amazing fully recommended and would go gain. They do need to improve entertainments. The food was very good and plenty of choice.

reviews.title: Beautiful but overcrowded
reviews.text: Beach is absolutely amazing ! Shallow water make it perfect place to stay with kids, view is outstanding. The only disadvantage was fact that beach was absolutely packed, all day long - but cannot really complain as it not a private place and Playa de Muro is a holiday destination for thousand's ppl each year.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, well maintained and clean. Tide comes right up to the top of the beach. Shallow water that is excellent for smaller children.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, shallow crystal clear water. Keep very clean. Sunbeds are 11 Euro for 2 for the day with the shade.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: beautiful beach, the water is so shallow it's great for kiddies or nervous swimmers.  If you like a beach bed you need to be down there early enough as they do get filled up very quickly but great beach and lovely and clean.

reviews.title: Beautiful spot.
reviews.text: Lovely beach . Rent a little thatched brolly sunbed ,book ,cold bottle idyllic!Could have been anywhere in the world. Would think it is busy in peak season but nice in October half term.

reviews.title: very clean
reviews.text: muro beach is nice and clean and a good place to swim most of the time it does get very busy in august it is much quieter early and late season after a time on the beach over the road there are plenty of places to eat and have a drink you can have a pleasant day out here

reviews.title: Good Beach
reviews.text: A good beach, sand is not as big an area as alcudia and the sea is a bit rougher but its still worth a visit.water was still warm enough for swimming in November

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach, sea is great, thought that the sun bed and umbrella hire was reasonable. Lots of restaurants, supermarkets nearby for food and drink.

reviews.title: Warm and humid in October
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, quite warm for October plenty of people in the sea. Sea was lovely colour. The beach was very clean and not too crowded.

reviews.title: Very nice beach!
reviews.text: Nice long beach with amazing white sand, good for children. There are now promenade, so you can walk along the beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach with shallow sea
reviews.text: A nice beach but gets very crowded as beach is very narrow but you can walk for miles . sea is very shallow you have to walk out along way to swim , ideal for families with young children ,

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: Great for all ages. Very clean and tidy beach and surrounding areas. Toilets nearby kept pristine.  The water is very shallow up to 30+ yards from the shore so great for kids.  shops and restaurants close by.

reviews.title: wow so amazing
reviews.text: beautiful sandy beachdidn't see crabs or shellsjust lovely sandand it was shallow , so we felt safe to venture in and splash in the sea despite not being strong swimmersand was warm enough despite being october

reviews.title: lovely beach
reviews.text: we went on the beach 3 times during our stay nice and cleanand plenty of space your can walk for miles if you wish

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Nice and clean beach, there were people on charge to clean every evening. Lovely clear water and lots of little fish, good for snorkelling. I loved the sun beds with the lockers to put valuables in while swimming, really good touch.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach.
reviews.text: The beach at Playa De Muro is well maintained. There are manned lifeguard towers every 800m or so. Sun beds and parasols are available for a charge and local cafe's and shops are within a short walk. There are disabled sun beds adjacent to the wooden walkway and a foot wash and toilet facility very nearby.

reviews.title: playa de muro beach
reviews.text: went to the beach playa de muro, sand sea was clean it was beautiful, the beach was a 5 minute walking distance from my hotel hsm lago park. myself daughter saw small fish in there and was swimming with them they do not bite or hurt u. it was a great experience and so much fun.

reviews.title: A beach like you can imagine it
reviews.text: White 'sand', clear water and typical beach services is what you get at Playa de Muro. The beach is hit by big waves with certain winds which may lead to the beach being closed down by red flags. There is also a very nice trail going through a dune protection area, which can be recommended for everyone interested in the nature.

reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: beach has endless sun loungers for rent some even have little lockers for your phone etc to be stored away with a combination lock! onsite massage places.

reviews.title: Long sandy beach very safe for swimming
reviews.text: Direct access from our hotel onto this wonderful beach with a very good Activity centre for all types of watersports. Great for families, the older kids will love the inflatable obstacle course that is reasonably priced. Mum & Dad will enjoy a stroll after dinner along the endless white sandy beach. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Shallow waters, clear water, clean sand. Excellent
reviews.text: Very good beach almost next to the Viva Blue hotel. If travelling with small children, this place is excellent as they have very shallow wtaer here

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Loved this beach! It is clean, beautiful and not too busy (I mean, in September) The water is calm and warm.

reviews.title: Lovely clean beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach that stretches for miles with plenty of sunbeds to hire.  Sea is shallow for many metres making it great for children.  It's a shame there isn't a promenade that runs along side this beach as in other resorts, as shops, restaurants and bars are a short distance away mainly overlooking the busy road.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Stunning white sand and blueSea, plenty of bars, restaurants & shops to visit. It could easily be a Caribbean beach.
